Title: Big Data Laser Analyst
Description:
Description -

Job Summary


We are seeking a highly analytical, business-oriented Data Analyst to support the Print Supplies business. In this role, you will translate consumer and enterprise print telemetry into trusted metrics, dashboards, and actionable insights, with a primary focus on laser printer data. You will partner closely with data engineers and data scientists to improve data reliability, define KPI and metric semantics, and influence cross-functional decisions through clear data storytelling.


Responsibilities


Own laser print telemetry business insights for the Print Supplies organization, from problem framing and metric definition through analysis, visualization, and executive-ready recommendations.
Partner with stakeholders to clarify goals, translate business questions into analytical requirements, define critical KPIs, and deliver insights that drive decisions.
Provide consultative support and ad hoc analyses with clear hypotheses, methods, and assumptions; produce reusable queries, datasets, and shareable outputs with documented limitations.
Collaborate with internal and external partners to align on telemetry instrumentation, data collection methodology, and platform differences to ensure consistent interpretation across printer platforms.
Investigate data quality issues (completeness, accuracy, timeliness), perform root-cause analysis across pipelines and sources, and communicate impacts and remediation paths with appropriate caveats.
Enable self-service analytics by documenting dashboards and KPI definitions, and coach users on correct interpretation and common pitfalls.
Design and maintain measurement frameworks (e.g., adoption, usage, retention, share, funnel/driver analyses); when applicable, support experiment or pre/post evaluation and interpret results for stakeholders.
Create clear narratives through written summaries, presentations, and recurring reporting that highlight trends, drivers, risks, and recommended actions for leadership and partner teams.
Provide guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members.
Solve difficult and complex problems with a fresh perspective, demonstrating good judgment in selecting creative solutions and managing projects independently.
Lead moderate to high complexity projects, delivering professionally written reports, and supports the realization of operational and strategic plans.


Education & Experience Recommended


Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, database management, statistical analysis, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.


Preferred Certifications


Programming Language/s Certification (SQL, Python, or similar)


Knowledge & Skills


Analytics: exploratory analysis, root-cause analysis, and KPI design
SQL: complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query performance optimization
Python (and/or PySpark) for analysis, data validation, and automation. Familiar with VSCode and Databricks Ideally
Ability to interpret telemetry and pipeline outputs in business context, including communicating uncertainty and known limitations
Comfort working across multiple data sources/layers and explaining differences in source-of-truth, grain, and transformations
Comfort with modern analytics tooling (including AI-assisted development) while maintaining reproducibility and reviewable outputs
Dashboarding & data visualization: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, advanced excel / PowerPoint or similar; ability to build stakeholder-ready reporting
Data quality and governance: profiling, anomaly detection, metric validation, and documentation
Strong documentation habits for metric definitions, data lineage, and stakeholder guidance; familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) a plus. Familiar with Jira and Confluence.
Applied statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, and basic experiment/pre-post evaluation


Cross-Org Skills


Effective Communication
Results Orientation
Learning Agility
Digital Fluency
Customer Centricity
Collaboration across technical and non-technical teams


Impact & Scope


Impacts function by providing analytics and data quality validation that supports business-critical reporting and stakeholder decision-making for laser telemetry KPIs
Serves as a key point of contact for laser telemetry interpretation and investigation requests, partnering across teams to drive consistent definitions and reliable use of outputs


Complexity


Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

The pay range for this role is $83,000 to $127,800 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Health insurance

Long term/short term disability insurance
Employee assistance program
Flexible spending account
Life insurance
Generous time off policies, including;
4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure
11 paid holidays
Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave (US benefits overview)

Summit School Services is seeking a Data Analyst to design, build, and deliver impactful Power BI

reports and dashboards that support decision-making throughout the organization. This role requires

strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills to help drive business

performance, enhance quality, and optimize operational processes.

• Partner with stakeholders to gather requirements for reports, metrics and dashboards

• Develop a deep understanding of business operations and data usage

• Provide guidance on data management standards and best practices

• Serve as a subject matter expert for data engineering teams and technology partners

• Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

• Define functional requirements and gather feedback to improve data products.

• Advance enterprise reporting through product-thinking, including roadmaps and backlog

• Identify opportunities for improvement and cost savings.

Team Collaboration

• Serve as a subject matter expert for Data Engineers & reporting teams.

• Manage vendors and cross functional work to achieve outcomes

• Develop materials for leadership presentations

• Produce weekly and monthly KPI reports using Excel and Power BI.

• Identify trends, gaps and improvements in operational performance.

• Optimize statistical calculations for better business metrics.

• Engage in new analytical projects and exploratory data capturing.

• Identify and resolve issues in established reports.

• Experience in Power BI reports and dashboards (DAX, Data modeling, performance

• Database design and data visualization tools.

Support the development and measurement of customer retention initiatives.
Deliver insights that improve customer lifetime value and operational effectiveness.

Experience with Databricks and modern analytics tools.
Working knowledge of AI/Machine Learning concepts and predictive analytics.
Experience building automated reporting, dashboards, and ETL processes.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Customer-focused mindset with strong business acumen.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Product
Description:
As a Senior Data Analyst for Rocket Loans, you'll be a strategic partner to our leadership, collecting, analyzing, and reporting on data that drives operational excellence. You'll work closely with our Senior Data Analyst leadership to support our product reporting needs ultimately enabling our team leaders to make data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency and performance. You'll use a range of tools and methodologies, including statistics, technical expertise, and modern data platforms, to generate actionable insights and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. As a storyteller, you'll collect data from various sources to guide strategic decisions and support our transition to advanced analytics platforms.

About The Role


Identify and communicate patterns with our product teams in response to business needs using data manipulation, statistics, and data visualization
Create and support business intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, reports, and methods with a focus on our product teams
Use data to support and challenge business solutions with stakeholders, particularly our product teams
Identify, document, and use exploratory data analysis to investigate assumptions around product performance and team efficiency
Maintain strong relationships and alignment among product stakeholders to meet reporting and analytical objectives
Define, gather, and validate data requirements; evaluate and ensure data quality standards are met
Develop and maintain KPIs and metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Support the team's transition to Sigma as our primary reporting and visualization platform
Stay proactive and strategic—identifying opportunities to improve processes and reporting before being asked
Stay informed of industry trends and best practices in supporting product teams through data analytics


About You

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a scientific discipline, mathematics, applied statistics, information technology, or a related field
3+ years of experience using SQL or other querying languages to create and analyze data sets in a business setting
Experience creating KPIs/metrics around operational performance, team efficiency, and business health
Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools
Experience executing end-to-end data analysis projects in a business environment
Experience using data to tell stories tailored to different audiences
Working knowledge of standard statistical measures, probability theory, and both qualitative and quantitative techniques
Conceptual knowledge of software programming fundamentals


Preferred Qualifications


Domain expertise supporting analytics for product teams
Exceptional communication skills and ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders
Proven track record in data quality management and establishing data governance practices
Strategic, proactive mindset allowing you to identify opportunities and propose solutions rather than waiting for requests
Databricks SQL experience
Sigma experience for reporting and visualization
AI utilization experience and understanding of AI applications for use cases in business analytics
AWS experience


What You’ll Get

Our team members fuel our strategy, innovation and growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We go above and beyond to give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put: We’ve got your back. Check out our full list of Benefits and Perks.

We have given it our best to create an experience that is best-of-breed in the personal loan industry and commit even more to continuously improving it. At Rocket Loans, you’ll build a career that helps you achieve your professional goals while helping clients get the loans they need to reach their financial goals. We’re looking for innovators and those unafraid to disrupt the status -quo. With an inclusive culture and opportunities to make a positive impact, we’re here to help you foster your career growth.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You And The Role

Zipline is on a mission to transform how goods move by making autonomous drone delivery the fastest, most reliable, and most delightful logistics system in the world. As we continue to scale our Platform 2 (P2) business, we are looking for a Business Data Analyst to help turn data into actionable insights that drive growth.

As a member of Zipline's centralized Data Science & Analytics team, you will serve as an embedded business and analytics partner to stakeholders across Marketing, Commercial, and Growth. You will help teams make better decisions by translating business questions into analyses, dashboards, and recommendations that improve performance, identify opportunities, and accelerate growth.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining technical expertise with business curiosity. You are comfortable working with large datasets, building intuitive reporting solutions, and communicating complex findings in ways that inspire action. You are excited by the opportunity to use modern analytics and AI tools to automate manual work, improve visibility, and help Zipline scale efficiently.

What You'll Do


Own analyses of customer behavior, commercial performance, market dynamics, and Platform 2 growth opportunities.
Define KPI frameworks and metric definitions that give Marketing, Commercial, and Growth teams a consistent view of progress against strategic priorities.
Build and maintain business-facing dashboards and self-service reporting that stakeholders use to assess performance and plan action.
Translate analysis into recommendations that inform campaign investment, commercial prioritization, growth initiatives, and strategic tradeoffs.
Monitor performance to identify material trends, risks, and opportunities requiring a decision or change in business approach.
Partner with Data Science, Product, and business teams to improve data quality, reporting capabilities, and analytical processes.
Use AI-enabled workflows to automate recurring reporting and analysis, reducing manual work and improving the speed of insight delivery.



What You'll Bring


5+ years of experience delivering analytics or business intelligence work in analytics, operations, technology, logistics, eCommerce, or a related environment.
Advanced SQL proficiency and experience querying complex relational datasets.
Experience building business-facing dashboards in Sigma, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or a similar platform.
Familiarity with data warehouses such as Snowflake or Redshift and a scripting language such as Python.
Ability to turn ambiguous commercial or growth questions into rigorous analyses, clear measurement approaches, and actionable recommendations.
Strong communication and business judgment, with evidence of helping technical and non-technical stakeholders act on data.
Experience using AI tools to automate analytical workflows or recurring reporting, plus a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or related field.



What Else You Need To Know

The starting cash range for this role is $140,000 - $180,000. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; overtime pay; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more.

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or other characteristics protected by state, federal or local law or our other policies.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

Voluntary Self-Identification

For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.

As set forth in Zipline ’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

Title: Staff Data Analyst
Description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

Great decisions aren't built on intuition alone – they're built on data.

As a Staff Data Analyst, you'll partner with teams across the organization to transform data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions. You'll help leaders understand business performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and measure the impact of strategic initiatives.

The best analysts don't just report what happened – they help teams understand why it happened and what to do next. That's the kind of impact we're looking for in this role.

Some of the Problems You'll Solve:

🧪 Which initiatives create the greatest impact?

Design and analyze experiments, pilots, and performance evaluations that separate signal from noise and support confident decision-making.

Moses Lake Industries, Inc. (MLI) is a rapidly growing producer of ultra-pure chemical products, serving the semiconductor, silicon and flat-panel screen industries worldwide. You will be working for a midsized company with great people and a history of steady growth and profitability. Sound like a match? If you are prepared to work in an exciting and rewarding environment, we look forward to considering your experience and qualifications.

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, manual, or inefficient processes.
Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using tools such as Power Automate, Python, RPA platforms, or similar technologies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline workflows and increase operational efficiency.
Monitor and maintain automated processes, ensuring reliability and scalability.
Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets from multiple sources.
Develop dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Excel.
Translate complex data into clear insights, trends, and actionable recommendations.
Perform root cause analysis to support continuous improvement initiatives.
Build and maintain data pipelines and integrations between systems.
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across platforms.
Support data governance and compliance practices.
Work closely with business units (e.g., operations, finance, QA, supply chain) to understand requirements.
Communicate findings and automation solutions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Provide training and documentation for implemented tools and processes.
Uphold all MLI policies and “MLI Code of Conduct.”
Strict compliance with Environmental and Safety regulations.
Compliance and individual accountability with the MLI Quality System and ISO Registration is required. It is the employee’s commitment to ensure that the Company’s actual practices and procedures are exercised as directed.
Perform other duties as assigned to support and sustain a high performing team.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in science base program or business administration (high preference for a degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, or Engineering). Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and continuous improvement.
Effective time manager with high organization & managing competing priorities; ability to prioritize and plan operational workload, balance competing priorities.
Strong attention to detail, observation, organization, analytical, problem-solving & leadership skills.
Strong technical and IT skills, toolset usage, planning and problem solving, including applicable technology, tools & industry best practices.
Excellent communication, listening & presentation (written & verbal) skills in English.
Work effectively with high tolerance of ambiguity and ability to follow instructions.
Assertive, self-starter that sets initiative and goals.
Critical thinking, scenario planning, & risk mitigation techniques and systems.
Ability to travel (All US States & International), up to 75% of time.
Office location at Moses Lake, WA, Milwaukie, OR, remote upon approval. Demonstrated ability to work remotely effectively with no impact to results.


Preferred Qualifications


Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
Minimum of three (3) years managing complex technical teams.
Minimum of two (2) years of experience in data analysis, automation, or related roles.
Strong proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, Python, or R).
Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
Familiarity with automation platforms (Power Automate, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, etc.).
Knowledge of databases, ETL processes, and data modeling.
Basic understanding of APIs and system integrations.
Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Knowledge of Lean/Six Sigma or process improvement methodologies.
Experience in scripting or programming for automation (Python, VBA).
Familiarity with ERP/MES systems in manufacturing environments.


Salary & Benefits

Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Summary pay range: $70K-$120K

We offer the following benefits: compensation, medical, vision, and dental insurance benefits.


You can work in an environment where teamwork is encouraged and where you have the opportunities for personal and professional growth.
Generous PTO: Your time off is important!
Medical/Dental/Vision: Majority of premiums paid by MLI. Includes virtual medical and mental health options.
Additional Health Coverage: FSA and HSA available. Voluntary insurance options include life and AD&D, accident, hospitalization, and critical illness.
Earn More: We offer a generous discretionary bonus program in addition to salary/wage.
401 (K) Savings Plan: Jump start your retirement with MLI’s employer matching contributions.
Company – Paid Benefits: Long-Term Disability Insurance, EAP, Fitness Club Membership Program, & Education Assistance Program.
Additional Benefits: We provide position-based clothing, travel expenses, training and relocation assistance available.


WORKING CONDITIONS

Duties are generally performed indoors in an office and high purity manufacturing environment. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate. When working in the presence of safety hazards, the employee is expected to follow company safety rules and use proper personal protective equipment such as: hardhat, safety glasses and full leather shoes, etc.

Title: Product Analyst / Data Analyst
Description:
Your Job

Flint Hills Resources is seeking a Product Analyst/Data Analyst to join our team in Wichita, KS. As an IT Product Analyst/Data Analyst, you will serve as a highly capable contributor who helps ensure strong delivery execution and continuity within the product team. You will play a critical role in translating product direction into high-quality delivery outcomes and in extending the team's impact across the broader technology ecosystem. This role is well-suited for someone ready to take accountability for delivery outcomes, influence how work gets done, and contribute meaningfully to business and technology objectives.

What You Will Do


Work closely with the business to understand problems at their root and drive solutions through technology — whether through your own development work or by collaborating across the business, software engineering, data architecture and solutions architecture.
Develop and maintain scripts, agents, and lightweight applications using tools like Python to automate processes, move data, and solve business problems.
Understand data models, system integrations, and application behavior to effectively translate business needs into sound technical approaches.
Analyze data, build reports and dashboards, and surface insights that inform product and business decisions — including understanding how application data and APIs translate into graph and analytical data models.
Own projects end-to-end — from problem statement through delivery and adoption — maintaining accountability for outcomes throughout.
Contribute to roadmap development, collaborating closely with product and business leadership to identify new features, enhancements, and incremental improvements aligned with product direction.
Continuously innovate and push the team forward — challenging the status quo, identifying opportunities to transform how work gets done, and raising the bar for those around you.



Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)


Experience in IT, data, software engineering, or a business role with demonstrated technical aptitude
A passion for or experience writing scripts, queries, or code (e.g., Python, JavaScript, SQL, AI agents, or equivalent) to solve problems, automate processes, or move and validate data
Experience working directly with business stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into technical solutions
Experience communicating technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences
This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship



What Will Put You Ahead


Experience with Cypher, graph databases, or data modeling
Experience with data engineering or API integrations — building pipelines, moving data, or connecting systems
Experience with cloud technologies, specifically AWS (e.g., SQS, CloudWatch, Lambda)
Experience with AI agents, LLMs, or prompt engineering
Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, data modeling, or analytics — including building reports, dashboards, or data products that inform business decisions
Experience in procurement, accounts payable, source-to-pay, or operations



At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

As a Koch company, Flint Hills Resources is an industry-leading refining company making the oil and transportation products that keep the world moving. We make a large supply of fuel for gas stations and airports in addition to transporting crude oil, natural gas liquids and refined products through 4,000+ miles of pipeline – delivering energy to farmers, manufacturers and families. Our team champions innovation and excellence to help power modern life.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Title: Data Analytics Coordinator
Description:
Position Summary

The Data Analytics Coordinator plays a supporting role as a steward of PRPA's data warehouses, from data ongestion through to the creation and maintenance of reports. They are responsible for ensuring the quality and integrity of data used for various activities from infrastructure planning to business development.

Position Accountabilities


PRPA's primary data steward for all forms of data, including geospatial (GIS) data, which support day-to-day operations at PRPA.
Load data assets into PRPA’s data warehouses following best practices.
Support and maintain PRPA’s data warehouse.
Maintenance of reports and dashboards.
Training of PRPA staff in end user reporting tools available for accessing PRPA’s data.


WORKING CONDITIONS


Works predominantly in an office environment.
Regular, full-time position (37.5 hours per week). Regular working hours are Mondays to Fridays, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM with 1 hour unpaid lunch break.


JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Formal Education


College diploma in Analytics, Computer Science Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or Information Technology.


Related Experience


Three to five years' experience in the industry


Other Requirements


Experience with reporting tools and software including SSRS, PowerBI, Informatica.
Experience with SSIS or other data ingestion and transformation tools.
Experience using Safe FME for processing geospatial data.
Experience with report writing, organizing, and presenting data in support of decision making
Demonstrates statistical and empirical analytical skills
Knowledge of relational database structures, theories, principles, and practices is an asset
Knowledge of ETL methodologies, T-SQL and ArcGIS is an asset
Familiar with the transportation and logistics industry
Demonstrates ability to learn new skills and acquire industry knowledge
Good spoken and written communication skills
Strong problem solving and organizational skills
Accuracy and attention to detail, with an analytical eye
Superior judgment and tact in dealing with sensitive issues and confidential information.
Demonstrates ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and to effectively handle changing priorities.
Enthusiastic and self-motivated. Works well individually as well as in a team environment.
Creative and intuitive thinker.
Demonstrates commitment to the Port’s Vision.
Resilient. Embraces change and thrives on change.
Proficient in MS Office, especially Microsoft Word, Excel, Visio and PowerPoint; some exposure to MS Access and Project.
Able to obtain security clearance under Transport Canada's Security Clearance Program.


The base salary range for this role is $77,689 - $97,112. This position is eligible for a performance-based variable incentive targeted at 10% of the base salary.

Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging are at the heart of PRPA’s culture and play a vital role in our growth strategy. We are committed to ensuring that everyone feels a sense of belonging and can contribute to their maximum potential. Our differences are the reason great things happen here. If you are an applicant in need of accommodation or special assistance throughout the interview process, please submit a request by email to careers@rupertport.com.

Individuals of Indigenous descent are strongly encouraged to apply.

Title: Pricing & Reporting Analyst
Description:
Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection.

Reports to: Sr. Pricing Analyst

Location: Cottonwood Heights, Utah (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office)

About The Role

The Merchandise Planning team needs a data-driven analyst to own the day-to-day mechanics of pricing across Backcountry's four banners—competitive pricing audits, markdown execution, MAP/MSRP compliance, and the reporting that powers pricing decisions.

As Pricing & Reporting Analyst, you will work directly with the Sr. Pricing Analyst to maximize profitability through smart pricing execution. By 6–12 months, you will be running pricing operations independently, regularly making recommendations that move sell-through, margin, or working capital, and serving as the team's go-to for AI-augmented workflows.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

About The Role


Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis
Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) daily to write formulas, draft SQL, automate repetitive tasks, summarize results, and accelerate your own learning
Execute daily, weekly, and seasonal price changes across four banners, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
Monitor competitive pricing across key categories and partner brands; surface risks and opportunities to the Sr. Pricing Analyst and Buying teams
Track MAP and MSRP compliance across the assortment, flagging and correcting violations in a timely manner
Bring analytical judgment to pricing and strategy conversations—surface trends, audit outcomes, flag risks, and recommend pricing actions that improve sell-through, margin, or working capital
Build and maintain pricing reports and dashboards that Planning, Buying, and Marketing teams rely on
Document and improve pricing processes—turn one-off analyses into repeatable AI-powered workflows
Partner with Marketing on promotional pricing setup and post-promo recaps
Maintain a strong feedback loop with the Sr. Pricing Analyst on what is working, what is not, and where to push next


What You'll Do


Pull pricing, margin, and sales data from the data warehouse for ad hoc analysis
Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) daily to write formulas, draft SQL, automate repetitive tasks, summarize results, and accelerate your own learning
Execute daily, weekly, and seasonal price changes across four banners, ensuring accuracy and on-time delivery
Monitor competitive pricing across key categories and partner brands; surface risks and opportunities to the Sr. Pricing Analyst and Buying teams
Track MAP and MSRP compliance across the assortment, flagging and correcting violations in a timely manner
Bring analytical judgment to pricing and strategy conversations—surface trends, audit outcomes, flag risks, and recommend pricing actions that improve sell-through, margin, or working capital
Build and maintain pricing reports and dashboards that Planning, Buying, and Marketing teams rely on
Document and improve pricing processes—turn one-off analyses into repeatable AI-powered workflows
Partner with Marketing on promotional pricing setup and post-promo recaps
Maintain a strong feedback loop with the Sr. Pricing Analyst on what is working, what is not, and where to push next


Required Qualifications


3–5 years of analyst experience, preferably in retail, ecommerce, or a related data-driven role
Demonstrated daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or similar) for real work—you iterate on prompts, evaluate outputs critically, and know when AI is the right tool versus when it is not
High proficiency with Microsoft Excel (pivots, lookups, formulas) and a strong aptitude to learn technical applications quickly
Solid understanding of retail math (margin, markdown, sell-through, IMU) and financial concepts (GMROI, NPV, CM%)
Awareness of customer pricing behavior—anchoring, discount perception, and how merchandising and pricing decisions land on a product detail page
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with messy datasets
Excellent attention to detail—pricing errors are expensive, and you treat that responsibility seriously
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate analysis into a clear, concise recommendation
Able to work both independently and collaboratively across Planning, Buying, Marketing, and Finance
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Statistics, or a related field preferred; equivalent demonstrated experience considered
Passion for the outdoor industry and knowledge of outdoor gear is a plus.


Why Join

The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.


Cross-Functional Impact: Your pricing work carries weight beyond the Pricing team—recommendations you make will shape decisions across Planning, Buying, Marketing, and Finance.
AI-First Skill Building: AI is a first-class tool here, not a buzzword. You will use Claude, Copilot, and similar tools daily and actively shape how the team adopts them.
Real Ownership: This role pairs tactical pricing execution with strategic contributions. You will report to an experienced Sr. Pricing Analyst with growth-focused mentorship and high visibility from day one.
Competitive Benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.


Interview Process


Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the Sr. Pricing Analyst focused on your analytical approach, pricing experience, and AI tool proficiency.
Take-Home Assignment - A pre-built test requiring high-level analysis, the use and documentation of AI as a working partner, and advanced communication skills to convey complex business recommendations.
In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our Cottonwood Heights office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.


Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

The CSC Generation family of brands is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please contact [email protected] .

Title: Data Analyst

A growing organization is seeking an eCommerce Data Specialist to play a key role in modernizing its online eCommerce product ecosystem. This position will focus on transforming large, complex product datasets, designing scalable catalog structures, and improving the processes used to manage product information across digital sales channels.




This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving data challenges, streamlining workflows, and building a foundation for future ecommerce growth.




What You'll Do

Redesign and optimize product catalog structures for a modern commerce platform.
Analyze, cleanse, and standardize large volumes of product data.
Create efficient processes for data imports, updates, validation, and ongoing maintenance.
Work with technical teams to align product information, business rules, and system integrations.
Improve digital asset organization, including product imagery and supporting content.
Evaluate and automate manual processes where possible.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and usability across ecommerce systems.

What We're Looking For

Experience working with large-scale product catalogs or digital commerce data.
Strong understanding of product taxonomy, catalog organization, and data governance.
Experience with data conversion, migration projects, or systems modernization initiatives.
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats, and data integration processes.
Ability to troubleshoot data quality issues and develop scalable solutions.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Experience

Product information management (PIM) systems.
ERP integrations and data synchronization.
Workflow automation or scripting experience.
High-volume product environments or highly configurable product offerings.
Digital asset management and ecommerce operations.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

Highly visible role with significant impact on business operations.
Opportunity to shape long-term data strategy and best practices.
Blend of technical problem-solving, process improvement, and business collaboration.
Stable organization investing in its digital commerce capabilities.

Candidates with experience improving product data quality, streamlining catalog operations, or supporting digital transformation initiatives are encouraged to apply.


• At least 2 years of experience working on ecommerce platform migration initiatives.
• Hands-on knowledge of BigCommerce catalog architecture and platform capabilities.
• Experience designing product taxonomies, catalog structures, and data mapping strategies for ecommerce environments.
• Proficiency with ETL concepts, SQL, JSON, and data import or synchronization processes.
• Working knowledge of APIs and experience supporting system integrations or migration tooling.
• Familiarity with Python, Node.js, or similar scripting languages used for transformation workflows.

Title: Institutional Query Analyst
Description:
The University of Southern Mississippi is currently accepting applications for the position of Institutional Query Analyst.

Position Details Location Hattiesburg

118 College Drive

Hattiesburg, Mississippi, 39406-0001

United States Division Institutional Research Office Position Type Staff Employment Status Full Time Grant Funded Yes Salary Range 50,000.00 - 53,000.00 Pay Grade

E10

Posting Close Date Open Until Filled

Special Instructions to Applicants

Please submit a cover letter, resume and contact information for three (3) references when applying for this position. Please note this position is grant funded.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for visa sponsorship. The University will not sponsor applicants for work visas (e.g., H-1B).

Job Summary

The Institutional Query Analyst is responsible for managing and maintaining the University’s PeopleSoft query environment, ensuring that campus-wide query usage aligns with established business processes, internal policies, and data governance standards. This position supports institutional data integrity by conducting regular audits, analyzing existing queries, and collaborating with departments to address discrepancies and improve data reliability. The analyst plays a critical role in campus data governance through oversight of query security access, coordination of query writer training, and leadership of the campus-wide query literacy program in partnership with key data stakeholders.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities


Manage and maintain the University’s ad hoc query request system, ensuring timely updates, troubleshooting, and coordination of query maintenance needs across campus.
Serve as a data integrity analyst by evaluating and validating existing queries to ensure alignment with university business processes and internal policies. Conduct regular data audits and collaborate with campus offices to resolve discrepancies and improve data quality.
Coordinate and lead the ongoing training program for employees with query-writing access. Serve as chair of the training program and provide regular updates and reports to the Academic Standards Committee.
Conduct regular audits of query viewer access to ensure proper security controls. Oversee the review and submission of security role requests required for running or viewing queries.
Coordinate a campus-wide data literacy program focused on query usage, working in partnership with the Data Literacy Program Manager and Statistical Analyst to ensure consistency with other institutional data literacy initiatives.
Assist with the preparation, analysis, and reporting of official institutional data to federal agencies, including the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS), and respond to ad hoc internal and external data requests.
Performs other duties as assigned to support the mission and operations of the department.


Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in data science, information systems, computer science, statistics, business analytics, or a closely related field; and three (3) to five (5) years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or information systems; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


Adept in Microsoft Office, specifically Excel
Strong analytical skills
Ability to review business processes for accuracy
Excellent written and oral communication skills
Ability to process and interpret information received and ask questions as appropriate
Ability to design SQL queries


Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency with use of SQL and Peoplesoft; demonstrated data quality control experience; demonstrated high levels of attention to detail; experience working in academia.

About The University Of Southern Mississippi

Since our founding in 1910, The University of Southern Mississippi has remained dedicated to preparing students for success. We deliver programs to more than 13,000 students in Hattiesburg and Long Beach, at teaching and research sites across the Mississippi Gulf Coast, as well as online. We are a community-engaged Carnegie R1 university, earning distinction as one of the nation's leading research institutions.

Southern Miss is known for pioneering work in polymer science, ocean science, spectator sports safety and security, and bringing language to children with communication disorders. We are also a national leader in a broad range of disciplines, including cybersecurity, hydrography, nutrition, aquaculture, kinesiology, and economic development, among others.

We produce graduates ready to enter fields that are leading the way in emerging technologies through programs such as computer engineering, information technology, and ocean engineering. We’re developing the next generation of business leaders, while also responding to critical workforce shortages by producing skilled professionals in education and nursing. With a tradition of excellence in the arts, we are one of only 36 public institutions in the nation accredited in four major areas of the arts. Home to the Golden Eagles, our student-athletes compete in 17 NCAA Division I sports. With a culture marked by passion and persistence, Southern Miss is delivering graduates who are ready for life. For more information, visit www.usm.edu.

The University of Southern Mississippi is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. EOE/VETS/DISABILITY.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We’re looking for a curious, thoughtful Data Analyst who enjoys turning data into answers that people can actually use.




In this role, you’ll work with different teams to understand what’s happening in the business, dig into the numbers, and help people make better decisions. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working with data but also knows that good analysis is about more than spreadsheets—it’s about asking the right questions and explaining what the numbers mean.




You’ll have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, improve reporting and processes, and help the team see the bigger picture through data.




What You’ll Do




Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and areas that need attention.
Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and regular business insights.
Work with stakeholders to understand their questions and translate them into practical analysis.
Clean, organize, and validate data to make sure it is accurate and reliable.
Use SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools to explore and communicate findings.
Present your findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Work closely with teams across the business to support data-driven decisions.
Look for ways to improve existing reports, processes, and how we use data.
Take ownership of your work while asking questions when you need context or clarification.




What We’re Looking For




Experience working as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
Strong SQL and Excel skills.
Experience with a visualization or BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
Strong attention to detail and a practical approach to problem-solving.
The ability to explain complex information in a simple, clear way.
Good communication skills and the confidence to work with people across different teams.
A naturally curious mindset—you like to understand the “why” behind the numbers.
The ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.




Nice to Have

Experience with Python or another programming language used for data analysis.
Experience working with large or complex datasets.
Knowledge of statistics and basic analytical techniques.
Experience working with cloud data platforms or data warehouses.
Experience in our industry or with similar business problems.




What You Can Expect




You’ll be joining a team where your work will have a real impact. We value people who are willing to ask questions, share ideas, learn from others, and take ownership of their work.




We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. What matters to us is that you’re willing to learn, think critically, and care about doing good work.




If you enjoy working with data, solving real business problems, and helping people make sense of information, we’d love to hear from you.

Description:

To be considered for this position, applicants must submit a complete application that includes (1) an online application, (2) a cover letter, and (3) a resume that addresses how they meet the minimum and/or preferred qualifications. Please include the position location (Eugene or Portland) you are applying for.

We are interested in finding the best candidate for the position. Department Summary

University Advancement (UA) supports the University of Oregon’s (UO) mission of providing exceptional teaching, discovery, and service by strategically positioning the university to create awareness, build long-term relationships, and secure resources that increase understanding and further its aims. The division consists of approximately 200 employees primarily working out of Eugene, with offices in Portland and Bend. We are committed to fostering equity and inclusion in a welcoming, safe, and respectful environment that recognizes the value of all members of our community.

The Advancement Strategies and Technology Innovation (ASTI) department is focused on finding the solutions for foundational issues that will best position UO Advancement to achieve its goals around engagement and fundraising. The department has a unique function in that it is based in UO Advancement, but also has strong working partnerships with The Office of Development as part of University Advancement has a mission to maximize philanthropic impact at the University of Oregon. We do this by identifying, connecting and engaging alumni and friends around the globe with their passions to advance the vision and priorities of the university.

Prospect Development is responsible for the implementation of the prospect management system and for the identification of prospects, strategic prospect review and providing intelligence for the purpose of aiding development officers in optimizing portfolios and fundraising to their highest capacity. This department's work is critical to the future success of fundraising at the University of Oregon and the Advancement initiative to identify the next generation of philanthropic leaders. Prospect Development collaborates with each development team and the department as a whole to promote a systematic and quantifiable framework through which development staff manage relationships and to analyze and identify prospects and related strategies.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Associate Director of Prospect Development, the Prospect Management Analyst audits and tracks prospect records while maintaining data integrity throughout the pipeline. Using a comprehensive knowledge of the Prospect Management System, this position reviews and revises policies, procedures, and reports, and engages key stakeholders in discussions and system review. In addition, this position conducts analytics and produces reports on prospect management data that provide essential information to development leadership and stakeholders about development activities and fundraiser performance.

With a customer service focus, the Prospect Management Analyst communicates, provides information, and strategizes with frontline fundraisers and their assistants on a regular basis. This position provides hands-on instruction for data input and information retrieval and plays an integral role in training fundraisers and Advancement staff on Prospect Management System policies.

The ideal candidate for this position will develop an in-depth knowledge of University Advancement’s donor database system that allows them to maintain data integrity by auditing their own work and that of colleagues. This position provides key services to constituents within the department and uses data visualization and analysis to provide information that informs department strategies and metrics. The Prospect Management Analyst should be able to work collaboratively, think independently, and work effectively with a variety of constituents and stakeholders. A PM Analyst that would thrive in this position is one who is detail oriented, enjoys working with large datasets, and can find patterns and impacts within the data to formulate a story of information.

Minimum Requirements

College level courses in statistics (at least six quarter hours); research methods and techniques (e.g., research

design, sampling, surveying, etc.); and computer software application or packages (e.g., Statistical Analyses System, Lotus 1-2-3, etc.);

OR

Three years of experience assisting with the gathering, compiling, analyzing, and reporting of research information and statistical data plus assisting with the drafting of this information into narrative or statistical reports

OR

An equivalent combination of training and experience.

Transcripts must be submitted for all required and/or related courses.

Professional Competencies


Ability to gain in-depth knowledge of a complex database system, including an understanding of how to use, support, modify and train others in the use of database systems.
Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Excel and Word.
Ability to exercise independent judgment, as well as operate as a productive team member.
Ability and willingness to work in an environment of frequent interruptions and competing priorities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including a willingness to proactively reach out to constituents and colleagues in person, via phone, and email.
Ability to build strong relationships with constituents, including developing rapport and trust.
Ability to interpret, analyze, and visualize data.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and adhere to the highest ethical standards.
Ability to interact, communicate, and work effectively with individuals, recognizing and respecting the many and varied identities of each person.
Commitment to promoting and enhancing diversity, equity, and inclusion.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience providing training on complex systems and/or internal policies and procedures.
Experience with Salesforce CRM database..
Experience with Tableau or other data visualization software.
Experience working in higher education development.
Experience in developing and maintaining policies and procedures.

All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a background check.

Title: Operations Systems Analyst
Description:
The Operations Systems Analyst will assist in tactically driving applications to evolve and enhance Click Bond’s business decision making capabilities. This role will support the identification, research, troubleshooting, and resolution of technical issues as it relates to database management, data conveyance mechanisms, graphical representation, and AI/Automation processes as well as applications. This role will support and work closely with all functional departments of Click Bond.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities


Responsible for examining and diagnosing trends and optimizing manufacturing processes to improve efficiency and productivity. This involves conducting data analysis, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing strategies to enhance overall operations.
Develop and create AI/Automation tools to support Click Bonds initiative.
Develop and create dashboards and reporting tools to support team members.
Participate in the development of new methods utilizing data to improve manufacturing processes and outcomes.
Propose process enhancements through data analysis.
Assist in developing and maintaining manufacturing measures, and metrics and apply Lean principles where applicable.
Conduct training on various manufacturing-related tasks.
Learn Click Bond manufacturing processes to better understand data outputs.
Will comply with and meets or exceeds requirements of Click Bond’s Quality and Environmental Management System (QEMS), AS9100, ISO14001, and 27001.
Tasked with the collection of stakeholder requirements, the orchestration of meetings, and the advancement of collaborative efforts in line with the industry’s recognized project management best practices.
Report immediately all suspicious and hazardous conditions to a supervisor.
Understand and observe all safety guidelines and assure quality and safety by complying with all appropriate Click Bond policies and procedures.
Assist in maintaining clean, orderly, and hazard-free work areas.
Able to work with minimal supervision, be a self-starter and be detail oriented.
Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to demonstrate the following competencies:


Strong analytical skills with attention to detail.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience building dashboards, using measures, and metrics.
Skillful at reading, writing and interpreting documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
Demonstrated ability to present business solutions to executive teams.
Proficient in AI/Automation tools (i.e. – CoPilot Studio, Power Automate, Python, HTML coding).
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Power BI).
Ability to utilize reports, accounting database applications, and MRP/ERP software.
Solid understanding of data structures, relational database, and MRP/ERP systems.
Strong SQL skills and understanding of data warehousing techniques.
Ability to collect business requirements and develop effective reports and dashboards. Additional requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.
Ability to write and read English.


Education And/Or Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science Field or 3+ years’ experience in a related field.
EPICOR experience is a plus but not required.


Supervisory Responsibilities


This is not a supervisory position.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


The work is primarily sedentary, although there may be some walking, standing, bending, and carrying of items, such as paper or books, weighing less than 10 pounds.


Work Environment


Work primarily performed in a standard office environment. If in manufacturing areas, may be exposed to noise, smells, heat, dust, etc.
Work requires the observance of fire regulations and safe work practices.


Click Bond Way – Key Attributes


Communicates respectfully to all team members, vendors, and visitors.
Models a positive attitude.
Actively listens to others and supports the team environment.
Asks questions and learns from mistakes.
Executes tasks with minimal errors in a timely and efficient manner.
Attendance is consistent and meets or exceeds company standards.

Title: Corporate Advanced Analyst I
Description:
Employment Type

Full-time

Exempt or Non-Exempt

Exempt

Job Summary


Hybrid Work Environment - Must reside on Oahu**



Pay Range: $59,000 - $116,000

Note: Individuals typically begin between the minimum to middle of the pay range

Works independently with internal and external customers to clearly articulate and define business problem(s) to be solved; reviews data sources and preps needed data; performs required analysis; applies accepted statistical methodologies where applicable; documents the process that was followed and data sources/tools used; ensures results have been validated (statistically, if necessary); and prepares/presents findings that are informative and audience appropriate to drive decision making across various levels of the organization.

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor's degree and four years of related experience or two years of Healthcare Analytics experience; or an equivalent combination of education and related work experience.
Strong oral and written communicate skills.
Strong understanding of data (types, content reliability, etc.).
Strong problem solving and data collection, analysis, and interpretation.
Strong understanding/use of dashboards, data visualization tools, and advanced and custom graphics.
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office applications. Including but not limited to Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook.
Proficiency with OLAP tools and databases.
Knowledge of one or more of the following: SQL, R or SAS/SPSS



Duties And Responsibilities


Data Management:
Reviews data sources and preps needed data.
Identifies existing and new data sources.
Performs data prototyping, if necessary, to agree what data can/not be used.
Preps data for use in analysis, goes back to source if problems are found, and identifies other options/alternatives if problems cannot be resolved.
Performs review of data to ensure completeness/accuracy/timeliness for the purpose of the analysis.
Ensures existing, approved, corporate tools used can accept/integrate the data.
Where necessary (and if practical to be done within the delivery timeframe of a project), facilitates the identification and use of new tools and works with the Technical Review Committee to authorize its use.
Analytics and Technical Acumen:
Performs required analysis, applies accepted statistical methodologies where applicable, and documents the process that was followed and data sources/tools used.
Determines what kind of analytics will be performed (descriptive, predictive, prescriptive) and defines/documents overall framework.
Where appropriate, applies linear regression (correlation, contingency table, ANOVA, inference, chi-square, t-test) and/or time series methods (data set-up, conversions, trends, decomposition, models, forecasts, confidence).
Utilizes appropriate tools to load, integrate, and analyze data.
Conducts analysis and documents findings, identifies unexpected anomalies and root cause (if possible) and determines if analysis can continue, identifies alternatives if anomalies cannot be resolved
Ensures reproducibility of outcomes.
Documents entire analysis process, including business problem, data sources, methods and tools used, project reference, and outcomes.
