The Opportunity

CACI is seeking a Business Systems Analyst to support Shipyard personnel tasked to expedite execution of maintenance availabilities and accelerate on-time delivery of submarines. This position supports the Shipyard solely onsite in HI.

As The Business Systems Analyst, You Will


Leverage your data analytics and dashboard development experience and proven expertise while partnering with Shipyard personnel at all levels of the organization to improve processes, workflow, communications, collaboration, reporting, and supply chains that will lead to increases in Submarine Operational Availability.
Provide subject matter expertise in shipbuilding or ship repair activities, including best practices and lessons learned, that can be applied to reap improvements in Shipyard naval maintenance and modernization activities.
Provide consultation, tools, and methods to aid decision making, project management, and action planning.


Responsibilities


Work collaboratively within a local CACI team and across contractor and customer teams to improve naval maintenance and modernization activities.
Extract data from databases to build metrics, dashboards, and slide deck reports.
Establish and track metrics to determine effectiveness and ensure accountability of stated goals. Perform data collection and analysis.
Design, develop, and update operational and performance metrics and visualization dashboards that measure the status of objectives and their impact on the performance of stated Shipyard measures. Create and deliver slide deck reports and presentations that meet customer needs.
Apply subject matter expertise to determine the highest value-added goals and develop an effective course of action to achieve them.
Facilitate supported teams in taking specific, measurable actions at the agreed upon standard of quality and consistency to drive goal achievement.
Plan, facilitate, lead, and support customer meetings, presentations, briefings, strategic planning sessions, working groups, off-site events, etc. in support of contract activities. This includes pre- and post-administrative support/coordination.
Provide information for various Shipyard management systems.
Support and coordinate with customers in preparation of documentation and deliverables.
Assist Shipyard Trade Shops, Support Codes, and Project Teams in focusing on process improvements that will add the most value to their work.
Establish standards, track highest-performing teams’ behaviors, and share them with across the Naval Maintenance Community.
Develop, maintain, and execute communication strategies that include all customer stakeholders.
Promote accountability through fostering a collective desire to hold each other accountable, celebrate victories, correct problems, and unify the team.
Support the execution of contract requirements, which may include submission of supporting data and metrics and timely completion of written reports to stakeholders, customers, and CACI leadership.
Other duties may be assigned in support of contract taskings and mission success.


Qualifications

Required:


Must be a US Citizen
Must have the ability to obtain a DOD interim Secret and subsequent final DOD Secret security clearance.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. In lieu of the degree requirement, candidates with minimum 10 years of directly applicable work experience may be considered for this position.
Minimum 5 years of experience working in public or private industry Shipyards in the area of shipbuilding, modernization, or ship repair OR in a large commercial repair machine shop OR in a production shop or engineering department.
Extensive experience developing metrics from data mining and developing visualization dashboards using Excel or Power BI tools. High level of proficiency in extracting data from databases to build metrics, dashboards, and slide deck reports.
Expertise in Shipyard best practices with the ability to leverage that expertise and experience to identify best-in-class practices across the shipbuilding and ship repair community.
Demonstrated project management and research skills.
Experience facilitating meetings attended by senior leadership.
Self-starter who is comfortable working in ambiguous situations and in a demanding industrial environment.
Proven leadership ability and demonstrated focus on making the workplace and operating environment higher performing.
Ability to work both independently and within a team to resolve problems.
Strong customer service orientation and written/verbal communication skills with the ability to respectfully engage internal and external customers at all levels in a manner that achieves successful outcomes.
Outstanding organizational skills to efficiently manage competing priorities, multiple concurrent taskings, and firm deadlines.
Proficiency with Microsoft 365.


Desired


Active DOD Secret security clearance
Experience working with unions and leading teams of Shipyard skilled workers (e.g., First-Line Supervisor, Work Group Leader, Foreman, Zone Manager).
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Certification in Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, Shingo, or Theory of Constraints.
Experience using cloud-based knowledge management systems (SharePoint, iNFUSION Suite, Jira, etc.).
Knowledge of Naval Shipyard data systems.
Work experience with the Naval Maintenance Community, United States Navy, or the Department of Defense. Experience working with Carrier Planning Activity, SUBMEPP, SHAPEC, PMS312, PMS 392, etc. is preferred.


What You Can Expect

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

$71,800 - $150,800

Hi, we’re HUB – a network of doers with diverse stories and a shared goal to support our clients and communities. When you partner with us, you’re at the center of a vast network of risk, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management specialists that bring clarity to a changing world with tailored solutions and unrelenting advocacy – so you’re ready for tomorrow.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly skilled Data Analyst with strong, hands-on experience in Applied Epic and Power BI to join our team. This role is central to maintaining, structuring, and leveraging data from Applied Epic to support operational decision-making, business performance tracking, and strategic initiatives across the organization. The successful candidate will take ownership of data quality metrics, build and maintain Power BI reporting infrastructure, develop Epic automation, and drive system efficiencies. Demonstrated expertise in Applied Epic's data structure and reporting capabilities, combined with advanced Power BI skills, is essential to success in this role. This is a great opportunity for someone who is detail-oriented, analytical, and excited about transforming insurance and brokerage data into actionable, visual business intelligence.

What You'll Do


Extract, analyze, and interpret data directly from Applied Epic, using advanced knowledge of its data structure, tables, and relationships to support business reporting and analytics
Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that present KPIs and operational metrics to stakeholders at all levels of the organization
Develop and manage data models and ETL processes connecting Applied Epic to Power BI, ensuring scalable, reliable, and efficient reporting solutions
Build and maintain Epic automation (including VBA-based tools and scripts) to streamline data extraction, reduce manual processes, and improve system efficiency
Establish and enforce data quality and validation processes to ensure accuracy and consistency across all Applied Epic-sourced reports and downstream systems
Write and optimize queries (SQL and/or Epic-native reporting tools) to support ad hoc and recurring reporting needs
Partner with underwriting, finance, operations, and leadership teams to gather reporting requirements and translate them into effective Power BI solutions
Support projects involving the migration, integration, or optimization of Applied Epic data with other business platforms (e.g., finance systems, CRM, data warehouses)
Maintain documentation of data definitions, report logic, and dashboard structures to support long-term data governance
Stay current on Applied Epic updates/releases and Power BI features to continuously improve reporting capabilities


What We're Looking For


Required: Significant hands-on experience working directly within Applied Epic, specifically in data extraction, reporting, and analysis
Required: Strong, proven experience with Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, data modeling, and building interactive dashboards from scratch
Required: Proficiency in SQL and Power Query (other query languages an asset)
A background in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field is considered an asset
Proficiency in VBA coding for automation and process improvement
Solid understanding of data modeling principles, particularly as they apply to reporting, dashboard integration, and Epic's underlying schema
Experience in the insurance or brokerage industry is a strong asset
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a sharp eye for accuracy and detail
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Comfortable working within Windows-based systems and standard business applications (Microsoft Office suite, etc.)
Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects independently in a fast-paced environment


Why Join HUB?


An exceptional, welcoming, and inclusive company culture
Excellent compensation, benefits, RRSP match, referral incentives, and company perks
Work flexibility
Paid educational training and vast learning opportunities
Room for advancement and growth within the organization
Paid day off for your birthday – we want to celebrate you!

Title: Reporting Analyst
Description:
Lynden Door in Lynden, WA has an immediate opening for a Reporting Analyst. At Lynden Door we strive to be a relational company that provides world class industry leading quality, value, service, and innovation.

Role Overview

The Reporting Analyst supports business leaders and core team members by maintaining costing, price guides and other sales tools, and by providing timely and accurate reporting and analysis of business operations. The Reporting Analyst will have the opportunity to build momentum in our ongoing transformation of data and enhancing our platforms and business processes.

Do you love turning raw numbers into decisions that actually move a business? We're looking for a Reporting Analyst to be a go-to person for pricing, costing, and performance data across our organization. If you are someone who is confident writing SQL queries and leveraging PowerBI, finds real satisfaction in clean data, performs reasoned analysis, and appreciates high-functioning excel-based business tools, read on!

Hours: Full-time, in-office, 8:00- 5:00 Monday to Friday.

Responsibilities


Perform margin and pricing analysis to support key business initiatives.
Own and maintain Costing Books alongside Estimating, Sales, and Purchasing.
Manage Residential price books — including deep-dive margin and price gap reviews.
Manage Commercial/Architectural Price Guides and multipliers.
Leverage Power BI to create and maintain production reporting.
Work with a broad range of stakeholders to understand and document their data needs.
Establish and maintain connections between data sources and solutions.
Employ reporting and data modeling best practices.
Partner with stakeholders across the company to understand and document their data needs.
Work with Production to build consistent costing methodologies for material, labor, and freight.
Surface margin performance trends tied to mix shifts and volume commitments.
Build ad-hoc reports and dig into data issues — researching root causes, correcting master data, and documenting solutions.
Maintain department KPIs and help evolve how the whole team experiences reporting.


What You Bring


Knowledge and experience writing SQL and leveraging PowerBI.
Strong organizational skills and sharp attention to detail.
A problem-solving, analytical mindset.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive data.
Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust across teams and cultures.
A collaborative, service-minded approach to work.


Role

What Makes This Role Rewarding for a Data-Minded Person:


You'll own the numbers that matter. From margin analysis to KPI tracking, your work shapes pricing strategy and business decisions — not just reporting after the fact.
Variety. Solving pricing puzzles, investigating data discrepancies, and translating findings into action across multiple business functions.
Excel is your playground. This role rewards advanced Excel skills — building, modeling, and collaborating at a level that goes well beyond most user's knowledge and ability.
Ad-hoc analysis means chasing down root causes, cleaning up master data, and documenting solutions that stick.
Cross-functional work. Partner with Estimating, Sales, Purchasing, and Production, giving you visibility into how data connects every part of the business.
You'll help shape how the company's platforms and reporting processes grow and improve — not just maintain the status quo.


Compensation And Benefits


Hourly Wage $25 - 32/Hr DOE
Medical/Dental/Vision insurance and Health Savings Accounts (HSA's) with employer contributions $500 - $1,500 annually
401(K) options including profit-share eligibility after 1 calendar year of employment.
8 Paid Holidays
2-3 Weeks Paid Time Off
Paid Bereavement Leave


More About Us

We are an equal opportunity employer and one of North America's leading manufacturers of quality residential and commercial interior wood doors. The great service and products we deliver are a result of the hard work and talent of our exceptional team. We work very hard to hire the best team members who share our core values in respect for all people, integrity in every situation, and quality in everything we do. A supportive team with diverse backgrounds and career experiences from all around the world strengthens who we are and provides many opportunities for continuous growth and development within our Company.

This job is Safety Sensitive and therefore is contingent upon a pre-employment drug test including marijuana. Additionally due to dealing with sensitive data and systems, a Criminal Background Check will be required for this role.

Description:
Description

Applications must have direct, hands-on experience with Yardi software to be considered.

The Systems and Data Analyst position performs advanced technical work developing and implementing solutions that support the Authority’s business strategy. This position serves as an all-tier support for the agencies Yardi system, including issue documentation, user account and access management, workflow support, and resolution of technical problems. The Analyst will triage, troubleshoot, and resolve software incident; support testing of updates and system changes; and debug reports, queries, and code.

Other Essential Functions Include But Are Not Limited To


Designing, developing, and maintaining operational and management reports, forms, letters, and statistical outputs; ensuring data accuracy through research, validation, and quality control.
Analyze and document business process and system workflows; evaluate system efficiency and ensure compatibility of in-house and SaaS applications.
Manage test environments and coordinate date refreshes.
Create, modify, and maintain SQL queries, scripts, reports, and data imports/exports; monitor system jobs and take corrective action as needed.
Develop and update software applications by converting specifications into code, compiling programs, and resolving errors.
Providing technical support for application and data-related issues; collaborate with IT team members to troubleshoot and resolve software, database, and system problems.
Work with end users to identify, document, and resolve root causes of system or process issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
Train end users and technical support staff on system functionality, workflow, and best practices.


Pay And Benefits

In compliance with the Equal Pay & Opportunities Act, the full salary range for the Systems and Data Analyst position is $85,020 to $127,530. Starting salary is determined by the required qualifications for the role and the candidate’s relevant experience. This is a full-time exempt position working primarily in office Monday through Friday.

We offer a generous contribution toward health care: 100% paid for employees’ only medical and vision coverage, 85% paid for dependent tier coverage. 100% paid for dental. Up to 26 days of accrued paid time off annually in the first year (13 vacation/13 sick days), and 12 paid holidays. This position is required to participate in Washington PERS (Public Employee Retirement Services).

Requirements

Knowledge and Attributes


Strong understanding of data administration and management functions, including data collection, analysis, and distribution.
Ability to improve system business processes using recognized process-improvement techniques.
Familiarity with modern database and information-system technologies.
Knowledge of program evaluation and outcome-based assessment methods.
Ability to work effectively with others, participate as a team member, communicate constructively, and navigate conflict professionally.
Skill in analyzing problems, identifying solutions, evaluating alternatives, and implementing recommendations aligned with organizational goals.
Ability to perform highly detailed work accurately and efficiently, organize tasks effectively, and work independently despite frequent interruptions.
Strong project-planning and organizational skills, with the ability to meet schedules and timelines and work with minimal direction.
Proficiency with data-analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL.
Experience with database-management systems.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Effective communication skills to explain complex or technical information to non-technical users.
Knowledge of modern office procedures, methods, and equipment, including computers and common word-processing and spreadsheet applications.

Technical skills


SQL (writing queries, joins, CTWs, optimization)
Microsoft Windows and Windows Server Operating Systems
Microsoft Azure
Cloud Platforms
Microsoft 365 Suite
Online Exchange
Windows Virtual Desktop
SharePoint
Networking and Security
System and Network Configuration
Virtualization
Backup and Disaster Recovery
Technical Documentation

Regulatory Knowledge
Security Best Practices

Customer Service

Problem Solving and Analytical Skills
Adaptability
Project Management and Organizational Skills


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree in a computer-related field, or MIS, or directly relevant experience can be considered in lieu of the required degree.
Four years of demonstrated related work experience. Experience with Microsoft with Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop; Exchange Online, Office 365; SharePoint, Azure Files Services; Azure Active Directory, Windows Service management, and document management and workflow automation software.
Experience administering local and cloud-based computer hardware and telecommunications functions is strongly preferred.
Extensive experience in Yardi required.


A combination of relevant education and experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the essential functions of the role may be considered in place of the stated requirements.

To be considered for this opportunity you must:


Complete the online application in its entirety.
Upload a cover letter that addresses how your experience qualifies you to perform the essential functions listed in the job announcement.
Upload a detailed resume of all educational and professional experience.


Final candidates must provide contact information for a direct supervisor to serve as a professional reference.

We do not discuss application status during the selection process.

Title: Data Analyst - API
Description:
Company Overview:

Lightspeed is the leading provider of cloud-based software for dealerships, serving the Powersport, Marine, RV, Trailer, and Golf Car industries adding hundreds of dealerships to the Lightspeed community each year.

Lightspeed’s Dealer Management Solution (DMS) enables dealerships to optimize their end-to-end business operations, including Sales, Parts, Service, Rentals, Payments, Accounting, and Customer Relationship Management (CRM). When implemented into their daily operations, Lightspeed helps dealers increase their profitability by selling more units, service, and parts, all while creating a more streamlined experience for customers.

Lightspeed is the most complete and integrated DMS in the industry with over 500 integrations with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), aftermarket parts and accessory distributors and dozens of other software tools that a dealership may use to run their business. Uniquely designed by dealers for dealers, and refined over the past 4 decades, Lightspeed empowers over 4,500+ dealers across North America with the tools and technology they need to manage their dealerships.

We are seeking a Data Analyst - API to maintain the API-based data integrations that connect Lightspeed's DMS platform with OEMs, aftermarket manufacturers, and internal teams. This individual will implement and support RESTful API integrations and reporting solutions, partnering closely with engineering, data platform, and cross-functional teams to keep dealer data flowing accurately across all Lightspeed data platforms.

This role has direct impact on dealer-facing data integrity: the integrations this person builds and maintains determine whether OEM programs, manufacturer data feeds, and dealer reporting are accurate and timely. The role combines hands-on API development with data analysis and reporting and requires close collaboration with internal and external technical stakeholders.

What You'll Do

API Development & Integration


Support and help maintain RESTful API integrations connecting Lightspeed's DMS platform to OEM systems, aftermarket manufacturer data feeds, and internal platforms.
Troubleshoot and resolve API connectivity, authentication, and data flow issues for internal and external clients, including OEM and dealer partners.
Document API integration specifications and data mappings for internal and partner-facing use.


Reporting & Data Solutions


Build and support customized reporting solutions using SQL (Microsoft and Postgres) and Power BI.
Perform data classification and validation to ensure accuracy and security across dealer and OEM datasets.


Client & Partner Support


Support internal and external client inbound requests related to API integrations and data feeds.
Collaborate with OEM and aftermarket manufacturer technical contacts to gather and validate integration requirements.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner with engineering, data platform, and product teams to meet diverse data requirements across sales, parts, service, rentals, and accounting modules.
Explore and adopt new tools and techniques across SQL, APIs, SSIS, and Power BI.


What You Should Have

Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Working knowledge of RESTful API design, development, and integration.
Proficiency with Microsoft SQL; familiarity with PostgreSQL.
Experience with Python, Node.JS, and/or SSIS for building data pipelines.
Exposure to dealer, franchise, or vertical SaaS business models, or strong interest in learning the dealer/OEM data ecosystem.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Power BI or SSRS reporting.
Prior experience integrating with OEM, manufacturer, or partner-facing APIs.
Interest in the Powersports, Marine, RV, Trailer, Outdoor Power Equipment, or Golf Cart industries.


Inclusion and Diversity at Lightspeed:

At Lightspeed, we celebrate the uniqueness of every individual and encourage diverse perspectives. We believe that inclusion drives innovation and fosters meaningful connections. We are committed to building an environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to make an impact.

Lightspeed is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. Important Note:

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.

Title: ICQA Data Analyst
Description:
Description

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst assigned to ICQA will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SoX requirements.

The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, you will be required to work autonomously, taking full control and responsibility for achieving business objectives. This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Key job responsibilities

Title: Database Reporting Specialist
Description:
The Montana State University Alumni Foundation is seeking an objective, detail-oriented Database Reporting Analyst to join our collaborative team in a flexible hybrid or remote role. In this position, you will be producing accurate, dependable data and meaningful insights that help strengthen lifelong relationships, support fundraising efforts, and advance the mission of Montana State University.

This opportunity is well suited for someone who values technical precision, thoughtful problem-solving, and the autonomy to improve processes and deliver trusted results. You will have the chance to apply your analytical expertise to work with a clear purpose, while contributing to a supportive team that values accuracy, sound judgment, continuous improvement, and the important role data plays in building relationships and inspiring private support.

Administrator: Director, Reporting & Analytics

Preferred Experience: 2+ years of experience in SQL programming and SQL Server databases; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Education Required: Baccalaureate Degree in computer science, computer engineering, information systems / technology, or related Degree with relevant experience.

Overtime Status: Exempt, not eligible for overtime

FTE and Benefits: 1.0 FTE, eligible for full employment benefits

Location: Remote or flexible hybrid schedule available.

Preferred Start Date: Sept 15, 2026

Major Duties And Responsibilities

The Database Reporting Analyst for the Montana State University Alumni Foundation (“Alumni Foundation”) is primarily responsible for fulfillment of targeted data and report requests from both external Montana State University (“University”) partners, and internal Alumni Foundation team members. The Database Reporting Analyst reports to the Director, Reporting & Analytics, Advancement Services Team.

Anticipated Distribution Of Time And Effort Are Outlined Below

30%

Manage and fulfill data and information requests from University partners and internal Alumni Foundation team members.

30%

Develop ad hoc and self-serve reports.

20%

Design/Maintain/Perform regular data extract, transform, and load operations (“ETL”) using SQL Server Integration Services (“SSIS”).

20%

Other duties including but not limited to: Business process development & SOPs Documentation. Assist in data hygiene and maintenance.

Specific Duties And Responsibilities


Assist with data and information requests (i.e. list requests) to external University partners and manage all request-related communications.
Assist with data and report requests by collaborating with other members of the Advancement Services team.
Provide quality assurance for reporting outputs by validating data accuracy, reviewing query logic, documenting assumptions, and ensuring appropriate handling of confidential constituent, donor, and institutional information.
Collaborate on reporting and integration-related work involving SQL Server, Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services, Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services, and other reporting or data tools used by the Alumni Foundation.
Develop, document, and disseminate targeted best practices and standard operating procedures (“SOP’s”) related to the fulfillment of targeted data and information requests from the Alumni Foundation database.
Support database management and data cleanup procedures by identifying data quality issues and recommending corrective actions.
Implement existing procedures and develop new SQL-based queries and procedures to fulfill targeted data requests, reporting needs, and data ETLs.
Utilize Visual Studio for various development tasks and integrating with SSRS projects.
Identify database-related improvement opportunities and collaborate with members of the Advancement Services team to develop and implement solutions.
Affect and maintain a professional, proactive, positive, highly collaborative, and performance-centric work environment.
Other duties, as assigned by the Director, Reporting & Analytics.


Duties and responsibilities may change at any time.

Special Skills And Qualifications


Understanding of and experience with the SQL Server query development and the Microsoft SQL Server/BI stack, including SSMS, Visual Studio Data Tools, SSRS, SSIS, complex joins, stored procedures, query validation, and performance considerations.
General programming and database administration experience helpful.
Experience developing documentation, SOPs, data definitions, reporting standards, and quality-control practices.
Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment while remaining helpful, pleasant, and courteous.
Complete respect for confidentiality and sound judgment in handling sensitive constituent, donor, institutional, and partner data.
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, analytical judgment, and commitment to data accuracy.
Experience developing and maintaining solutions using Microsoft Power Platform components (Power BI Desktop, Power Automate, and Power Apps) is a plus.


Benefits

The MSU Alumni Foundation offers a comprehensive benefit package which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance (all of which are 90-100% employer-paid for employee-only coverage), 403(b) retirement plan with 7% employer contribution after 1-yr anniversary, up to 5 weeks’ paid time-off, 11 paid holidays, tuition assistance and more.

Applications And Recruitment

Qualified candidates should submit a cover letter, a resume, and three professional references online. Recruitment will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. Compensation will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

The MSU Alumni Foundation is an equal employment opportunity employer who believes that diversity, equity and inclusion allow us to better serve our students and communities and are critical to supporting the mission of Montana State University as a land grant institution.

Title: Big Data Laser Analyst
Description:
Description -

Job Summary


We are seeking a highly analytical, business-oriented Data Analyst to support the Print Supplies business. In this role, you will translate consumer and enterprise print telemetry into trusted metrics, dashboards, and actionable insights, with a primary focus on laser printer data. You will partner closely with data engineers and data scientists to improve data reliability, define KPI and metric semantics, and influence cross-functional decisions through clear data storytelling.


Responsibilities


Own laser print telemetry business insights for the Print Supplies organization, from problem framing and metric definition through analysis, visualization, and executive-ready recommendations.
Partner with stakeholders to clarify goals, translate business questions into analytical requirements, define critical KPIs, and deliver insights that drive decisions.
Provide consultative support and ad hoc analyses with clear hypotheses, methods, and assumptions; produce reusable queries, datasets, and shareable outputs with documented limitations.
Collaborate with internal and external partners to align on telemetry instrumentation, data collection methodology, and platform differences to ensure consistent interpretation across printer platforms.
Investigate data quality issues (completeness, accuracy, timeliness), perform root-cause analysis across pipelines and sources, and communicate impacts and remediation paths with appropriate caveats.
Enable self-service analytics by documenting dashboards and KPI definitions, and coach users on correct interpretation and common pitfalls.
Design and maintain measurement frameworks (e.g., adoption, usage, retention, share, funnel/driver analyses); when applicable, support experiment or pre/post evaluation and interpret results for stakeholders.
Create clear narratives through written summaries, presentations, and recurring reporting that highlight trends, drivers, risks, and recommended actions for leadership and partner teams.
Provide guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members.
Solve difficult and complex problems with a fresh perspective, demonstrating good judgment in selecting creative solutions and managing projects independently.
Lead moderate to high complexity projects, delivering professionally written reports, and supports the realization of operational and strategic plans.


Education & Experience Recommended


Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, database management, statistical analysis, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.


Preferred Certifications


Programming Language/s Certification (SQL, Python, or similar)


Knowledge & Skills


Analytics: exploratory analysis, root-cause analysis, and KPI design
SQL: complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query performance optimization
Python (and/or PySpark) for analysis, data validation, and automation. Familiar with VSCode and Databricks Ideally
Ability to interpret telemetry and pipeline outputs in business context, including communicating uncertainty and known limitations
Comfort working across multiple data sources/layers and explaining differences in source-of-truth, grain, and transformations
Comfort with modern analytics tooling (including AI-assisted development) while maintaining reproducibility and reviewable outputs
Dashboarding & data visualization: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, advanced excel / PowerPoint or similar; ability to build stakeholder-ready reporting
Data quality and governance: profiling, anomaly detection, metric validation, and documentation
Strong documentation habits for metric definitions, data lineage, and stakeholder guidance; familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) a plus. Familiar with Jira and Confluence.
Applied statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, and basic experiment/pre-post evaluation


Cross-Org Skills


Effective Communication
Results Orientation
Learning Agility
Digital Fluency
Customer Centricity
Collaboration across technical and non-technical teams


Impact & Scope


Impacts function by providing analytics and data quality validation that supports business-critical reporting and stakeholder decision-making for laser telemetry KPIs
Serves as a key point of contact for laser telemetry interpretation and investigation requests, partnering across teams to drive consistent definitions and reliable use of outputs


Complexity


Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

The pay range for this role is $83,000 to $127,800 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Description:
A Little Bit About Us

Founded in Vancouver in 2016, FORM is the sports technology company behind the award-winning FORM Smart Swim Goggles. Since launching in 2019, our goggles have earned global recognition, including Red Dot, iF Design, and Global Triathlon awards, and are trusted by professional athletes, age-group triathletes, and swimmers looking to get better.

We're a talented, tight-knit team that's fun to work with and serious about building great products. Together, we bring decades of consumer product experience spanning sports eyewear, interface design, and activity-tracking algorithms.

To learn more, visit formswim.com

Position Overview

We're seeking an experienced Analytics Developer to strengthen FORM's analytics data foundation and business intelligence capabilities. Working primarily in SQL, dbt, Amazon Redshift and Tableau, you will transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce and financial data into trusted, reusable models and translate those models into clear, decision-ready dashboards and visualizations. This is a hands-on role for someone who can contribute quickly, take ownership of production work and leave well-tested, documented systems and intuitive reporting behind.

Primary Responsibilities


Build and maintain scalable SQL and dbt models in Amazon Redshift
Transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce, marketing and financial data into clean, reusable analytics datasets
Define and maintain consistent business metrics, including revenue, MRR, churn, retention, trial conversion, customer lifetime value and sales performance
Implement automated data-quality tests, documentation and lineage so stakeholders can trust and understand the data
Monitor scheduled analytics workflows, investigate failures and improve pipeline reliability
Develop and maintain Tableau data sources and dashboards using curated warehouse models
Build Python-based data integrations and automation where SQL and dbt are not the right tools
Improve Git-based development, code review, deployment and CI/CD practices for analytics
Partner with Analytics, Data Engineering and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable data products


Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications


3 - 5 years of experience in analytics development, data engineering or a highly technical analytics role
Advanced SQL skills and strong knowledge of dimensional data modelling
Hands-on experience building, testing and documenting production data models with dbt
Experience working with a cloud data warehouse; Amazon Redshift and AWS experience are preferred
Experience using Git, code review and software development practices in an analytics environment
Working proficiency in Python for data pipelines, integrations or automation
Experience with Tableau or another modern business intelligence platform
Ability to troubleshoot data issues across source systems, transformation pipelines and downstream reporting
Strong communication skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into clear, maintainable data solutions


Nice to Haves


Experience with Dagster, Airflow or another workflow orchestration platform
Experience with Fivetran or other managed data ingestion tools
Experience with subscription, ecommerce, product telemetry or financial data
Experience working in a fast-paced startup or consumer technology environment

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Number: R0243644

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data analyst like you to bring your knowledge to the Navy.

As a client-facing data analyst on our team, you’ll work closely with clients to understand their questions, conduct research, and develop metrics and strategies to guide enterprise-level software and hardware decisions. You will respond to data calls, combine information from multiple sources, and develop detailed analytical reports that can be clearly communicated to teammates, leadership, and stakeholders. You’ll build dashboards and data visualizations, automate repetitive tasks with scripts, and produce standardized reporting to support enterprise licensing, acquisition documentation, and ongoing program needs.

Work with us to help drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


4+ years of experience working with the DoW
2+ years of experience with data engineering in Databricks or Spark
2+ years of experience with Python, R, or SQL for data manipulation and analysis
2+ years of experience performing research, recommending strategies and performance metrics, and supporting business intelligence
Ability to be self-motivated and pay strict attention to detail
Secret clearance
Bachelor's degree



Nice If You Have:


Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, or Seaborn
Experience performing data science and predictive analytics using tools such as Pandas, Polars, Scikit-learn, MLFlow, Pytorch, or Tensorflow
Experience with federal procurement, including for enterprise software
Experience using Power Platform tools such as Canvas Apps and Power Automate
Knowledge of AI engineering
Databricks, Tableau, or Power BI Certification



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $61,900.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.


Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.

Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.



Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We’re looking for a curious, thoughtful Data Analyst who enjoys turning data into answers that people can actually use.




In this role, you’ll work with different teams to understand what’s happening in the business, dig into the numbers, and help people make better decisions. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working with data but also knows that good analysis is about more than spreadsheets—it’s about asking the right questions and explaining what the numbers mean.




You’ll have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, improve reporting and processes, and help the team see the bigger picture through data.




What You’ll Do




Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and areas that need attention.
Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and regular business insights.
Work with stakeholders to understand their questions and translate them into practical analysis.
Clean, organize, and validate data to make sure it is accurate and reliable.
Use SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools to explore and communicate findings.
Present your findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Work closely with teams across the business to support data-driven decisions.
Look for ways to improve existing reports, processes, and how we use data.
Take ownership of your work while asking questions when you need context or clarification.




What We’re Looking For




Experience working as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
Strong SQL and Excel skills.
Experience with a visualization or BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
Strong attention to detail and a practical approach to problem-solving.
The ability to explain complex information in a simple, clear way.
Good communication skills and the confidence to work with people across different teams.
A naturally curious mindset—you like to understand the “why” behind the numbers.
The ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.




Nice to Have

Experience with Python or another programming language used for data analysis.
Experience working with large or complex datasets.
Knowledge of statistics and basic analytical techniques.
Experience working with cloud data platforms or data warehouses.
Experience in our industry or with similar business problems.




What You Can Expect




You’ll be joining a team where your work will have a real impact. We value people who are willing to ask questions, share ideas, learn from others, and take ownership of their work.




We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. What matters to us is that you’re willing to learn, think critically, and care about doing good work.




If you enjoy working with data, solving real business problems, and helping people make sense of information, we’d love to hear from you.

Careers With Purpose

Sanford Health, the largest rural health system in the United States, is dedicated to transforming the health care experience and providing access to world-class health care in America’s heartland.

Location: Sioux Falls, SD

Weekly Hours: 40.00

Salary Range: $24.00 - $38.50

Pay Info: Pay starts at $24 and increases according to years of applicable experience.

Department Details

The Data Engineering team is a collaborative, fun and dynamic group. We strive to innovate and improve the process to bring quality data to our end users.

This role includes a significant emphasis on data engineering quality assurance, including validation of data pipelines, structured testing of data transformations, establishing data quality standards, and ongoing monitoring to ensure accurate and reliable analytics and reporting.

Job Summary

Perform data integration to and maintenance of applicable databases and supporting databases. Independently seek out additional information, knowledge and training to further understand the database system. Learn, understand and analyze process workflows within various functional areas to best understand improvements and associations, specifically with relation to data reporting, extraction and analytics. Design, develop, document, test and deploy custom reports, database smart queries and data exports. Must be knowledgeable and experienced using report writing tools and embrace new responsibilities and change associated with the database. Provide accurate information to support enterprise business, communication and fundraising decisions. Collect, organize, segment, analyze, validate and disseminate significant amounts of information to communicate performance as compared to identified key performance indicators.

Use database reporting environment and complex queries to develop and deploy standard, ad-hoc and custom reports, communications and dashboards in a manner suitable to those receiving it, including both internal and external recipients. Establish and implement processes, including potential automation, to streamline the extraction of data that results in accurate, user-friendly reports, analytics and mass communications. Identify, analyze, research and interpret trends or patterns within complex data sets to provide recommendations and possible solutions. Use logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions that translate to performance measurement, improvement and outcomes.

Use appeal information to monitor and analyze return on investment of various communication activities, including events, mailings and digital communications. Utilize outside sources, including social media and digital analytics, to monitor online engagement and marketing performance. Assist foundation leadership in creating and executing the data management strategy, making recommendations to improve data flow, availability and quality. Work closely with all areas of the organization to develop an understanding of business requirements and goals to provide best service. Proactively seek improvement and monitor feedback to make recommendations for information system modifications needed to support effective and accurate reporting and analysis for the organization.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree required. In lieu of education, leadership may accept six years of applicable experience.

Previous experience of two or more years in business, finance, data science, statistics, information management, analytics, fundraising or related field is preferred. Previous experience operating reporting and analytic tools preferred.

The Data Services Analyst delivers custom data solutions that help DMSi customers maximize the value from their ERP solution. This role works across a broad and growing set of technologies, including custom reporting, business intelligence dashboards, data transformations, and system integrations. The right candidate is execution-focused, intellectually curious, and eager to grow alongside an expanding technology stack. They will bring a strong aptitude for problem-solving, a collaborative mindset, and a genuine interest in using AI tools to work smarter and help the team build more efficient workflows.


RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

  1. Evaluate and manage customer requests using internal systems, including the ability to scope, quote, design a solution, and execute on the project plan.
  2. Develop and deliver custom data solutions, including report writing, data extractions, forms customization, business intelligence dashboards, and system integrations.
  3. Use AI tools and assistants as a standard part of daily work to increase efficiency and contribute to the team’s development of AI-assisted workflows and internal tooling
  4. Build proficiency in DMSi’s evolving product and integration ecosystem, including current and emerging platforms.
  5. Develop and maintain an advanced working knowledge of DMSi’s internal support tools and delivery processes.
  6. Assist other DMSi personnel through escalation support, coaching, and training on data-related topics.
  7. Complete documentation related to job responsibilities and contribute to the DMSi Knowledge Base.
  8. Lead, attend, or assist with training for internal personnel, customers, and prospects.
  9. Assist with internal projects to support departmental and organizational objectives.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

Technical: SQL/query proficiency (Cyberquery a plus), BI tools (Power BI, Phocas, Tableau, etc.), ETL/data lineage and database fundamentals (schemas, indexes, keys).

Analytical: Genuine curiosity paired with strong problem-solving, research, and the ability to work independently through ambiguous business challenges.

AI-forward: Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, Copilot) to speed up and improve work quality.

Quality-focused: High attention to detail, diagnoses issues correctly and validates solutions before customers see them.

Technical collaboration: Familiar with integration/automation (Workato or similar), comfortable with code reviews and tools like GitHub.

Execution: Prioritizes well, works under pressure, hits deadlines.

People skills: Communicates clearly, builds relationships across all levels (including customers/vendors), exercises tact and keeps confidentiality.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

College degree in Data Science, Computer Information Systems (CIS), Management Information Systems (MIS), Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related discipline preferred; 3-5 years of equivalent work experience in a relevant field will be considered.


WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Normal office environment with use of computers and telephone systems; no unusual physical demands.

Travel as needed, including business air travel and car rental.

Title: Data Analyst, Mid
Description:
Job Number: R0246792

Data Analyst, Mid

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good. We need a data analyst like you to bring your knowledge to support Navy Fleet readiness.

As a client-facing data analyst on our Navy Supply Operations team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on education, resources, trainings, and policies to ensure sailors receive proper awareness to form career-forwarding decisions.

Work with us to help drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:


5+ years of experience in a professional work environment
Experience presenting data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using databases and scripting languages
Experience preparing customer data for models, including merging and aggregating data, handling anomalies, balancing, and feature selection
Experience establishing quantitative and qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive technical outcomes
Experience applying data visualization through different formats such as graphs, tables, and PowerPoint slides
Ability to research, develop, and test data methodologies
Ability to support client and stakeholder relationships, conceptualize directions, analyze trends, and develop justifications for Navy leadership decisions
Ability to contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making by applying communications, validation, and research to simplify technical requirements and trends for varied audiences
Secret clearance
HS diploma or GED



Nice If You Have:


Knowledge of building and maintaining workflows, visualizations, and other Premium Microsoft Services databases in the Microsoft enclaves and ADVANA, Jupiter, or BOLT enclave, including Databricks, Qlik, Tableau, and Power BI
Bachelor's degree



Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $61,900.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.


Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.



Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Title: Analyst, Business Analysis
Description:
The Opportunity

Are you someone who loves uncovering insights hidden in data? We’re looking for an Analyst, Business Analysis to join our Finance team within Insurance Services. In this role, you’ll collaborate with teams across AMA to turn complex information into meaningful insights that help guide sound business decisions. You’ll analyze trends, process and products, and bring clarity to big questions — all while helping us make smarter, data-driven choices that serve our members better. In this role, you will also be supporting the corporate reserving function, to support informed business decisions across pricing, underwriting, reinsurance, and capital management.

A Place to Belong

AMA is more than a workplace; it’s a family. Together, we help protect the things that matter most to our more than one-million members—everything from roadside safety to retail savings, food security to childhood well-being. And with operations that span automotive, registries, travel, insurance and more, the opportunities to grow with us are almost limitless!

About

Building on a century of proud service in Alberta communities, we’re passionate about making a meaningful difference in the places where we live and work. And that all begins with our people. As part of the AMA team, you’ll enjoy:


Competitive salary and flexible benefits
Employer-paid retirement savings program
Employee-exclusive discounts on travel, insurance, memberships, and more
Free travel medical insurance for you and your immediate family
Ongoing professional development
Paid vacation and personal days, including a Volunteer Day and Me Day
Flexible work models that make sense for your lifestyle


Who You Are


A curious, analytical thinker who loves solving complex problems with data.
A strong communicator who can translate numbers into meaningful business stories.
Naturally collaborative — you enjoy working across teams to find solutions that make an impact.
Detail-oriented, organized, and confident managing multiple priorities.
You thrive in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment where innovation and teamwork drive results.


How You’ll Make An Impact


Provide data-driven support to guide action-oriented business decisions across AMA.
Analyze and interpret data from multiple sources to identify key trends and opportunities.
Develop and manage high-quality dashboards and reporting solutions that serve as a single source of truth.
Work closely with internal stakeholders and IT teams to gather, validate, and refine business requirements.
Present findings and insights to leadership teams in clear, compelling ways.
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timely delivery of critical data.
Support the rollout of new business analytics tools and processes.


What You Bring To The Table


Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in actuarial analysis, business intelligence, business analysis, or a related technical role.
Advanced working knowledge of SQL (including complex query writing).
Experience developing and managing BI solutions or dashboards using Power BI or similar tools.
Strong data visualization and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex information.
Familiarity with data management languages (Python, R) and experience in the insurance industry are strong assets.
Experience in the insurance industry is preferred.
Actuarial reserving experience would be an asset.


Belonging Matters Here

AMA is committed to providing an inclusive, respectful, and accessible environment. If you require an accommodation at any time during our recruitment process, please contact recruitment@ama.ab.ca. We’ll work with you to ensure you feel supported throughout your journey with us.

Work Model

Hybrid

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Data Scientist

Department: Winnipeg Police Service

Salary: $3,977.94 - $4,812.58 bi-weekly

Providing a wide range of services to over half of all Manitobans, The City of Winnipeg is one of the largest employers in Manitoba. We provide a comprehensive range of benefits and career opportunities to our employees. These include competitive salaries, employer-paid benefits, dental and vision care, pension plans, and maternity/parental leave programs. Additionally, we offer education, training, and staff development opportunities to ensure that our employees are equipped with the necessary skills to advance in their careers.

Our Benefits web page provides detailed information about the benefits we offer, and we encourage you to visit it for further information at City of Winnipeg Benefits . The City is committed to attracting and retaining a diverse, skilled workforce that is representative and reflective of the community we serve. Requests for Reasonable Accommodation will be accepted during the hiring process.

Preference to internal applicants may be applied.

Job Profile

Under the general direction of the Senior Data Scientist, the Data Scientist is responsible for conducting large-scale and targeted statistical data analysis to identify trends and deliver, reports to both management and project stakeholders.

The Data Scientist leads the design, implementation, and integration of complex data systems and sources, oversees the development of advanced analytics models, and creates interactive dashboards and visualizations to support operational and strategic decision-making.

Leveraging deep knowledge of industry best practices and providing subject matter expertise, the Data Scientist fosters a data-driven culture and strengthens the organization's ability to accurately collect, analyze, and deliver actionable insights to support informed decision-making.

In the absence of the Senior Data Scientist, the Data Scientist may assume temporary oversite responsibilities of the section.

As a Data Scientist You Will


Conduct large-scale and targeted statistical data analysis to identify trends, support critical decision making, and for reporting to both management and project participants.
Lead the development, implementation, and integration of new and existing data sources, applications and reporting mediums.
Contribute subject matter expertise to promote a data culture within the organization and enhance organization-wide capacity for accurately collecting, analyzing, and acting on data.
Research and apply best data science practices to ensure accurate, efficient and scalable solutions aligned with industry standards and business goals.
Other duties as assigned


Your Education And Qualifications Include


Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Statistics or related field.
Certificate in Business Intelligence is an asset.
Master's Degree is an asset.
Minimum 48 months progressive experience in:
SQL, RStudio, and/or Python
Statistical Analysis System (SAS), Statistical Package for Social Sciences (SPSS), or other equivalent tools
Data analytics, interpretation of data and statistical modelling
Minimum 48 months experience with databases, performing Extract/Transform/Load (ETL) from various data sources, and data warehousing integration including organizing, compiling, manipulating, analyzing and summarizing large datasets.
Experience with Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning or Neural Networks is an asset.
Knowledge of operational process asset management principles and practices and ability to integrate data science for the effective and efficient use within the Service's investment planning process.
Knowledge of project management principles and the ability to manage multiple projects and coordinate and facilitate activities as assigned.
Knowledgeable in utilizing data repositories and integrating open-source programming and tools to address specific requirements.
Practical experience with graphic design principles for Power BI dashboard creation.
Skilled in using business intelligence platforms and tools such as Power BI SAS, SPSS, Power Query, and Data Analysis Expressions (DAX).
Proficient in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geospatial and Location Intelligence (GLI), including cartography and mapping techniques.
Demonstrated advanced level proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.
Demonstrated ability in data collection, writing summaries, and visualizing data.
Proven history of advising senior leadership and driving efficiency and improvement through innovative solutions and successful project execution .
Ability to conduct research, analyze complex issues and make recommendations based on sound judgement.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent organizational abilities with a proactive, initiative-driven approach.
Strong ability to multi-task and perform effectively under time constraints.
Excellent oral and written communication skills , and the ability to present research findings effectively to varying audiences.
Demonstrated interpersonal skills and the ability to work cooperatively, collaboratively, and professionally with fellow employees at all levels, consultants and external stakeholders.
Ability to work independently and build and maintain relationships with the team and others within the organization
Ability to maintain a continuous learning attitude.
Ability to establish and manage effective partnerships and agreements with a wide variety of community/business groups, agencies, associations and civic departments.
The ability to establish and maintain a positive, respectful, safe and healthy work environment that supports the physical, psychological and social working relationships with members at all levels in a team environment.

As the Data Analyst, ReBIRD, your expertise in analysis and data-driven insights supports key decisions on product service, repair, and long-term strategy. Reporting to the Senior Data Analyst, ReBIRD you will work closely with cross-functional partners of the ReBIRD program to deliver a best-in-class guest experience that extends the lifecycle of Arc’teryx products. You are a driven professional focused on creating a data-driven culture and enabling decision makers in the short- and long-term strategy to deliver on a best-in-class guest experience.




This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.






Meet Your Future Team:




Under the Circularity umbrella, the ReBIRD team supports the operations of our warranty and repairs program, our service centers within retail, and resale.  The global ReBIRD program focuses on an exceptional Guest experience at all Commercial touchpoints, inclusive of Guest Services, After Sales, Branded activations, and especially within our owned Vertical channels, Retail and eCommerce. 







If you were in the Data Analyst, ReBIRD role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:


Performing data manipulation and analysis to support key performance metrics across the service and repair network


Maintaining recurring forecasts and supporting the development of new forecasting techniques


Building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI including troubleshooting and debugging errors, refreshing, and publishing data


Gathering business requirements and translating them into data requirements and specifications


Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Business Intelligence, Technology, Design, Quality Control, and Supply Chain; representing company needs in after-sales returns and service and working on projects to enable informed decision making


Improving data through research and analysis of product returns and trends in support of product insights and design teams


Understanding and teaching others about global service delivery systems and processes in relation to regional differences and constraints for reporting visibility





Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:





Supporting the creation and reporting of sustainability metrics and measuring the impact of the service and repair program, in partnership with our Sustainability team


Contributing to the evolution of data tools across the business, providing subject matter expertise in future development of data platforms


Integrating APAC regions into greater data analytics work to better inform global ReBIRD analytics


Incorporating raw material data to support forecasting, ordering, managing, and fulfillment






Are you our next Data Analyst, ReBIRD?



You have a Bachelor’s Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Finance, Business or a related field


You have 3+ years' experience synthesizing complex analysis into actionable insights and presenting insights to senior leaders


You have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to summarize and express ideas clearly through visualizations, written documents and presentations


You have extensive experience in data visualization and analysis software (e.g. Power BI, Excel, Tableau, SQL, etc.)


You have experience with data manipulation and management including ETL, user provisioning, and Power BI service management


You have experience balancing customer focus with long-term strategic goals and operational constraints, and you take initiative in documenting and presenting opportunities for improvement


You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions.


You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity.


Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it.


You are able and willing to travel as required

Most new team members join between the start and midpoint of the range, where you can contribute right away while continuing to grow your craft, your collaborations, and your impact at Arc’teryx.
