Title: Duomenų mokslo analitikas (-ė)
Description:
„IKI“ – tai vieta, kur žmonės, nepriklausomai nuo to, ar dirba biure, parduotuvėse, gamyboje ar logistikoje, aistrą pirmauti verčia ambicingais pasiekimais! Pirmieji Lietuvoje pristatėme prancūziškus kruasanus ir bagetes, atidarėme autonominę parduotuvę, įdiegėme savitarnos kasas ir elektronines kainų etiketes. Šie žingsniai atspindi mūsų nuolatinį siekį būti žingsniu priekyje ir kurti ateities mažmeninę prekybą – inovatyvią bei tvarią. Jei ieškai dinamiškos, idėjoms atviros aplinkos, kurioje galėtum augti ir kurti naujoves, gali būti, kad darbas „IKI“ yra arčiau tavęs!

Šiame darbe tu:


Kursi, diegsi ir prižiūrėsi statistinius modelius, prognozavimo algoritmus bei mašininio mokymosi sprendimus.
Analizuosi verslo eksperimentų (A/B testų, pilotinių projektų) rezultatus ir vertinsi jų poveikį verslo rodikliams.
Automatizuosi analitinius procesus.
Vizualizuosi analizės rezultatus, rengsi įžvalgas ir rekomendacijas, padedančias priimti duomenimis grįstus verslo sprendimus.
Bendradarbiausi su IT, prekybos, rinkodaros, tiekimo grandinės ir logistikos komandomis, ieškant galimybių gerinti veiklos rezultatus pasitelkiant duomenų analitiką.
Nagrinėsi struktūrizuotus ir nestruktūrizuotus duomenis, identifikuosi tendencijas, dėsningumus bei priežastinius ryšius.
Prisidėsi prie analitikos metodikų, standartų ir gerųjų praktikų kūrimo bei jų diegimo organizacijoje.


Tikimės, kad tu:


Turi universitetinį išsilavinimą tiksliųjų mokslų srityje (matematikos, informatikos, ekonomikos, fizikos ir kt.)
Turi ne mažesnę kaip 2 metų patirtį dirbant duomenų mokslo, analitikos srityje
Turi gerus Python, SQL ir Excel įgūdžius
Puikiai bendrauji anglų kalba
Gebi savarankiškai vykdyti analizės projektus – nuo verslo problemos identifikavimo iki sprendimo rekomendacijų pateikimo


„IKI“ pasiūlymas tau:

Atlyginimas ir finansinė gerovė


atlyginimas: 2800 – 3800 €/mėn. (neatskaičius mokesčių, priklausomai nuo tavo patirties ir įgūdžių),
galėsi pigiau apsipirkti „IKI“ prekybos centruose,
turėsi nuolaidas „IKI“ asortimento naujienoms,
daugiau nei 300 MELP ir partnerių nuolaidų kone visiems gyvenimo atvejams.  


Darbo aplinka ir lankstumas


hibridinis darbo modelis: galimybė dirbti patogiame „IKI“ biure arba namuose,
lankstumas pasirenkant darbo valandas,
įkvėpimui – darbostogos iki 30 d. per metus.


Karjera ir tobulėjimas


karjeros galimybės (tiek Lietuvoje, tiek užsienyje),
profesinio tobulėjimo galimybės (tiek su kolegomis, tiek ir individualiai).


Sveikata ir emocinė gerovė


papildomas sveikatos draudimas, kurį galėsi rinktis net iš 3 planų,
nemokamos sveikatos patikros biure,
dalyvavimas „Walk15“, vidinėse badmintono, dviračių, žygių mėgėjų sporto grupėse,
streso valdymo ir kiti emocinės gerovės mokymai, galimybė gauti anonimines psichologo konsultacijas telefonu.     


Stipri bendruomenė


stiprybėmis grįsta kultūra, kurioje vertinamos visų darbuotojų unikalios savybės ir pasiekimai,
kolegas pagal laisvalaikio veiklas kviečiame burtis į „Hobby Spotlight” klubus,
darbuotojų fondas „VeIKIme drauge“,
esame aktyvūs bendruomenės nariai – savanoriaudami ir finansine parama prisidedame prie „Maisto banko“ ir kitų organizacijų.  


Inovacijos ir dinamiškumas


modernūs darbo įrankiai ir programos,
inovatyvūs sprendimai prekyboje, tvarumo ir kitose srityse,
mūsų komandos projektus ir pasiekimus kviečiame pažinti čia: Tvarumas | IKI. Arčiau Tavęs!


Skamba kaip darbas arčiau tavęs ir tavo tikslų?

Pasidalink savo CV arba susisiek su mūsų atrankų specialiste Vilte, telefonu +370 658 99876 arba LinkedIn platformoje.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
OBDeleven is all about making car tech easy and accessible for everyone. For over 10 years, we've been building powerful yet simple diagnostic and customization tools for car enthusiasts worldwide.

As we continue to grow the OBDeleven ecosystem, we're looking for a Data Analyst who will help us turn data into insights, support better business decisions and uncover opportunities to improve our products and customer experience.

This is not a role focused only on reporting. You'll work with data across different areas of the business, partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering and other teams, and help turn complex questions and data into clear, actionable recommendations.

What You'll Do


Analyse customer, product and business data to support better business and product decisions
Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports and ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions
Define, monitor and improve KPIs and maintain clear metric definitions
Analyse funnels, cohorts, retention, segmentation and trends to identify opportunities and investigate anomalies
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
Evaluate business initiatives, product features and experiments and help measure their impact
Validate data quality, identify gaps and work with engineers to improve data pipelines and documentation
Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Engineering and other teams to understand their needs and deliver meaningful insights
Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and contribute to a culture of data-driven decision-making


We expect


2-3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Marketing Analytics, BI or a related field
Strong hands-on SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries and window functions
Experience analysing customer, business, operational or product data
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports using a BI or data visualisation tool
Good understanding of analytical methods such as funnel, cohort, retention/churn, segmentation and trend analysis
Ability to turn business questions into structured analyses and clear, actionable recommendations
Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Ability to work independently, take ownership and collaborate effectively with different teams
Experience with Python, A/B testing, product analytics or cloud data platforms would be considered an advantage
Fluency in Lithuanian and full professional proficiency in English


Here's what we offer:


Fair pay for bold work: We reward your expertise with competitive pay that grows as you do
Hybrid Work Flexibility: Work 3 days in the office and 2 days from home or wherever suits you best.
Focus on your well-being: Choose your comprehensive health plan, get paid days off to care for yourself and your family, and enjoy flexible working hours, as well as your birthday day off.
More time that truly counts: Enjoy a 4-day workweek for one month a year, depending on how well the company hits its goals. Plus, earn an additional vacation day for every working year with us - up to 4 extra days
Real learning opportunities: Grow your skills with a 2% gross salary learning budget. Take your monthly paid self-learning day and improve stress-free.
Culture that connects: Enjoy Friday lunches on us, team buildings, company parties, and all the usual office perks like snacks, a cozy lounge, sport communities, and more.
Environment for real impact: Got an idea that'll make OBDeleven better? Share it, get feedback, fine-tune, and take action. We trust expertise and value ownership.


Salary range

Gross salary in a range: 2800 - 4500€ / month. The salary range is flexible, and we're open to discussing your expectations based on your experience and competencies.

Title: Data Reporting Analyst
Description:
Job Title:

Data Reporting Analyst

Contract Type:

Time Type:

Full time

Job Description:

The Data Reporting Analyst is responsible for ensuring the quality, consistency, and analytical value of trading and financial data used by the Controlling and Accounting functions. The role supports Trading Controllers and business stakeholders through the development of robust reporting solutions, reconciliation analysis, dashboard creation, and data governance activities.

Acting as a key link between Controlling, Accounting, Risk, Trade Support, and IT teams, the incumbent ensures that business data is accurately mapped, validated, and transformed into actionable insights that support financial performance monitoring and decision-making. The role contributes to continuous improvement initiatives through the automation of reporting processes, enhancement of data quality controls, and implementation of analytical tools that improve the visibility of desk profitability, balance sheet positions, and cash flow performance.

The successful candidate combines strong financial acumen with advanced analytical and reporting capabilities, enabling the organization to move from historical reporting toward forward-looking analysis and enhanced business intelligence.

Main Responsibilities

Data Accuracy & Mapping


Collaborate with the Trading Data Reporting Analyst to verify and maintain accurate mappings.
Ensure correct data classification and structure to support precise analysis.



Report Generation & Dashboard Development


Create detailed reports using data from various sources to provide stakeholders with key insights into performance metrics.
Develop interactive dashboards to detect and correct data discrepancies, particularly in:
Desk performance and analytical dimensions view
Desk balance sheet view
Desk cash flow (CF) view

Data Analysis & Reporting


Conduct in-depth analysis of trading data to support decision-making and identify potential improvements.
Provide regular reports on trading data accuracy and mapping, including:
Daily PnL estimation – ensure accuracy and highlight significant movements.
Monthly and year-to-date (MtD & YTD) trading reconciliation – review and explain variations by nature, cost structure, cut-off points, trends, volumes, and counterparties.

Process Documentation & Improvement


Document existing workflows to enhance process visibility and identify optimization opportunities.
Recommend and implement process improvements to streamline data reporting.



Ad-hoc Tasks & Support


Assist with various ad-hoc requests aligned with Trading Controller (TC) goals, targets, and performance initiatives.
Provide replacement for another team member in case of temporary absence (incl. vacation, sickness, business trip, etc.).



Profile


Financial reporting, controlling, management accounting, or business analytics.
Data analysis and reporting within commodities trading, financial services, banking, energy, or related industries.
Proven experience reconciling and analyzing P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow information.
Experience working with large datasets from multiple source systems and ensuring data integrity and consistency.
Strong understanding of reporting processes, financial controls, and performance measurement methodologies.



If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!

Our people make all the difference in our success.

Title: Klientu datu analītiķis/-e
HTML:
Katru nedēļu mūsu klienti veic vairāk nekā 3 miljonus darījumu 300+ veikalos un tiešsaistes tirdzniecības vietnēs visās Baltijas valstīs. To atbalsta vairāk nekā 12 000 darbinieki un gadā veido vairāk nekā miljardu eiro ienākumus. Mēs izmantojam šo bagātīgo datu avotu, lai attīstītu izpratni, kas ļauj mums būt klientu orientētiem, tā arī mēs redzam mūsu darba rezultātus uzlaboto lēmumu pieņemšanā un klientu pieredzē ikdienā.

Mēs meklējam jaunu komandas biedru, lai pievienotos Klientu pieredzes komandai un atbalstītu klientu izpratnes attīstību mārketinga komandām. Kā Klientu Datu Analītiķis, Tev būs iespēja strādāt ar vienu no lielākajiem klientu bāzēm Baltijā, sniedzot izpratni par dažādām jautājumu jomām, sākot no "kā mēs vislabāk sazināmies ar klientiem?" līdz "kādas darbības mums jāveic, lai uzlabotu klientu apmierinātību?", izmantojot datus, kas tiek ģenerēti visos klientu saskares punktos (veikalā, tiešsaistē, lietotnē, e-pastā utt.). Turklāt kopā ar mūsu Datu zinātnes komandu Tev būs iespēja strādāt pie uzlabotiem analītiskiem modeļiem, izmantojot mašīnmācīšanās tehnikas.

Ja Tev ir svarīgi:

  • Strādāt vienā no vadošajiem pārtikas mazumtirgotājiem Baltijā;
  • Strādāt ar īstiem, bagātīgiem datiem Baltijas mērogā un pētīt pircēju paradumus;
  • Nepārtrauktas attīstības iespējas strauji mainīgajā mazumtirdzniecības vidē;
  • Piedalīties darbinieku attīstības un apmācību programmās;
  • Izbaudīt kompetento un profesionālo atbalstu draudzīgā darba vidē;
  • Konkurētspējīgs atalgojums, veselības apdrošināšana pēc pirmā mēneša, sporta zāle birojā, mūsdienīgs un ergonomisks birojs, un citi darbinieku bonusi.

Tavā atbildībā ietilps:

  • Būt vēstniekam par mūsu klientu datu izmantošanu, proaktīvi sniegt ieskatus un izstrādāt lietotājam draudzīgus ziņojumus un analītiskus rīkus;
  • Ievākt, strukturēt un analizēt iekšējos un ārējos datus, lai veicinātu efektīvu lēmumu pieņemšanu, apkopojot datus saprotamā un veiksmīgā formātā;
  • Informēt vadību un ieinteresētās personas par ieskatiem;
  • Būt atbildīgam par klientu saistīto uzņēmējdarbības rādītāju novērtēšanu un priekšlikumu izteikšanu, lai tos uzlabotu;
  • Atbalstīt un konsultēt vadītājus un komandas locekļus par datu izmantošanu un secinājumu veidošanu;
  • Piedalīties liela mēroga Rimi projektos, pārstāvot analītisko kompetenci;
  • Pastāvīgi uzlabot un ieviest jaunas analītiskās metodes organizācijā.

Tu esi ideālais kandidāts, ja:

  • Miljoniem rindu datu apstrāde Tevi padara laimīgu;
  • Tev ir augstākā izglītība un/vai vairāku gadu pieredze analītikā, biznesa inteliģencē vai līdzīgos laukos;
  • Tev ir labas prasmes darbā ar MS Excel;
  • Tev ir pieredze datu iegūšanā no relāciju datu bāzēm (piemēram, SQL);
  • Tev ir pieredze ar programmēšanas valodām (Python, R);
  • Ļoti labas latviešu un labas angļu valodas zināšanas (angļu valodas zināšanas nepieciešamas darbam ar kolēģiem Baltijā, sistēmām un programmām);
  • Tev ir izteiktas analītiskās prasmes, un strādā kārtīgi un strukturēti;
  • Tev ir pozitīva personība ar stratēģisku skatu, fokusējoties uz risinājumiem un rezultātiem;
  • Tu spēj strādāt elastīgā vidē un pielāgoties izmaiņām.

Bonusa punkti, ja Tev ir pieredze ar:

  • Biznesa inteliģences rīkiem (Power BI / SAP Business Objects / SAP BW vai citiem);
  • Google Analytics;
  • Darbu mazumtirdzniecības nozarē vai klientu datu analītikā.

Atalgojums no 2300 - 2900 EUR mēnesī pirms nodokļu nomaksas. Atalgojuma piedāvājums tiks izvērtēts, balstoties uz kandidāta kompetenču, pieredzes un prasmju novērtējumu atbilstoši amata prasībām.

Pateicamies par Tavu interesi mūsu vakancē!

SIA Rimi Baltic, Reģistrācijas numurs 40003592957

Rimi Latvia ir viens no vadošajiem pārtikas mazumtirdzniecības uzņēmumiem valstī. Šobrīd pircējiem visā Latvijā ir atvērti vairāk nekā 140 Rimi veikali. Rimi Latvia strādā vairāk kā 5 000 darbinieku.

Title: BI Analyst
Description:
Position: BI Analyst (Tableau & Revenue Operations)

Location: On site (Larnaca or Limassol)

Department: Data & Analytics




About Us

Our company is a leading provider of cloud contact center solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Our innovative platform offers a full range of features and capabilities, including intelligent routing, IVR, call recording, analytics, and more. We are growing rapidly and expanding our global footprint, and we are looking for a talented Sales professionals to help us expand our client base.




Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive BI Analyst to become the core owner of our Tableau ecosystem. Our organization is heavily sales-driven, meaning your work with data will directly impact our revenue growth. You will be responsible for building high-quality interactive dashboards, managing our Tableau Server, and working closely with the Revenue team to track the sales pipeline and conversion rates.




The ideal candidate is someone who is technically skilled in Tableau and SQL but also has the "business curiosity" to understand how our operations works and where we can improve.




Key Responsibilities

1. Tableau Development & Admin

Dashboarding: Create functional, interactive, and visually polished dashboards in Tableau that stakeholders actually enjoy using.
Server Maintenance: Manage Tableau Server (handling user access, permissions, and organizing the project structure).
Data Freshness: Manage and monitor Tableau Extracts and subscriptions to ensure data is always up-to-date and accurate.

2. Sales & Revenue Support

Funnel Analysis: Build and maintain reports on sales pipeline, conversion stages, and lead velocity.
Ad-hoc Reporting: Provide quick, accurate data insights using Excel or Tableau to support urgent business decisions.
Proactivity: Don’t just build what is asked — analyze the data and suggest where the business might be missing opportunities.

3. Collaboration & Processes

Requirements Gathering: Communicate with business users to understand their needs and turn them into clear technical requirements.
Data Pipeline: Coordinate with data engineers to explain what datasets you need to build the best possible dashboards.




Requirements

Experience: 2–4 years of experience in BI or Data Analytics.
Tableau Stack: Proficiency in Tableau Desktop (LODs, Parameters, Sets) and experience with Tableau Server administration.
SQL: Solid ability to write queries to extract and transform data.
Excel: Advanced user (Pivot tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).
Business Mindset: Understanding of basic sales metrics (Pipeline, Conversion, Win Rate, Churn, MRR).
Language: Professional working proficiency in English.




Nice to have:

Python: Basic scripting for data tasks.
Statistics: Understanding of core statistical concepts.
Vibe Stack: Cursor for development, n8n for workflow automation, and an understanding of how to prompt/deploy AI agents for data tasks.




Key Competencies

Attention to detail: You double-check your numbers before showing them to the manager.
Organization: You can manage multiple requests without losing track of priorities.
Communication: You can explain "what the data says" to someone who isn't a data person.




What We Offer:

Play a crucial role in growing our product.
Attractive compensation and benefits.
Top-notch work gear.
Embrace a flexible hybrid work model.
Free lunch and healthy snacks every day.
Medical insurance.
A team of talented and fun colleagues from different countries.




At Voiso, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all team members.

Title: Quantitative Data Analyst in Credit Risk Model Validation | SEB, Vilnius
Description:
SEB is a leading northern European financial services group with a high focus on risk identification, measurement, monitoring, and governance. Banking is transforming at pace, our talented and rapidly expanding quant team is committed to innovation, excellence, and fostering a strong risk culture. Does that sound like a fit for you?

What You Will Be Doing

You will be a part of a professional team within SEB Group CRO organization that ensures quality of models used for measuring credit risk. We conduct in-depth reviews of the models to ensure quality performance by assessing model design and modelling methodologies, performance from the statistical point of view, data quality, implementation, regulatory compliance, and usage.

We work closely with model developers, owners, users, management and other key stakeholders to provide insights and recommendations.

As a Quantitative Data Analyst your primary focus will be on retrieving, preparing, analysing, and interpreting data used throughout the validation process. You will help ensure data quality through structured DQ checks, reconciliations, and standardised datasets, while contributing to consistent data definitions, metadata management, and well‑documented data usage. Alongside analytical work, you will support the development of validation infrastructure by contributing to automation, reusable functions, reporting templates, and coding standards. You’ll be empowered to introduce new validation tools or enhance existing ones, driving innovation and efficiency. Work will be organized in small, project-driven sub-teams within a fast-paced and supportive environment that fosters creativity, autonomy, and professional growth.

The team is located in Vilnius, but you will work in close interaction with the experienced professionals in SEB Group CRO organization across Nordic and Baltic countries.

As a Quantitative Data Analyst, you will be responsible for:


Developing methodologies and advanced tools to improve model review process
Build, maintain and standardize validation datasets ensuring consistent variable definitions and filters across portfolios. Support validation sample preparation under time constraints.
Design and implement automated DQ checks, reconciliations, and data profiling tools, detect data issues early and propose fixes or compensating controls.
Document and maintain data lineage, access methods, and usage guidelines.
Develop or enhance reusable R/SQL/SAS/Python functions, templates.
Automate the generation of charts, tables, and other outputs, and ensure the seamless integration of results into standardized reporting interface.
Maintain code quality via coding standards, version control, documentation, and reproducibility practices.


Who we are looking for:


An academic background in statistics, mathematics, data science, econometrics, physics, engineering or similar
3 and more year's work experience in data analysis or credit risk modelling/validation
Good statistical/programming knowledge (R, SAS, SQL, Python) and data handling skills
Hands‑on experience with large datasets, data warehouses.
Ability to design or maintain DQ frameworks, reconciliation logic, and standardized data structures.
Familiarity with integrating analytical tool outputs into structured reports.
Willingness to take on ownership and to deliver good quality work on time
Analytical and strategic mindset with the ability to transform theory into concrete action while maintaining documentation and coding standards.
Proactive and constructive team player, ready to share experience and ideas.
Good writing and communication skills (English is the main working language).


What we offer:


Entrepreneurial Scandinavian environment: international working environment, empowering culture, friendly and welcoming teammates.
Growth culture: opportunity to grow professionally by contributing to large-scale, high-impact initiatives, local and international internal mobility possibilities, put an impact on social or environmental issues.
Modern environment: innovative company in forefront of technology, challenging, cutting-edge work, excellent office environment, agile and modern ways of working.
Additional monetary benefits: paid seniority vacation and volunteering days, allocations to Your pension fund, profit sharing programme, and additional health insurance.


Do you want to be a part of SEB?

Welcome to join our inspiring culture and dedicated team of 1700 professionals. Our office offers both work and leisure areas, including a gym, library, game room, roof terrace, and more.

Communication Excellence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for diverse audiences.
Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to identifying challenges and crafting innovative solutions.

Experience with Python or other programming languages.

Experience working with advanced analytical frameworks or developing new methodologies leveraging emerging technologies.


Why Join Patrianna?


Impactful Role: Lead the charge in optimizing the performance of a diverse portfolio of gaming brands and shaping the way the commercial team operates.

Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and advancement in a dynamic and innovative industry.
Collaborative Environment: Work with a passionate team that values creativity, teamwork, and excellence.

Title: VYRESNIOJI DUOMENŲ ANALITIKĖ (-AS)
HTML:
Ar nori tapti „Ignitis Group“ dalimi?

Šiuo metu ieškome naujos (-o) komandos narės (-io) duomenų analitikos komandoje. Šioje pozicijoje būsi atsakinga (-as) už analizę, elektros energijos prekybai vykdyti. Manai, mums pakeliui? Tuomet laukiame tavęs savo komandoje!

Take YOUR part in #EnergySmart!

Prisidėsi prie saugios ir žalios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:


  • Kuriant analitinius įrankius duomenų gavimui, analizei, procesų optimizavimui, procesų stebėsenai ir automatizacijai;
  • Analizuojant duomenis, ieškant dėsningumų ir teikiant įžvalgas verslo sprendimams;
  • Kuriant, testuojant ir tobulinant prognozavimo bei analizės modelius;
  • Kuriant įrankius kitiems įmonės specialistams, savarankiškoms ataskaitoms;
  • Vykdant didmeninės rinkos modeliavimą;
  • Inicijuojant ir diegiant naujus analitikos sprendimus;
  • Tobulinant ir administruojant automatizuotas prekybos sistemas;
  • Ieškant naujų analitikos, automatizavimo ir dirbtinio intelekto sprendimų.


Šiai pozicijai svarbu:


  • Aukštasis išsilavinimas (ekonometrijos, statistikos, matematikos ar kitų panašių tiksliųjų mokslo srityse);
  • Ne mažesnė nei 2 metų patirtis, kuriant analitinius sprendimus duomenų analizės ar modeliavimo srityje;
  • Geri programavimo įgūdžiai su „Python“, „VBA“ bei „SQL“ programavimo kalbomis;
  • Analitinis mąstymas, duomenų raštingumas, geri problemų sprendimo įgūdžiai;
  • Gebėjimas analizuoti didelius duomenų kiekius ir sudėtingas problemas paversti aiškiais sprendimais.


Privalumas būtų:


  • Ankstesnė patirtis elektros, kitų žaliavų, akcijų ar valiutų biržoje;
  • Su energetika susijusių duomenų dalinimosi platformų išmanymas;
  • Elektros rinkos veikimo principų išmanymas;
  • Patirtis kuriant prognozavimo modelius ar taikant dirbtinio intelekto sprendimus.


Mainais už tvaresnės ateities kūrimą, mes pažadame:


  • Papildomų naudų paketą pasirenkant: pensijų kaupimą, sveikatos draudimą ar kitą naudą iš pasirenkamų naudų sąrašo „MELP“ programėlėje;
  • Papildomas apmokamas dienas: sveikatinimuisi, trumpalaikės ligos atveju, savanorystei, už sukauptą darbo stažą;
  • Nelaimingų atsitikimų draudimą;
  • Hibridinį darbo modelį (3+2) ir lankstų darbo laiko grafiką;
  • Vidines karjeros galimybes;
  • Plačias mokymosi, kvalifikacijos kėlimo programas;
  • Dėmesį fizinei ir emocinei sveikatai: gerovės mentorių iniciatyvas ir psichologinę pagalbą, tinklinio ir krepšinio komandas ir t.t;
  • Galimybę prisidėti prie energetikos transformacijos, siekiant sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energijos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms.


Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

Pareigybių grupės pastovios atlyginimo dalies intervalas: yra nuo 3430 iki 5150 EUR (neatskaičius mokesčių). Konkretus darbo užmokestis siūlomas atsižvelgiant į darbo patirtį ir kompetenciją. Prie darbo užmokesčio gali būti mokama kintamoji atlygio dalis.

Apie mus:

Norėtum prisidėti prie projektų, keičiančių elektros energijos gamybos ir vartojimo ateitį Baltijos šalyse ir už jų ribų? „Ignitis grupė“ yra Baltijos šalyse pirmaujanti integruota energetikos įmonių grupė, apjungianti beveik 4 800 skirtingų sričių ekspertų vienijamų bendro siekio sukurti 100 proc. saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms.

Atsakingai investuojame, kad įgalintume elektrifikaciją, užtikrintume tinklų atsparumą ir įgyvendintume strateginį siekį – įdiegti 4–5 GW veikiančių žaliųjų pajėgumų, plėtojant žaliąją gamybą ir lankstumo pajėgumus.

Mažindami ŠESD emisijų intensyvumą energetikos tinkluose, nuosekliai įgyvendiname vertę kuriančią dekarbonizaciją ir kartu užtikriname energetinį saugumą.

„Ignitis grupė“ veikia Baltijos šalyse, Lenkijoje ir Suomijoje. Integruotas verslo modelis grupėje įgalina sinergijas ir naujus verslo modelius, pasitelkiant Baltijos šalyse turimą didžiausią tinklą, energijos kaupimo pajėgumus ir klientų portfelį.

Title: Decision Scientist, Trust & Safety (Limited-Time Relocation Bonus)
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information About The Position

You’ll join Trust & Safety’s Actioning team, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The team owns critical mechanisms, including user reporting, moderation workflows, policy enforcement, and interventions against malicious users.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst / Decision Scientist to join the team and help shape better product and policy decisions through data. In this role, you’ll be embedded in a cross-functional product team, working closely with product managers, engineers, and other decision scientists to solve meaningful problems and turn insights into action.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys combining analytical depth with real product impact. You’ll lead hypothesis-driven experimentation, uncover opportunities, measure outcomes, and help your team make confident, data-driven decisions.

In this position, you’ll


Partner closely with your product team and stakeholders to identify opportunities, answer important business questions, and guide decision-making with data.
Drive product experimentation from hypothesis to analysis, helping the team validate ideas and understand their real impact.
Analyse moderation, reporting, policy, and sanctioning flows to uncover insights and improve how we protect the Vinted community.
Define, calculate, and monitor key performance indicators, spot issues early, and investigate root causes.
Build dashboards and self-service solutions that help teams independently access and use data.
Work with other decision scientists to raise the bar for analytics, experimentation, and data-driven thinking across the domain.


About You


Have 3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Decision Science, or a similar role.
Are strong in analytical thinking and problem-solving, and know how to balance rigor with business relevance.
Have a solid understanding of statistical methods, including A/B testing (designing, running, and interpreting A/B tests), and other inferential techniques.
Have hands-on experience with SQL and Python for data analysis, or a strong willingness to learn them quickly.
Are familiar with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI, or a strong willingness to learn them quickly.
Enjoy working in iterative environments where priorities evolve and learning quickly matters.
Can communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
Nice to have: Experience in Trust & Safety, fraud prevention, or a related area.


Work perks


This position is eligible for Limited-time Relocation Package which includes €30.000 bonus + 2 months of temporary housing covered by Vinted (check our website for more info)
The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
25 working days of holiday
Access to all the tools & tech needed for work
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Private health insurance
Mental and emotional health support through the Mindletic app
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation
A dog-friendly office
In Vilnius office: Gym & in-house meals at friendly prices
In Kaunas office: a monthly lunch allowance, and a once-a-week provided in-house lunch and breakfast


Working at Vinted

Limited-time Relocation Package

Your location shouldn’t be a stopper! In addition to our standard package, for this position we’ve increased the bonus to €30,000 gross. If you think Vinted is the ideal cultural fit for you, we invite you to apply! For further information, please refer to our Relocation page.

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

Title: Data Engineer / Analyst
Description:
About the role




At Cosylab we build software for the world's most advanced scientific and medical systems — particle accelerators, telescopes, fusion reactors, and cancer treatment devices. Our technology helps organizations drive scientific discovery, advance cancer care, and bring clean fusion energy closer to reality.




You will be joining our business analytics team, where your main tasks will involve preparing data for analytical and operational use, working with our data warehouse, and creating reports for internal users of the company, such as management, production, marketing, sales, finance, and others.




Key tasks and responsibilities




Development and maintenance of ETL processes for transferring data into the data warehouse.
Preparation and maintenance of data for reports (views, tables, and scheduled jobs).
Gather and define requirements with internal stakeholders (management, development, sales, finance, and others) and deliver corresponding data solutions.
Integrate new data sources in line with evolving business needs.
Collaborating on the modernization of internal data infrastructure.




Required Qualifications and Skills




Minimum of 2 years of experience in a comparable data engineering or analytics role.
Strong knowledge of SQL.
Understanding of ETL processes and data pipelines.
Solid understanding of data modeling and how to structure data for reliable reporting and analysis.
Comfortable working directly with business users to understand what they need and build data that delivers it.
Proactiveness, a strong sense of responsibility, and well-developed communication and teamwork skills.




You'll stand out if you have experience with




Familiarity with the Microsoft data stack (SQL Server, SSIS, Power Query).
Experience developing reports in Microsoft Power BI.
Interest in AI tools and ideas for applying them to optimize workflows.
Working knowledge of React sufficient to support the maintenance of an internal web application.




Education




Bachelor of Science in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or another related technical field.
Fluency in spoken and written English.




What we offer




Employment contract for an indefinite period with a six-month probationary period.
A work environment with flexible working hours and a hybrid work model.
Plenty of personal and professional growth opportunities combined with a competitive and periodically updated salary tailored to your skills, experiences, and results.
Interesting work full of challenges in an international working environment.
Company-funded licenses for leading AI tools (Claude Code).
High-impact learning culture: regular in-house and external training sessions and a team of international professionals eager to help you grow.
Many recreational after-work activities, additional health insurance (Specialists+), unlimited coffee, soft drinks, fruit, and other well-being goodies.
Cosylab events (Teambuilding, New Year’s Party, Picnic… ).




You will fit perfectly if you share these values




Think bold: We deliver exceptional solutions through courageous thinking, open communication, and the drive to continuously improve.
Be modest: We set our egos aside in actively listening, respecting one another, and embracing the diversity of experience and perspective across the company.
Work smart: We know we get more accomplished by working together, being accountable, focusing our efforts, and going the extra mile.
Enjoy life: We prioritize balance and positivity, nurturing personal wellness and celebrating successes.
Do good: We support one another and are passionate about solving difficult problems that ultimately help make the world a better place.




Apply for the job




Apply by Tuesday, September 1, 2026. Your application should include:




CV,
A brief motivational letter and
potential recommendations or references.




We're looking forward to meeting You!

The Cosylab Team

Title: Process Analyst
Description:
About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Process Analyst to work as the data and analytics interface for Kerry’s Enzyme Process Technology (PT) Team. Embedded within the wider PT team, over three production sites, the role will focus on curating, structuring, analysing, and visualising process data across the entirety of the microbial enzyme production life cycle.

The successful candidate will partner closely with the PT teams on site to curate, structure and visualise manufacturing and process data from Kerry’s core systems (including SAP, EPM/MES platforms, SCADA systems and local Excel based datasets), turning complex and fragmented data streams into clear insights that support yield, recovery, productivity, process robustness and facilitate operational excellence.

Key responsibilities

Data Curation & Integration


  Extract, clean and harmonise process and manufacturing data from
  SAP (process orders, batch data, confirmations, material movements, yields)
  EPM / MES / LIMS / SCADA systems
  Site level Excel trackers and historical datasets
  Resolve inconsistencies between system data and off-line data repositories
  Improve transparency and traceability of process performance data
  Understand how SAP master data structures influence process orders, confirmations, yields, and performance reporting


Process & Manufacturing Analytics


  Analyse and trend process performance data across the end-to-end enzyme production process, including Inoculum preparation and cultivation; Fermentation metrics and profiles; and Downstream operational parameters and yields
  Support PT with robust analysis of key performance indices including yield and rolled throughput yield; recovery of unit operations; Enzyme titre and productivity; Losses, variability and deviation impacts
  Provide analytical support to process optimisation initiatives and continuous improvement projects
  Work with PAT and IoT-enabled sensors, historians, and data acquisition systems to contextualise high-frequency process data alongside batch and transactional datasets


Data Architecture


  Design and implement practical data frameworks and architecture to improve data accessibility and data reliability
  Reduce manual data handling by improving integration between SAP and reporting tools, while standardising data flows and calculation logic
  Work with each respective production site to align on data architecture and tools
  Clearly document datasets, assumptions and calculations used in PT reporting


Visualisation & Reporting


  Translate complex, multivariate datasets into clear, decision focused visuals, using Power BI dashboards for site, Excel based tools, PowerPoint etc
  Develop standardised visual and reporting templates to illustrate end-to-end process data


Collaboration within Process Technology


  Operate as a core member of the Process Technology team to help improve transparency and accessible to process data
  Leverage expertise from the PT teams to interpret biological data and benchmark expected process outcomes
  Work with the wide team to help coordinate how data may be collected, stored and modelled from operational process data and equipment


Qualifications and skills


  Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Engineering, Science, Biotechnology, or related field with a MSc or PhD preferred
  Experience applying data engineering principles (data pipelines, transformations, data quality controls) in a manufacturing or process environment with complex and various data streams
  Solid industrial process/data analytics experience, operating at a moderate to advanced level
  Advanced capability in Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint and other related platforms is a necessity
  Experience in working with SAP and managing its datasets is a strong advantage
  A proven understanding of data modelling, architecture and scalable analytical frameworks
  Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work within multidisciplinary teams and influence stakeholders
  Advanced English proficiency


Why Kerry?

In Kerry we benefit from the knowledge of our colleagues who bring a diverse range of cultures, backgrounds, lifestyles, and experiences. One team fostering an inclusive culture that, above all, inspires food and nourishes life. One culture where everyone brings their unique perspectives and experiences to help make us better, together. We are committed to nurturing an environment of positivity and inclusiveness, where everyone can be at their best, both personally and professionally.

Our recruitment, selection and assessment process are based on the skills and competencies of the specific roles and based entirely on merit. We are committed to and value Diversity and Inclusion in all recruitment processes within Kerry and do not discriminate based on gender, race, class, economic status, ethnic background, sexual orientation, age, political beliefs, veteran status, marital status or any other protected characteristic.

Please note We do not accept CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies where Kerry terms of business have not been signed. Additionally, we will not consider or agree to payment of any recruiter fee under these circumstances. This also applies to CVs or candidate profiles sent directly to any Kerry Hiring Managers.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
OBDeleven is all about making car tech easy and accessible for everyone. For over 10 years, we've been building powerful yet simple diagnostic and customization tools for car enthusiasts worldwide.

As we continue to grow the OBDeleven ecosystem, we're looking for a Data Analyst who will help us turn data into insights, support better business decisions and uncover opportunities to improve our products and customer experience.

This is not a role focused only on reporting. You'll work with data across different areas of the business, partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering and other teams, and help turn complex questions and data into clear, actionable recommendations.

What You'll Do


Analyse customer, product and business data to support better business and product decisions
Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports and ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions
Define, monitor and improve KPIs and maintain clear metric definitions
Analyse funnels, cohorts, retention, segmentation and trends to identify opportunities and investigate anomalies
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
Evaluate business initiatives, product features and experiments and help measure their impact
Validate data quality, identify gaps and work with engineers to improve data pipelines and documentation
Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Engineering and other teams to understand their needs and deliver meaningful insights
Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and contribute to a culture of data-driven decision-making


We expect


2-3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Marketing Analytics, BI or a related field
Strong hands-on SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries and window functions
Experience analysing customer, business, operational or product data
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports using a BI or data visualisation tool
Good understanding of analytical methods such as funnel, cohort, retention/churn, segmentation and trend analysis
Ability to turn business questions into structured analyses and clear, actionable recommendations
Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Ability to work independently, take ownership and collaborate effectively with different teams
Experience with Python, A/B testing, product analytics or cloud data platforms would be considered an advantage
Fluency in Lithuanian and full professional proficiency in English


Here's what we offer:


Fair pay for bold work: We reward your expertise with competitive pay that grows as you do
Hybrid Work Flexibility: Work 3 days in the office and 2 days from home or wherever suits you best.
Focus on your well-being: Choose your comprehensive health plan, get paid days off to care for yourself and your family, and enjoy flexible working hours, as well as your birthday day off.
More time that truly counts: Enjoy a 4-day workweek for one month a year, depending on how well the company hits its goals. Plus, earn an additional vacation day for every working year with us - up to 4 extra days
Real learning opportunities: Grow your skills with a 2% gross salary learning budget. Take your monthly paid self-learning day and improve stress-free.
Culture that connects: Enjoy Friday lunches on us, team buildings, company parties, and all the usual office perks like snacks, a cozy lounge, sport communities, and more.
Environment for real impact: Got an idea that'll make OBDeleven better? Share it, get feedback, fine-tune, and take action. We trust expertise and value ownership.


Salary range

Gross salary in a range: 2800 - 4500€ / month. The salary range is flexible, and we're open to discussing your expectations based on your experience and competencies.

Title: Data and Reporting Analyst
Description:
As Data & Reporting Analyst, you will own the delivery of trusted, decision-ready reporting for Verne using Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. You’ll turn data from multiple operational and product sources into clear KPIs, semantic models, and dashboards that help teams measure service performance, product experience, and system health.

Who are we?

At Verne, we're building an ecosystem to progress our society through a journey of curiosity and innovation. Named in honor of Jules Verne "the man who invented the future,". We are the first European solution for autonomous journeys. We adopt an integrated approach, including vehicle design, infrastructure development, and the full digital experience.

As a growing startup, we thrive on curiosity, innovation, and bold ideas. If you’re ready to make your mark in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, this could be the role for you.

What will you do?

Regular tasks


Build and maintain Power BI dashboards for Verne operational and performance reporting (e.g., operational metrics, per-vehicle stats, system health monitoring).
Monitor and troubleshoot Fabric/Power BI refreshes and data reliability across ingested sources (e.g., databases, telemetry, tooling feeds).
Perform ongoing KPI validation and data quality checks (completeness, consistency, timeliness) and resolve issues with source owners.
Deliver ad-hoc analysis for stakeholders and communicate insights clearly, especially around service readiness and operational performance.
Keep metric definitions and reporting logic documented so stakeholders share a common, “single version of truth” language.


Responsibilities


Reporting ownership (Power BI): Design, develop, publish, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards that support Verne operations and leadership decisions.
Semantic modelling: Create maintainable data models and DAX measures to support consistent KPI calculation and self-service analytics.
Microsoft Fabric delivery: Support ingestion and shaping of data into Fabric (e.g., pulling data from operational stores and platforms into Fabric for reporting).
KPI framework & instrumentation mindset: Ensure the right events and metrics exist to measure customer and product journeys (e.g., registration, booking/ride funnel, app stability and key screen performance).
Operational/system health monitoring: Help define and operationalize monitoring KPIs (e.g., uptime and response time metrics) and make them visible through reporting.
Data governance & compliance alignment: Collaborate with IT/security and stakeholders to ensure data access, storage and protection expectations are met.


What do you need to succeed?


5+ years in BI / analytics / reporting roles; experience owning business-critical dashboards end-to-end.
Strong Power BI skills: data modelling, DAX, performance optimisation, workspace/report lifecycle in Power BI Service.
Working experience with Microsoft Fabric concepts (Lakehouse/Warehouse/Dataflows/Pipelines/Semantic models) and modern data platforms.
Strong SQL; ability to translate operational questions into reliable datasets and measures.
Proven ability to define and maintain KPI definitions and ensure consistent measurement across teams.
Comfortable working with multi-source operational data (e.g., DBs + telemetry + monitoring platforms) and aligning stakeholders on definitions.
Clear communication skills - able to explain data, assumptions and insights to technical and non-technical audiences.


What’s in it for you?

Joining Verne means becoming part of a team shaping the future of autonomous mobility. Here’s what we offer:


The chance to collaborate with experts from 20+ industries.
Ownership of your projects, with the freedom to innovate and take initiative.
A culture of transparency, feedback, and open communication.
Comprehensive financial and wellbeing support designed to meet diverse needs.
The excitement of working in a fast-growing startup where your ideas truly matter.


How can you apply?

If this role and our mission resonate with you, hit the Apply button! We typically review applications within 3-4 business days, but since we want to give each one the attention it deserves, please allow a little extra time if needed. Once we've had a chance to fully evaluate your submission, we’ll reach out with details about the next steps.

If Shortlisted, Here’s What To Expect


An initial HR interview focused on culture fit.
A task.
A technical interview with the Hiring Manager.
A final interview with C-level.


Not sure if this role is the right fit?

We’re always looking for creators who challenge the status quo and aren’t afraid to take the lead. If that’s you, explore our story - we might have other opportunities that spark your interest.

Verne (Project 3 Mobility) is a company comprised of people with different qualities and backgrounds, because we believe our differences make us stronger. All applications will be considered in accordance with the regulations of personal data protection.

Title: Qlik Developer
Description:
A well-established organisation is looking for an experienced Qlik Developer to join its Business Intelligence team. This is an excellent opportunity for a data-focused professional with strong QlikView and Qlik Sense experience who enjoys turning complex data and business requirements into meaningful reporting solutions.

The successful candidate will work closely with business users and stakeholders to understand their needs, develop and maintain Qlik solutions, and help deliver accurate insights that support business performance and decision-making.




Key Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and enhance QlikView and Qlik Sense dashboards, reports, and BI solutions.
Work closely with business users to understand reporting requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Analyse product, market, and business data to identify trends and generate meaningful insights.
Develop reporting solutions that provide accessible and accurate information for business decision-making.
Work with data warehouse information to create reports and support business performance monitoring.
Maintain and continuously improve existing Qlik applications, BI systems, and reporting solutions.
Troubleshoot issues within Qlik applications, reports, and BI models.
Identify opportunities to improve existing BI systems and reporting processes.
Ensure reports and dashboards are accurate, reliable, and aligned with business requirements.
Perform quality assurance checks on reports and BI solutions before delivery.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to continuously improve reporting and business intelligence capabilities.




Requirements

4+ years of experience in Qlik Development, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a similar role.
Strong hands-on experience with QlikView and Qlik Sense is essential.
Proven experience developing Qlik dashboards, reports, and data visualisations.
Good understanding of data warehousing and business intelligence concepts.
Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to troubleshoot BI models and investigate data-related issues.
Proactive approach with the ability to take initiative and identify opportunities for improvement.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
Previous industry experience will be considered an advantage.




What's on Offer

Salary up to €60,000 per annum, depending on experience.
Opportunity to work extensively with QlikView and Qlik Sense.
Exposure to business-critical BI, reporting, and data projects.
Close collaboration with business stakeholders and technical teams.
Opportunity to have a direct impact on business reporting and decision-making.
Professional development and long-term career progression opportunities.




If you're an experienced Qlik Developer looking for your next opportunity and have a strong background in QlikView and Qlik Sense, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
About Us

GoCardless is a global bank payment company. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Payment Intelligence

Our mission is to make GoCardless the best way to pay and be paid. Our ambition is to dramatically improve payment performance and safeguard our customers from bad outcomes like payment fraud and failures. You will help find data opportunities and areas to improve our payment intelligence products. You should be comfortable with large data sets, customer data, and machine learning principles. You’ll work alongside Product Managers, Engineers and Data Scientists in our two core Payment Intelligence teams to provide critical insights and help drive product direction.

Our existing Payment Intelligence Products are already one of the key reasons why customers choose GoCardless. These include Protect+, which defends customers from fraud, and Success+, which helps customers intelligently recover failed payments. You will need to own our understanding of these products and identify insights and opportunities to help us develop new intelligent features.

What You'll Do

At GoCardless analytics is at the core of everything we do and drives business performance through data insight. You will play a critical role partnering closely with stakeholders across the business (including product, operations, marketing, and commercial teams) in order to deliver actionable insights to influence decisions at every level of the organisation. The role is focussed on identifying value and driving change throughout the business derived from insights. Your insights will be turned into actions that will help drive the future of GoCardless. You will act as the bridge between the data, technical and business stakeholders informing strategic plans and will own and evolve a suite of reports designed to give a wide range of stakeholders access insights.


Own and iterate on experiments to generate user insight and drive business metrics, allowing the team to quickly take action on business opportunities.
Define how we quantitatively evaluate success, setting KPIs, designing tracking to measure what really matters, delving into the leading indicators of user behaviour
Influence the organisation to increase Product Data coverage and implement user tracking best practices - acting as a mentor to guide other members of the organisation to become data driven
Build models of user-segmentation, customer lifetime value etc in order to inform strategic product & commercial decisions
Continuously innovate on the practices and the tools we rely on to deliver the right insights at the right decision points (A/B Testing, Analysis (SQL), Visualisation (Looker), Tracking (Amplitude), Automation (Python), AI (Gemini)


What Excites You


Become a strategic partner and advisor for the business: you like to proactively seek out gaps in our product capabilities, suggest areas of improvement based on tangible data, as well as owning processes to run and improve testing from the tracking point of view when developing new features.
Act as a catalyst for change across the organization, driving the evolution of our data analytics standards, internal processes, and overall product data strategy to ensure scalability and operational excellence.
Translate complex technical findings into compelling, high-impact narratives. You will bridge the gap between technical data and commercial strategy, influencing product roadmaps and executive decision-making across the entire organization.
Stay current with AI and data trends to solve real-world problems. You like to leverage these technologies to enhance the payment experience, as well as to optimize data analysis, and deliver high-impact insights and strategic recommendations across the business.
Unlocking new layers of payment performance, from uncovering new fraud vectors to maximizing success rates
Serve as a cross-functional mentor, championing a data-driven mindset and elevating the analytical capabilities of team members throughout the company.


What Excites Us


You have a background working in similar fast paced product-driven teams and are great at communicating insights to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders, to drive data-informed product decisions
You are a self-starter, focused on results, with a demonstrated background in using analytics to drive the understanding, growth, and success of a product
You have extensive experience with data visualisation tools mentioned above and develop compelling visualisations which influence decision making and business understanding
You have advanced SQL skills and intermediate Python skills & have experience leveraging AI capabilities to enhance data analysis, automate tasks, and improve decision-making processes
You have a background working in similar fast paced teams and are great at communicating insights to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders, to drive data-informed decisions.
You are solution-oriented and able to own projects from start to finish. You are comfortable motivating stakeholders across the business and negotiating timelines to unblock yourself and make things happen!


Salary range: the expected base salary range for this position is between €32,000 - €48,000.

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.

(some of) The good stuff


Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period
Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
Time off - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)


Life at GoCardless

We're an organisation defined by our values; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic- the reason we all love showing up to work.

Diversity & Inclusion

As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.

To Ensure That We're Representative Of The World Around Us - And To Be Able To Review Relevant Benchmarks - We Ask GeeCees To Voluntarily Disclose Diversity Data. This Year, The Proportion Of GeeCees Providing Data Increased To 88% (up From 79% In 2024). With Regards To Diversity Within GoCardless, We Can See GeeCees Identifying As

Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — 25%

Neurodiverse — 9%

Average age — 33

Title: Performance & Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Windcave




Windcave is a global leader in payment technology, delivering a unified platform that brings together acquiring, issuing, payment gateways, online commerce, point-of-sale solutions and unattended payments into one seamless ecosystem.

Operating in over 40 countries and supporting more than 57,000 merchants worldwide, we process billions of transactions each year and help businesses accept payments securely across every channel. With continued investment in innovation, technology and data, Windcave is shaping the future of payments on a global scale.

As our European business continues to grow, we're looking for a talented Performance & Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team and help transform data into meaningful business insight.




Your role with us




As our Performance & Business Intelligence Analyst, you'll work across Sales, Operations, Finance, Compliance and Technology to build powerful reporting solutions, analyse business performance, automate processes and deliver insights that support strategic decision-making across Europe.This role offers the opportunity to work with modern business intelligence technologies, explore emerging AI solutions and contribute to business performance within one of the world's leading payment technology providers. Whether you're a recent graduate with exceptional analytical skills or have gained early career experience in business intelligence, this is an exciting opportunity to develop your career in a fast-paced global fintech environment.




What you'll do




Business Intelligence & Performance

Develop interactive Power BI dashboards and KPI reporting.
Analyse operational, commercial and financial performance across the business.
Produce management reports that support strategic decision-making.
Identify trends, risks and opportunities through data analysis.




Data Analytics, Automation & AI

Develop automated reporting using SQL, Excel, VBA and Power BI.
Work with multiple data sources to create reliable business intelligence.
Explore AI and emerging technologies to improve reporting and productivity.
Continuously improve reporting processes through automation and innovation.




Safeguarding, Governance & Compliance

Support safeguarding monitoring and reconciliation reporting.
Produce regulatory and management reports.
Perform trend analysis and identify reporting exceptions.
Help maintain high standards of data quality and reporting governance.




Business Partnership

Partner with teams across Sales, Operations, Finance, Compliance and Technology.
Translate business requirements into reporting and analytical solutions.
Support budgeting, forecasting and performance reviews.
Deliver insights that improve operational efficiency and commercial growth.




What you'll bring

A degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance or another analytical discipline, or equivalent commercial experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience using Excel, SQL or Power BI through university, internships or employment.

Title: Quantitative Data Analyst in Credit Risk Model Validation | SEB, Vilnius
Description:
SEB is a leading northern European financial services group with a high focus on risk identification, measurement, monitoring, and governance. Banking is transforming at pace, our talented and rapidly expanding quant team is committed to innovation, excellence, and fostering a strong risk culture. Does that sound like a fit for you?

What You Will Be Doing

You will be a part of a professional team within SEB Group CRO organization that ensures quality of models used for measuring credit risk. We conduct in-depth reviews of the models to ensure quality performance by assessing model design and modelling methodologies, performance from the statistical point of view, data quality, implementation, regulatory compliance, and usage.

We work closely with model developers, owners, users, management and other key stakeholders to provide insights and recommendations.

As a Quantitative Data Analyst your primary focus will be on retrieving, preparing, analysing, and interpreting data used throughout the validation process. You will help ensure data quality through structured DQ checks, reconciliations, and standardised datasets, while contributing to consistent data definitions, metadata management, and well‑documented data usage. Alongside analytical work, you will support the development of validation infrastructure by contributing to automation, reusable functions, reporting templates, and coding standards. You’ll be empowered to introduce new validation tools or enhance existing ones, driving innovation and efficiency. Work will be organized in small, project-driven sub-teams within a fast-paced and supportive environment that fosters creativity, autonomy, and professional growth.

The team is located in Vilnius, but you will work in close interaction with the experienced professionals in SEB Group CRO organization across Nordic and Baltic countries.

As a Quantitative Data Analyst, you will be responsible for:


Developing methodologies and advanced tools to improve model review process
Build, maintain and standardize validation datasets ensuring consistent variable definitions and filters across portfolios. Support validation sample preparation under time constraints.
Design and implement automated DQ checks, reconciliations, and data profiling tools, detect data issues early and propose fixes or compensating controls.
Document and maintain data lineage, access methods, and usage guidelines.
Develop or enhance reusable R/SQL/SAS/Python functions, templates.
Automate the generation of charts, tables, and other outputs, and ensure the seamless integration of results into standardized reporting interface.
Maintain code quality via coding standards, version control, documentation, and reproducibility practices.


Who we are looking for:


An academic background in statistics, mathematics, data science, econometrics, physics, engineering or similar
3 and more year's work experience in data analysis or credit risk modelling/validation
Good statistical/programming knowledge (R, SAS, SQL, Python) and data handling skills
Hands‑on experience with large datasets, data warehouses.
Ability to design or maintain DQ frameworks, reconciliation logic, and standardized data structures.
Familiarity with integrating analytical tool outputs into structured reports.
Willingness to take on ownership and to deliver good quality work on time
Analytical and strategic mindset with the ability to transform theory into concrete action while maintaining documentation and coding standards.
Proactive and constructive team player, ready to share experience and ideas.
Good writing and communication skills (English is the main working language).


What we offer:


Entrepreneurial Scandinavian environment: international working environment, empowering culture, friendly and welcoming teammates.
Growth culture: opportunity to grow professionally by contributing to large-scale, high-impact initiatives, local and international internal mobility possibilities, put an impact on social or environmental issues.
Modern environment: innovative company in forefront of technology, challenging, cutting-edge work, excellent office environment, agile and modern ways of working.
Additional monetary benefits: paid seniority vacation and volunteering days, allocations to Your pension fund, profit sharing programme, and additional health insurance.

Title: Lead Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

We’re looking for a Lead Data Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders to partner with our operational teams to help drive data-driven decisions that would support our fast-growing product through scaling and optimising the team.

As a Lead Data Analyst, you'll be driving our analytics efforts in our operations teams, who do everything from support our customers when they need help, to screening for criminal activity, to verifying customer identities at scale.

Most importantly, you’ll collaborate closely with your operational leads, as well as workforce management, quality, training, and knowledge management, to bring your insights into real change for our customers and help drive our mission!

Here’s How You Will Be Contributing


Analytical Capacity Planning and Forecasting. Focus on building and refining analytical models for strategic capacity planning. Take ownership of forecasting efforts to align with business growth and operational demands.
Data Pipeline Ownership. Take ownership of data pipelines to maintain and improve data flow, ensuring reliability and accuracy.
Predictive Modeling and Cause and Effect Analysis. Develop and implement robust models to predict outcomes and perform cause and effect analysis to identify key drivers, optimise processes, and enhance decision-making and strategic planning.
Strategic Support and Analysis. Provide critical insights to assess the operational health of the KYC/FinCrime function, conduct in-depth cost analysis, and offer detailed analysis of operational metrics (including quality) to understand impacts on customer experiences.
Performance Tracking and Initiative Optimisation. Monitor and track the performance of key strategic initiatives, capitalising on optimisation opportunities to enhance operational outcomes.
KPI Implementation and Target Setting. Lead the development and implementation of the operations KPI tree and the target-setting framework, integrating these within reporting pipelines and strategic operations.
Stakeholder Collaboration and Process Standardisation. Collaborate closely with various stakeholders to standardise processes across forecasting, scheduling, and real-time operations, promoting continuous improvement and strategic alignment.


This is an IC3 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here.

What You Will Bring


Quantitative Foundation. Ideally, you have a background in statistics, maths, physics, engineering, economics, or another scientific field. You apply first-principles thinking to break down complex operational problems.
A Statistical Mindset. You have a natural grasp of data logic. You don't just look at averages; you understand distributions, variance, and significance. You enjoy applying that rigor to messy, real-world operational data to separate signal from noise.
You have 4+ years of experience in analytics with demonstrated ability to approach complex problems with a strategic mindset, identifying innovative solutions that drive operational improvements.
You have a background working with operational team analytics including capacity planning, forecasting, efficiency analysis, quality assurance, predictive analytics, and experimentation.
You have experience working with complex data models in SQL (our warehouse is Snowflake) and analysing it using advanced SQL/Python/R
Able to demonstrate that you can tell a story and proactively give guidance on strategy based on insights
You have experience with data visualisation tools (Looker, PowerBI, Tableau etc.) and demonstrate storytelling ability with data
You have a bias to action - you identify what needs to be done and make it happen.


Some Extra Skills That Are Great (but Not Essential)


Prior experience in Operation domains
You have experience working with a WFM or Quality team.
You have experience working with WFM Systems
You have experience with forecasting techniques such as ARIMA, Holt-Winters, and other time series analysis methods


Additional Information
