Title: Game Data Analyst (World of Warships, PC)
Description:
Job Overview

Wargaming is looking for a Game Data Analyst to work on World of Warships, World of Warships: Legends and World of Warships: Blitz in our brand to strengthen the World of Warships product analytics team. The position is dedicated to core game play and balance analysis.

You will be a part of the team working on analyzing, visualizing, monitoring and managing data of three World of Warships Franchise games. We cover all kinds of products’ needs ranging from in-game battle analysis to game economy and financial monitoring. We work extensively with game production team for both providing sufficient data for informed decisions and to enhance data processes within the development.




Reports to

Our future colleague will report to Lead BI Data Analyst




What will you do?

Work closely with internal customers and stakeholders from gameplay development teams to meet business requirements and transform them into valuable BI reports / research reports for senior management and product teams all over the globe;
Identify the key needs and point of growth of the development team and identify which data and how can enhance the decision-making process;
Define the format and to provide the decision support outputs (dashboards, ad hoc reports);
Determine key measurement metrics for new functionality and define tracking strategy;
Consult users and lead cross-functional teams to address business issues, if necessary;
Directly produce datasets and reports for analysis using various system reporting tools, if necessary.




What are we looking for?

3+ year experience on similar position;
Experienced player with a broad gaming background
Advanced knowledge of SQL at the level of complex queries;
Data visualization skills, proficiency with BI instruments (we use Tableau);
Good mathematical knowledge and knowledge of statistics;
Knowledge of Python popular libraries for data processing and analysis;
Experienced in working with DWH, overall understanding of DWH design and operations;
Written and spoken English (B2 and higher).




What additional skills will help you stand out?

Experience in game development (2+ years) and understanding of game production processes and needs;
Experience in Wargaming games
Understanding of multiplatform game analysis basics (PC, mobile, console).




Work mode

Hybrid (3 days of work from the office)
This role isn't eligible for relocation & immigration support.




Benefits

Benefits and perks are tailored to the local market and culture. Our benefits in Nicosia include:

21 days annual leave (additional days based on years of service: up to 25 days)
Additional paid time off (5 Personal Days, Birthday Leave, Marriage Leave, Compassionate Leave)
Sick Leave (10 days top-up to statutory allowance per year)
Maternity Leave (18 weeks top-up to statutory allowance per case)
Career development and education opportunities within the company
English Language courses fully covered by the company upon Manager’s approval
Private Health Care
Mental well-being program (iFeel)
Onsite gym and spa
Free parking close to the Nicosia offices, based on availability
Free drinks-equipped kitchen in every floor building

Employee discounts (e.g. restaurants, bars, etc.)

Company events, Social Clubs
Seniority Awards

Title: Vecākais/-ā datu analītiķis/-e
Description:
Pievienojies mūsu komandai kā Vecākais/-ā datu analītiķis/-e!

Jā, Tu to vari! Tāda ir mūsu nostāja pret darbu, ambīcijām, idejām un attiecībām. Mēs Luminor ticam, ka ikvienam ir potenciāls sasniegt lielus mērķus, un mudinām ikvienu tos īstenot – gan profesionālajā, gan personīgajā dzīvē.

Lai kas Tu būtu un kāda būtu Tava loma, Luminor Tev sniegs unikālu iespēju kļūt par banku nozares čempionu.

Mēs meklējam pieredzējušu Vecāko datu analītiķi, kas palīdzēs radīt pievienoto vērtību, izmantojot datus. Šajā amatā tu strādāsi ar datu iegūšanu, apstrādi, analīzi un vizualizāciju, izmantojot tādus rīkus kā SQL, Excel, Tableau un KNIME. Mēs augstu vērtējam radošu domāšanu, iniciatīvu, spēcīgas analītiskās prasmes un vēlmi nepārtraukti mācīties un pilnveidoties.

Mēs Tev uzticēsim:


Novērtēt, vadīt un atbalstīt finanšu noziegumu novēršanas un atbilstības risinājumu un procesu izstrādi, ieviešanu un pilnveidošanu
Veikt sarežģītu datu analīzi, lai identificētu tendences, riskus un iespējas, kā arī sniegtu datos balstītus ieteikumus lēmumu pieņemšanai
Uzraudzīt, izvērtēt un pilnveidot esošos rīkus un risinājumus, lai uzlabotu to efektivitāti un lietderību
Sadarboties ar biznesa un tehniskajām iesaistītajām pusēm, lai ievāktu prasības un nodrošinātu risinājumus, kas atbilst biznesa vajadzībām
Atbalstīt testēšanas aktivitātes, tostarp lietotāju akcepttestēšanu (UAT), incidentu izsekošanu un risinājumu validāciju
Piedalīties automatizācijas un modernizācijas iniciatīvās, izmantojot datu analītiku un tehnoloģiskos risinājumus
Vadīt un piedalīties datu analītikas iniciatīvās, kas atbalsta uzņēmuma stratēģiskos mērķus un ilgtermiņa attīstību


Tu iederēsies mūsu komandā, ja Tev ir:


Augstākā izglītība ekonomikā, matemātikā, biznesa vadībā, informācijas tehnoloģijās vai līdzīgā jomā
Vismaz 3 gadu pieredze darbā ar datu analīzi, datu vizualizāciju un SQL, kā arī izpratne par relāciju datubāzēm (relational databases)
Izpratne par banku produktiem, procesiem un sistēmām
Spēcīga analītiskā domāšana un spēja pārvērst datus praktiski izmantojamos secinājumos un ieteikumos
Padziļinātas zināšanas Python, R, KNIME vai līdzīgos datu analītikas rīkos, kā arī pieredze darbā ar datu vizualizācijas platformām, piemēram, Power BI vai Tableau
Attīstītas problēmu risināšanas, komunikācijas un sadarbības prasmes, spēja patstāvīgi organizēt darbu, pārvaldīt procesus un uzņemties iniciatīvu
Labas zināšanas par AML un finanšu noziegumu novēršanas procesiem tiks uzskatītas kā priekšrocība
Teicamas angļu valodas zināšanas gan mutiski, gan rakstiski, jo darba pienākumos ir paredzēts komunicēt ar kolēģiem no visām Baltijas valstīm


Mēs Tev piedāvājam:


Atalgojums no 2880-4320 EUR bruto, kā arī iespēja pretendēt uz atalgojuma pārskatu reizi gadā.
Elastīga darba vide. Elastīgs darba laiks, attālināts darbs un iespēja strādāt no jebkuras vietas ES, Islandē, Šveicē un Apvienotajā Karalistē (kopā 90 dienas gadā).
Starptautiskas komandas. Komandas, kas iziet ārpus Baltijas robežām, kur cilvēki novērtē izaicinājumu bagātu darbu kopā ar labu humoru un prieku.
Vairāk atvaļinājuma. Papildu nedēļas atvaļinājums pieejams visiem darbiniekiem, kuri ir uzņēmumā strādājuši 1 gadu vai ilgāk.
Brīvprātīgo atvaļinājums. Mums rūp dot savu ieguldījumu sabiedrībai, tāpēc jūs saņemsiet papildu brīvdienas brīvprātīgas darbības nolūkos.
Apmaksāts atvaļinājums. Mēs lepojamies ar saviem darbiniekiem, kuri piedalās militārajās apmācībās. Tāpēc Luminor katru gadu piedāvā 30 pilnībā apmaksātas dienas militārajām apmācībām.
Veselības apdrošināšana. Konkurētspējīgs labumu grozs papildus jūsu algai, kas ietver veselības apdrošināšanu visās trīs Baltijas valstīs, kā arī veselības dienas, ja jums ir neplānota prombūtne slimības dēļ bez ārsta paziņojuma.
Labklājība. Piekļuve rīkiem un resursiem, kas palīdz justies labi un būt produktīvam gan darbā, gan privātajā dzīvē.
Profesionālā izaugsme. Iekšējās un ārējās apmācību programmas, darbnīcas, konferences, tiešsaistes apmācības utt.


Tā kā mūsu organizācijas saziņas pamatvaloda ir angļu valoda, sagaidi, ka ar Tevi sazināsies un intervija notiks angļu valodā, kā arī darbā pieņemšanas process notiks angļu valodā.

Piesakies līdz 28.08.2026!

Lūdzu, pieteikties ar savu CV angļu vai latviešu valodā un PDF formātā!

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
We create responsible logistics for an exciting future! Our strategic dream is to become a leader in the logistics sector in Europe by 2026. This ambitious goal makes our daily work even more meaningful and inspires us to surpass ourselves. Together, by creating a modern and advanced international company, we foster an open and friendly corporate culture where everyone is treated with respect. Join the Girteka Group and take the lead of your career with the company that is setting impressive possibilities to grow.

About The Role

The Business Analyst is responsible for ensuring data quality within the pricing department, providing analytical insights to support business decision making, and developing and improving effective data analytics tools. This role requires strong data modeling skills, a deep understanding of business processes, and the ability to independently initiate analytical solutions that contribute to overall operational efficiency.

What you will do:


Work with large databases — process, structure, and prepare data for analysis.
Monitor KPIs, prepare reports, and automate reporting using Power BI, SAP, Excel, and SQL.
Evaluate incoming data, identify trends, and provide recommendations to improve operational efficiency.
Ensure data quality by creating control measures and participating in data‑related projects.
Analyze business processes, identify inefficiencies, and drive optimization initiatives.
Investigate and resolve data issues such as discrepancies, missing information, and quality gaps.
Prepare forecasts, perform ad‑hoc analyses, and present insights to stakeholders while supporting data‑driven decision‑making.


What we expect from you:


Bachelor's degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field.
2–3 years of experience in data analytics, business analytics, or a similar field.
Experience in the logistics or transportation sector is considered an advantage.
Good command of English (spoken and written).Excellent Excel skills.Experience working with SQL, data modeling, and large datasets.
Experience with SAP, Power BI, or other BI tools is a strong advantage.
Ability to analyze large data volumes, systematize findings, summarize results, and provide clear insights.
Result oriented mindset, independence, and strong collaboration skills across departments.


What we offer:

We always have a challenge for those looking for one. If complex, large-scale, and impactful projects excite you, we might be just the right fit for you. With us, you will enjoy:


Career opportunities: Many of our managers have started in entry-level positions at Girteka Group, and as many as 30% of our colleagues move up the career ladder every year.
Learning and development: We continuously invest in a wide variety of internal and external courses, seminars, mentoring, leadership programs, and offer language courses.
Health and well-being: We care about how our colleagues feel and we offer them comprehensive health insurance. We also foster a community of gym-goers and athletes. On-site meals are 50% compensated, and you’ll find free fruit and snacks in our kitchenettes and lounges.
Collaborative culture: We believe that the power of teamwork and social connection enables us to achieve exceptional results. Working in international teams, we strive toward the company’s goals together, sharing experiences and celebrating our joint successes.
Rewards and recognition: Rewards on work anniversary occasions and values-based behavior, days off during your birthday, and holiday gifts are included. Team-building events, various initiatives, and like-minded clubs. Access to exclusive discounts from our partners.
Base monthly salary: from €2930 to €3670 (before tax). The specific salary offered will depend on the candidate‘s experience, competencies displayed and suitability to the requirements of the position.

Description:
The Role:

We’re looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join our Data Science team and turn complex data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions. In this role, you’ll work with large and diverse datasets, uncover patterns and opportunities, and use advanced analytics to help solve real business challenges.

If you’re naturally curious, enjoy tackling complex problems, and are passionate about transforming data into actionable insights, this is an opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.




The main responsibilities of the position include:

Apply statistical analysis and data mining techniques to extract meaningful insights from large datasets
Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies
Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate insights and monitor key business metrics.
Support the evaluation and assessment of machine learning models through data analysis and performance reporting.
Contribute to the development of the department’s data science strategy and identify opportunities where data science can deliver business value

Collaborate with cross-functional teams including data engineers, data scientists, software engineers, product owners, and business stakeholders

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

Title: Financial Data Analyst
Description:
Financial Data Analyst (Reconciliation, Reporting & FP&A)

Riga

Hybrid: up to 2 remote working days weekly




We are looking for a finance-minded Financial Data Analyst with strong financial planning and analysis experience to join our dynamic team in our vibrant office in Riga.

In this global role, you will combine ownership of our client-book reconciliation process with hands-on support for budgeting, forecasting and performance management. You will work closely with Finance and department heads across the business to ensure data integrity, accurate financial reporting, robust planning inputs, and clear visibility of performance against budget.




Your analytical mindset and understanding of accounting logic and financial data flows will help to identify discrepancies, trace their root causes and design efficient solutions.

Beyond reconciliation work, you’ll use your technical skills in SQL, databases, Power BI and Excel to automate processes, build insightful dashboards, prepare budgets and forecasts, and turn budget-versus-actual performance into practical insight for business decision-making.




Our mission

3S Money is reinventing international business banking. Founded in 2018, our mission is to help growing businesses send, receive and exchange money in over 190 countries. With offices in five countries and over 180 employees, you’ll be joining a high-energy, high-impact team that’s achieved profitability and has a wealth of opportunity ahead.




Our culture

At 3S Money, we believe in caring personally, staying curious and making an impact through collaboration not competition. Our culture is genuinely transparent with minimal hierarchy and a commitment to each employee’s professional growth.




Our team

We're a team driven by data, financial insight and collaboration, and we're looking for someone who can connect detailed financial information with the wider commercial picture.

If you enjoy improving financial processes, working with department heads on budgets and forecasts, and turning variances into meaningful insight that shapes business decisions, we’d love to meet you!




What you’ll be doing

· Take end‑to‑end ownership of the client‑book reconciliation process, including running reconciliations, analysing and resolving discrepancies across multiple systems

· Maintain and enhance reconciliation reporting in Power BI, including investigating reconciliation breaks across Power BI, source systems, and underlying datasets to identify root causes and fixes where required.

· Support the automation of reconciliation workflows in close collaboration with Finance, Settlements, and Operations teams.

· Analyse operational and financial data, support ad-hoc reporting and analytical requests, and contribute to improvements in data quality, reporting accuracy, and reporting processes.

· Support Finance and Operations teams with reporting, and ad-hoc data requests, ensuring timely follow-up, resolution, and escalation where required.

· Prepare budget forecasts and periodic re-forecasts, working with Finance to consolidate, validate and challenge inputs across departments.

· Help manage the annual and periodic budgeting process, liaising with department heads and other key stakeholders to gather, challenge and align budget assumptions.

· Prepare regular budget-versus-actual analysis, investigate material variances, and explain the key drivers of performance to Finance and relevant department heads.

· Partner with department heads to monitor performance against budget, identify risks and opportunities early, and agree actions to keep plans on track.

· Support business decisions by assessing their financial impact and helping stakeholders ensure that proposed actions are consistent with approved budgets and forecasts.




About you, you have

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in an FP&A, finance, accounting, audit or data-related role, with meaningful involvement in budgeting, forecasting, management reporting and financial analysis.

• Hands-on experience analysing budget-versus-actual variances, presenting results in a clear, structured way and ability to translate analysis into practical actions.

• Solid understanding of accounting principles and financial concepts, including confidence working with ledgers, balances, and transaction flows.

• Practical experience with Power BI for maintaining and supporting operational and financial reporting.

• Comfortable working with SQL and Microsoft Excel for analysing, validating, and reconciling data.

• Experience - or strong interest - in automating repeatable reporting or reconciliation processes, including exposure to Power Automate or similar workflow automation tools.

• Experience working with business stakeholders to collect requirements, clarify ambiguous needs, and translate them into structured reporting or data solutions.

• Comfortable working independently in execution: able to drive analysis, structure problems, and move work forward without step-by-step guidance.

• Good judgment on when to escalate: able to bring clear context and structured options when input or alignment is needed.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

• Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration (or Mathematics, Statistics, or Computer Science if combined with proven experience working with financial data).




In return for your hard work:

💰 Salary starting from €3,500, stock options (after 12 months) & benefits

💻 Hybrid working setup in our wonderful city-centre office

📚 We foster non-BAU projects in our team, we want you to explore new avenues and expand your expertise to benefit your professional pathway & our teams.

And much, much more….




Our commitment to you

We are an equal opportunities employer.

We make recruiting decisions based on your experience, skills and personality. Our passion and focus will always be to work with the best people. We’re creating services for everyone, so it’s imperative we work with everyone. Our diverse team has been the foundations to our success in building more efficient products, making better decisions and establishing an all-inclusive place to work. Applicants of all backgrounds are hugely encouraged to apply and discover the 3S way.

Title: Data Analytics Engineer
Description:
VIA is making an impact, and so can you.

VIA is the digital infrastructure company mission-critical organizations rely on when speed and security matter most. The Department of War, government agencies, and global enterprises depend on VIA to disrupt corruption, defend critical infrastructure, and deliver humanitarian aid. VIA’s products span agentic AI, zero-trust identity, quantum-resistant data, and offline stablecoin payments. Every human and agentic AI action is intentionally captured, attributed, and defensible. Designed for sub-second speed and multi-decade defensibility.

An impressive mission requires an equally impressive Data Analytics Engineer.

As a Data Analytics Engineer at VIA, you'll play a pivotal role in the growth of our solutions. You'll turn raw, complex, and often ambiguous data into the clear, trusted narratives that power VIA's data products and guide our customers' decisions. Operating on a high-velocity Agile team, you'll work cross-functionally with software engineers, data peers, and client delivery professionals to lead data initiatives end to end, in an environment where precision, security, and clarity are non-negotiable.

In This Role, You Will:

Understand the data and the domain


Partner with VIA's client delivery team and customers to translate domain knowledge into data infrastructure requirements, validate assumptions, and resolve data-related issues
Explore customer data to build a clear picture of contents and characteristics (e.g. averages, expected ranges, trends, standard deviations) and make suggestions for data cleaning and analysis


Build AI-powered data products


Deliver data-based products to external customers, including interactive data analysis and investigation platforms, data quality reports, statistical analysis, and visualizations that turn complex findings into clear stories
Build AI into VIA's data products, for example through automated insights, anomaly detection, AI-assisted data quality checks, and natural-language interfaces over operational data
Evaluate the quality and reliability of AI/ML outputs against domain expectations, and design the human-in-the-loop checks that keep our data products trustworthy


Oversee data pipelines


Own the design, quality, and reliability of ETL/ELT pipelines, including work built with AI assistance
Coordinate with internal stakeholders and customers when information is missing or discrepancies are found
Run quality control on data and data products through both automated tests and targeted manual review, and document the assumptions and decisions made along the way so the work stays traceable


Improve the platform


Contribute to the continual improvement of internal tools for data cleaning, modeling and analytics, and data quality assessment by identifying key data-related challenges that are ideal candidates for automation and AI enhancement


Requirements

What you will bring to this role:


3+ years of experience in a data-driven role or equivalent in data-related research projects
Bachelor’s or Master's degree in science, mathematics, engineering, or a data-driven field
Competence in Python, R, or equivalent programming language
Competence in at least two of the following technologies:
Database technologies (e.g., SQL, PostgreSQL)
Data science libraries (e.g., NumPy, pandas)
Data pipelining workflows and tools (e.g., Dagster, Airflow, dbt)
Cloud providers (e.g. AWS, Azure), including software development kits used to access data and services on these platforms
Ability to translate complex data findings into clear, compelling narratives
Strong communication capability to decompose complex operational workflows into clear, repeatable steps that both teammates and AI tools can act on
Passionate about data integrity, with a proven track record of transforming raw inputs into high quality, trusted datasets
A self-starter attitude and demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly
Experience in the following is a plus:
Generative AI tools (e.g. AWS Bedrock, LangChain)
Testing frameworks (e.g. pytest)


What does it take to be a successful VIAneer? Let’s break it down, our VIAneers are:


Self-motivated and passionate about leaving everything they touch better than how they found it
Firm believers that people should love what they do and are eager to build a culture that enables them to do their best work
Creative problem solvers who respectfully challenge the status quo in the pursuit of excellence
People who lead discussions with curiosity and value diverse perspectives
Eager to explore new ideas, understand the power of feedback, and constantly seek opportunities to grow and develop their skills
Strong team players who thrive in collaborative environments and celebrate the success of others


Benefits

What can VIA do for you?

VIA Offers Competitive Benefits, Flexible Work Options, And Individualized Mentoring And Growth Opportunities. Here Are Just a Few Of Our VIAneers’ Favorite Perks:


Compensation:
This role offers a salary range of $100,000 - $130,000 USD per year
401K plan with up to 5% employer contribution
Health: A fully funded, top-tier health benefits plan, including vision and dental coverage, fully covered from day one, for your whole family
Family Support: Up to 24 weeks paid parental leave, a 4-week paid ramp-back program, and a $10K family forming benefit (covering fertility treatments, adoption, and surrogacy)
Time off: Flexible Vacation Policy with no set annual limit or accrual period, Summer Fridays, and an extended holiday period in December
Remote work: Ability to enjoy the best of both worlds with flexibility to work from home as needed, as well as access to three well-located offices, designed for collaboration and stocked with everything you could need
Opportunities to work remotely from eligible locations for up to 2 months per year
Growth: Individualized growth opportunities, including internal and external mentorship panels, custom goals and feedback sessions, and/or access to learning and development programs, including VIA’s unrivaled leadership program
A dedicated wellness advisor to help you navigate the programs and opportunities available at VIA
Transit: Benefits to support commuting costs
Connection: In-person events to foster team bonding and collaboration across different teams

Description:
KCC seeks a Property Data Specialist to join our growing team of risk modeling experts. KCC develops models to estimate the risk from all types of natural perils including tropical cyclones, wildfires, severe convective storms, and earthquakes. KCC scientists and engineers create stochastic sets of potential future scenarios that are overlayed on an exposure dataset of building replacement values. The Property Data Specialist will support the exposure development team in modeling replacement values for countries around the world.

Karen Clark & Company (KCC) is the innovation and technology leader in catastrophe risk modeling. KCC professionals are globally recognized experts in catastrophe modeling and risk management. Title: Growth Analyst
Description:
Who We AreButcherBox is a certified B Corp headquartered in Boston, and honored to be celebrating our fourth year in a row on Inc.'s list of Best Workplaces. At ButcherBox, we believe in better. That’s why we deliver 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef, free-range organic chicken, pork raised crate-free, and wild-caught seafood directly to our members’ doors. All of our products are humanely raised or wild-caught and never given antibiotics or added hormones ever. We’re working to build a world that’s better for all, and we’re inviting everyone to come along. For us, better means treating our planet with respect. It means improving the lives of animals and the livelihoods of farmers. It means never cutting corners when it comes to doing business. Ultimately, it means better meals, enjoyed together. Our team is made up of people who collaborate and support one another. We’re always looking for outstanding people to join our mission! 

About the Role

Department: Commercial Operations

Reports To: Associate Director of Commercial & Marketing Analytics

Location: Watertown, MA - in office 3 days/week 

Level: Individual Contributor, mid-level

Base Salary: $103,000 - $120,000

 

About the Role

ButcherBox is looking for a Growth Analyst to own new member acquisition analytics. This isn't a build-dashboards-and-hand-off-findings role. You'll identify opportunities, design tests, drive analysis, and follow it through to a decision. The expectation is that you're the connective tissue between data and action; not just telling us what the numbers say, but making sure something happens because of it. 

Our marketing and commercial teams embrace a hybrid model that provides personal flexibility as well as in-person collaboration. The ideal candidate will find value in coming to our Watertown office two to three days per week. You’ll be embedded in the growth team, owning critical metrics alongside them and supporting weekly channel deep dives. 

Responsibilities

Own analysis across paid (social, SEM, affiliate) and non-digital channels (TV, radio, podcast, OOH), plus site funnel and lead/email flow — from surfacing what's happening to advising what to do next 
Design, analyze, and report on A/B and incrementality tests with a bias toward action and iteration 
Build and maintain self-service reporting tools and data resources that enable self-service analytics by the growth team 
Lead the development of our next phase of media attribution, including MTA and media mix  
Build a deep understanding of the new member journey (predictive LTV, LTV:CPA, funnel conversion) and use it to sharpen acquisition strategy 
Translate analytical findings into decisions in partnership with the growth marketing team 
Drive work from question to answer to outcome, including identifying and resolving whatever's in the way 

Qualifications

Excellent SQL skills; proficiency in Power BI or other visualization tools 
Experience in paid media analytics and growth marketing measurement 
Deep knowledge of incrementality testing, multi-touch attribution, media mix modeling, and other measurement tools 
Strong sense of “so what?”, driving action through analysis 
Comfort working in a fast paced environment where decisions cannot wait to be made 
Ability to translate technical analysis into clear, specific recommendations, communicated clearly and concisely to non-technical stakeholders 
Track record of driving projects to closure in cross-functional environments, including navigating ambiguity and multiple priorities, with a bias towards speed 

 

What We OfferOur ValuesWe are a mission-driven company and strive to embody our values in every step of the process. ButcherBox is driven by relentless improvement, accountability, humility, and customer obsession. We want our workplace to be one of growth and learning where everyone can be safe/comfortable to show up as their authentic self to work. Anyone who loves our products and goals is welcome here! Odyssey Systems has an exciting opportunity for a Journeyman Data Business Analyst supporting the NC3 Contract, specifically the GASNTi1 & GASNTi2 program offices within the Nuclear Networks Division (NCN). The AFNWC/NC3 Integration Directorate is headquartered at Hanscom Air Force Base, MA.

2+ years of experience engaging with clients, gathering requirements, and implementing analytics or visualization solutions
Experience querying and analyzing data to answer questions and solve problems
Experience visualizing data to communicate key insights
Knowledge of business analysis or business intelligence tools and methodologies
Ability to learn quickly and adapt to evolving organizational processes

Experience:

Experience with Microsoft Power Query, Databricks, or SQL for data engineering

Ability to synthesize analytical results and deliver briefings or presentations to product owners and stakeholders

Title: Customer Experience Analyst
Description:
About SimpliSafe

We're a high-tech home security company that's passionate about protecting the life you've built and our mission of keeping Every Home Secure. And we've created a culture here that cares just as deeply about the career you're building. Ours is a no ego culture of collaboration and innovation where those seeking their next challenge can find big opportunities and make a huge impact on the lives of all those who we protect. We don't just want you to work here. We want you to grow and thrive here.

We're embracing a hybrid work model that enables our teams to split their time between office and home. Hybrid for us means we expect our teams to come together in our state-of-the-art office on two core days, typically Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday – working together in person and choosing where they work for the remainder of the week. We all benefit from flexibility and get to use the best of both worlds to get our work done.

Why are we hiring?

Well, we're growing and thriving. So, we need smart, talented, and humble people who share our values to join us as we disrupt the home security space and relentlessly pursue our mission of keeping Every Home Secure.

About The Job

The SimpliSafe CX Analytics team is looking for an Analyst to co-own performance for our rapidly growing Telesales and Loyalty channels — both key strategic priorities for SimpliSafe's future growth. In this role, you won't just measure a team of 150+ agents driving new customer acquisition and subscriber retention — you will help set the strategy that determines whether they succeed.

This is a unique opportunity to build deep, sustained fluency in how Telesales and Loyalty actually operate — and to use that fluency to identify what the business should be doing differently, not just report on what it did. You will define the KPIs that matter, understand what truly drives them, forecast where they're headed, and then support experiments aimed at identifying the right tactics to beat that forecast. You will share accountability for the outcome with Operational leadership, not just for the accuracy of the analysis. Your responsibilities will include:


Own the full KPI lifecycle for Telesales and Loyalty performance: define the right KPIs at the channel and agent level, build and maintain the forecasts for them, and develop a deep understanding of what drives them
Originate and lead experimentation aimed at beating those forecasts — partnering with the business to identify test ideas and ensuring rigorous setup and measurement so the business can trust the read
Get close enough to the operation — the agents, the workflows, the day-to-day realities of Telesales and Loyalty — to spot risks and opportunities Operations can't see from the inside, and bring recommendations to leadership before they ask
Share accountability with Operational leadership for the business results, not just the integrity of the analysis — success is measured by whether Telesales and Loyalty performance improves, not just whether the reporting is right
Serve as data steward for the datasets underlying these KPIs, and use AI tools and automation to eliminate as much manual reporting and one-off analysis as possible — reinvesting that time into the work above


Qualifications:


BS in a quantitative field or equivalent experience (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or related field)
3+ years of equivalent experience, or Masters + 3 years
Strong technical skills, including experience with query and data visualization tools. SQL and Excel are core requirements; experience with Tableau, Hex, or programming languages (Python, R, etc.) is a plus
Track record of proposing ideas and driving them to business impact, not just delivering requested analysis — comfortable being judged on whether the business outcome moved, not only on whether the work was correct
Experience designing and running experiments or pilots — including forming the hypothesis, not just measuring someone else's
Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with extreme attention to detail and the ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic, cross-functional environment
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to synthesize concepts for non-technical audiences and effectively engage partners across all levels of the company
Genuine interest in learning how a complex operation runs day-to-day — willing to spend real time with Ops and agents, not just their data — in order to identify the question behind the question
Comfort using AI tools to accelerate data prep and analysis, so more time goes toward business understanding and origination
Experience supporting contact center operations is a plus


What Values You'll Share


Customer Obsessed - Building deep empathy for our customers, putting them at the core of our work, and developing strong, long-term relationships with them.
Aim High - Always challenging ourselves and others to raise the bar.
No Ego - Maintaining a "no job too small" attitude, and an open, inclusive and humble style.
One Team - Taking a highly collaborative approach to achieving success.
Lift As We Climb - Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed.
Lean & Nimble - Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment.


What We Offer


A mission- and values-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive
A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families (For more information on our total rewards please click here)
Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home.
Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change.


The target annual base pay range for this role is $80,000 to $105,000

This target annual base pay range represents our good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role. We use a market-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees' job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors.

Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. More details can be found here.

We're committed to fair and equitable pay practices, as well as pay transparency. We regularly review our programs to ensure they remain competitive and aligned with our values.

We wholeheartedly embrace and actively seek applications from all individuals, no matter how they identify. We are committed to cultivating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe our work is enriched when we incorporate a multitude of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. We want everyone who works here to thrive and contribute to not only our mission of keeping every home secure, but also to making our workplace safe and supportive for others. If a reasonable accommodation may be needed to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of a position, or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact careers@simplisafe.com.

Title: Compliance Data and Reporting Analyst
Description:
Summary

The Compliance Data and Reporting Analyst (“CDRA”) is part of the Brown University Health Corporate Compliance team and reports to the Manager of Compliance and Program Effectiveness. This position serves as a key member of the compliance team and data analyst for compliance and privacy reporting matters. The CDRA is responsible for assisting the compliance team with facilitating, executing, monitoring the overall management of the compliance, policy & privacy, and revenue compliance data and reporting functions. Will assist with general audit projects.

Principal Duties And Responsibilities

Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization’s values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another.

Data Analyst


Design business analysis and data recording systems for use throughout the department.
Maintain databases and perform updates as necessary to ensure accuracy.
Track and identify trends in reported compliance issues and inquiries.
Regularly examine data reports to locate and resolve mistakes throughout.
Accurately analyze and collect data for various types of business reports.
Create business reports and dashboards that provide insight into key data points.
Communicate the results of data analysis in written and verbal form to managers.
Assists the Team with the maintenance of electronic data management systems in use in the Department. Including but not limited to – NAVEX; Imprivata; MDaudit; COI -Smart; Intelligent Contracts


Privacy


Assists the Privacy team with the coordination, development, facilitation, and enhancement of the Privacy Program through reporting trends, metrics and dashboards.
Assists the VP and Manager with coordinating system wide privacy and compliance projects which may include working closely with Information Security, Information Services, Human Resources, or operations teams to identify and implement process or system changes.
Responsible for the collection and analysis of privacy program data and analytics and development of standard and ad hoc reports.
Provides support to privacy-related initiatives including the planning and performance of privacy-based risk assessments and data-inventory processes. 
Provides support to the VP and Department Manager(s) and members of the compliance team in meeting federal and state reporting requirements, including the Office for Civil Rights, regarding breach notification and follow-up investigations.
Maintains a working knowledge of relevant privacy laws, regulations, rules, and standards and keeps abreast of privacy trends.
Assists the Manager and VP with requests for data sharing with external entities.


Compliance and Revenue Compliance


Assisting the Compliance Team with the management of general audits identified on the Annual Workplan and other audits as needed.
Develop and facilitate designated monitoring activities to assess compliance with policies. Responsible for ensuring monitoring is occurring on a consistent basis.
Assists with implementation of compliance training and education.
Supports the activities of the System Compliance Committee and Audit & Risk Committee, and implementation of the Compliance work plan.
Develop a strong understanding of the Compliance Services software tools to help optimize each tool to full potential.
Participates in committees and work groups representing Compliance as requested.
Handles all compliance and privacy matters with sensitivity and maintains strict confidentiality of all work material and activities.
At the direction of the Manager performs special projects related to Compliance.
Supports the development and implementation of a sustainable Privacy and Compliance management program.
Performs other duties as assigned.


Education


Bachelor’s degree and at least a minimum of 2 years’ experience working as a data analyst, preferably in healthcare. Master’s degree preferred.


Experience

The ideal candidate will have strong data analytics skills. While we understand that no candidate will possess every skill listed, a minimum requirement for this position is proficiency in data analytics, including development of data driven reports, dashboards, and use of data analytics tools.


Demonstrated ability to manage time and prioritize projects to meet deadlines
Ability to use SQL and Microsoft Excel to create pivot tables, graphs and charts. Experience with Tableau and/or Microsoft PowerBI
Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively relate data to coworkers
Tendency to pay close attention to small details that could impact results
Certification/Licensure: Certification in Healthcare Compliance (CHC) required within 12 months of hire.
Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Skills Required.


Experience with Artificial Intelligence; Imprivata/or Privacy Surveillance software, NAVEX/Compliance Tracking Software; Revenue Cycle Audit solutions, and electronic health records preferred

Supervisory Responsibility

None

Ocean Spray is hiring for a(n) Data Visualization Analyst! We’re a team of farmers, thinkers, creators, and doers. Whatever your title, whatever your role — it always comes back to this: we’re a farmer-owned co-op where everyone rolls up their sleeves to get the job done. Three maverick farmers started it all — and we’ve been making our own way ever since.

Role

The Data Visualization Analyst role is designed to help the commercial teams extract, summarize and visualize relevant past performance metrics to drive future performance. It requires a creative thinker who has the ability to transform ideas into actionable tolls that help teams deliver their objectives. This role will:


Work across multiple business teams learning how they operate, understanding insights they need to make decisions
Analyze information from multiple data sources, external and internal to identify business drivers that affect growth and efficiency
Design reports, tools and tracking mechanisms
Translate ideas into tangible output


A Day in the Life...


Delivering insights using compelling Power BI or SAC visualization techniques for business team.
Ability to translate business needs into actionable reporting and visualization thru rapid prototyping and storytelling.
Building models and designing experiments that seek to uncover insights that drive performance.
Analyzing complex data made of unstructured, semi-structured and structured datasets to drive insights.
Active participant in designing creative new ways to use data to help commercial team drive growth.
Work in an environment with internal IT, business teams and external vendors to design and scale work-flows, templates and dashboards .


What We Are Looking For


BA/BS in computer science or related field or equivalent relevant experience, preferably with a focus on data visualization
Minimum 5 years of related experience
Extensive experience with Data Visualization using tools like PowerBI (preferred) and Tableau
Demonstrate ability to work effectively with others within a complex, cross-functional and fast paced organization
Excellent communication. Ability to present ideas and insights to business stakeholders
CPG industry knowledge


Education

Bachelor's or University Degree (Required)

Work Experience

At least 3 Years of Experience

Annual Salary

$87,400 - $120,230

Certain positions may be eligible for short-term and long-term incentive rewards. We also offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that supports all aspects of your health and well-being.

Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
Health savings account

Life and accident insurance
Employee assistance program
Telehealth services
1:1 health coaching
Supportive benefits for all the stages of your life

Flexible scheduling options

Career development and growth opportunities

Access to LinkedIn Learning

Parental leave
Bright Horizons Family Solutions – Back-up care, tutoring, etc.
Adoption assistance
Bereavement leave

Up to $300 massage reimbursement
Employee appreciation events
Employee discounts
Charitable giving

You might have our iconic cranberry juice in your fridge or have gotten into heated holiday debate about what’s better - canned or fresh cranberry sauce. Title: CEMA Business Intel Analyst
Description:
Job Description


Do you love to improve business processes and drive improvement through data analytics? Are you looking for a role that supports a diverse and growing portfolio developing and producing the most advanced electronic systems that protect our warfighters? Are you inspired to join an organization with a strong culture that’s focused on ensuring we hear all voices, being brilliant on the basics, and developing our teams and leaders? BAE systems put our customers first – exemplified by our mission “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®. Come join our team!

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst who will partner with a diverse team of directors, managers, engineers, technicians, and operators to develop solutions for gathering and analyzing data to help overcome challenges and improve business execution. The role requires use of your process knowledge to rapidly translate complex data into actionable insights, improving data accuracy and automation to accelerate ramp to rate, and serve as the factory‑floor liaison to ensure that quantitative findings lead to tangible quality and throughput gains. Candidates must have strong analytical, statistical, and communication skills, a solid foundation in manufacturing processes, and thrive in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.



Key Responsibilities



Partner with cross‑functional teams to turn production data into insights that boost product yield, flow, and cost efficiency.
Be a spokesperson for the factories and get involved in the design, testing, and implementation of dashboards and other data tools with the Analytics Team.
Use data analysis to determine areas for improved process yields, flows, on-time delivery and cost savings measures.
Work directly with the process and product teams to implement improvements.
Champion the implementation of AI solutions and assistants to the factory end users.


If you want an exciting opportunity in a fast-paced environment, where you can partner with a diverse team and contribute to our mission, then this position will provide tremendous professional and personal satisfaction.



Required Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related work experience
Experience with manufacturing standards, processes and techniques
Strong technical skills in data analysis
Strong communication skills
Experience working in cross functional teams
Experience using dashboards and reporting for business intelligence
Experience using GenAI models for analysis




Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a technical field
Background in data analytics or data science
Experience with Mat lab, Python, SQL, or other programming language
Experience in project management
Process or Product Engineering experience
New product introduction experience
Proven success with change management in a fast-paced, manufacturing environment



Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $118095 - $200762

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems Electronic Systems


BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Electronic Systems (ES) is the global innovator behind BAE Systems’ game-changing defense and commercial electronics. Exploiting every electron, we push the limits of what is possible, giving our customers the edge and our employees opportunities to change the world. Our products and capabilities can be found everywhere – from the depths of the ocean to the far reaches of space. At our core are more than 14,000 highly talented Electronic Systems employees with the brightest minds in the industry, we make an impact – for our customers and the communities we serve.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We’re looking for a curious, thoughtful Data Analyst who enjoys turning data into answers that people can actually use.




In this role, you’ll work with different teams to understand what’s happening in the business, dig into the numbers, and help people make better decisions. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working with data but also knows that good analysis is about more than spreadsheets—it’s about asking the right questions and explaining what the numbers mean.




You’ll have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects, improve reporting and processes, and help the team see the bigger picture through data.




What You’ll Do




Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and areas that need attention.
Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and regular business insights.
Work with stakeholders to understand their questions and translate them into practical analysis.
Clean, organize, and validate data to make sure it is accurate and reliable.
Use SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools to explore and communicate findings.
Present your findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Work closely with teams across the business to support data-driven decisions.
Look for ways to improve existing reports, processes, and how we use data.
Take ownership of your work while asking questions when you need context or clarification.




What We’re Looking For




Experience working as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
Strong SQL and Excel skills.
Experience with a visualization or BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
Strong attention to detail and a practical approach to problem-solving.
The ability to explain complex information in a simple, clear way.
Good communication skills and the confidence to work with people across different teams.
A naturally curious mindset—you like to understand the “why” behind the numbers.
The ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.




Nice to Have

Experience with Python or another programming language used for data analysis.
Experience working with large or complex datasets.
Knowledge of statistics and basic analytical techniques.
Experience working with cloud data platforms or data warehouses.
Experience in our industry or with similar business problems.




What You Can Expect




You’ll be joining a team where your work will have a real impact. We value people who are willing to ask questions, share ideas, learn from others, and take ownership of their work.




We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. What matters to us is that you’re willing to learn, think critically, and care about doing good work.




If you enjoy working with data, solving real business problems, and helping people make sense of information, we’d love to hear from you.

Title: Supply Chain Planning Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

At Harvey Performance Company, we're more than a team; we're a community. Our thriving, dynamic, and rapidly expanding organization values community, celebrates success, and fosters personal and professional growth opportunities.

The Opportunity

The Planning Analyst builds the data, dashboards, and KPI reporting that support Demand Planning, Production Planning, and inventory optimization at Harvey Performance Company. This is a newly created role for an analyst who can write SQL, build Power BI dashboards, and translate a planner's question into a query and a useful report. You'll work closely with our planning leadership and database team, with direct mentorship and support as you grow into the role. You'll also contribute to a new planning and inventory optimization system going in later this year. Rowley, MA preferred with one day per week onsite. Remote across New England considered for the right candidate.

In This Role, You Will


Build and maintain KPI reporting and dashboards for Demand Planning and Production Planning, covering service performance, inventory health, forecast accuracy, and planning execution.
Write SQL against ERP sources (Epicor P21, SAP, Kinetic) to produce repeatable, validated datasets that planners and buyers can trust.
Develop planning data models in Power BI that surface what matters and leave out what doesn't.
Help establish data validation routines and refresh cadences that create a single source of truth for planning data.
Support tuning of planning parameters (lead times, MOQs, safety stock) alongside Production Planning and Demand Planning.
Contribute to the upcoming inventory optimization and demand planning system rollout, including requirements gathering, field mapping, testing, and post-deployment KPI validation, with guidance from planning leadership.
Partner with IT and the database team on data access and reporting.
Build repeatable analytical workflows that reduce manual effort over time.


You'll Bring


2+ years in analytics, BI, or supply chain/planning analysis, ideally in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Solid SQL skills, including joins and validation logic. You can write queries from scratch, not just modify existing ones.
Power BI experience building dashboards that operating teams actually use.
Familiarity with supply chain basics: PO flow, sales order flow, and planning master data (items, lead times, MOQs, safety stock), or a strong interest in learning them.
Exposure to an ERP system. Epicor or SAP a plus, but any major ERP works.
Ability to translate business questions into analytical solutions and work cross-functionally with IT and operations.
Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain a dashboard to a non-technical stakeholder and a data model to an IT partner.


Nice To Have


Exposure to a planning systems implementation (requirements, field mapping, UAT, post-deployment validation).
Familiarity with a modern demand planning or inventory optimization tool (Kinaxis, o9, Logility, Blue Yonder, OMP, RELEX, SAP IBP, or similar).
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Analytics, Engineering, Finance, MIS, or related field.


Where You'll Work

Find yourself in the heart of Rowley, MA, where our modern facility resides. Experience the balance between vibrant professional growth at Harvey and the soothing, scenic lifestyle of this quaint North Shore town. We champion work-life harmony and invite you to be part of our journey.

What Harvey Provides


A fun, rapid-growing environment where new opportunities are regularly made available.
Opportunities for training and development, including tuition reimbursement.
A comprehensive benefits package, including PTO, paid holidays, health, dental, vision insurance, and a 401k match program, along with profit sharing.


The pay range for this position is $75K to $85K annually. This range reflects what the company reasonably expects to pay at the time of posting. Where an individual’s pay falls within the range will depend on their skills, background, and performance.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Title: Assistant Director of Systems and Data Reporting
Description:
Job Description:

About Brown:

Brown University is a leading research university distinct for its student-centered learning and deep sense of purpose. Our students, faculty and staff are driven by the idea that their work will have an impact in the world.

Brown University offers a flexible work/life balance; summer hours, winter break and a comprehensive Benefits package including time off, annual paid holidays; benefits offerings including health, dental, vision, tuition assistance, retirement, wellness, employee discounts and more. To learn about Brown University’s benefits, visit the University Human Resources web page here for further information.

About the Opportunity:

Brown University’s School of Professional Studies (SPS) brings a Brown education to new audiences of learners: those focused on the development of skills and a breadth of knowledge necessary for professional success and leadership. We leverage Brown’s intellectual centers of excellence, rigorous teaching, and developmental approach to learning in a range of programs, including serving students outside of traditional degree programs. We partner with Brown departments, centers, institutes, and schools to develop degree and non-degree programs, and to support the recruitment, retention, and placement success of master’s students, including traditional, non-traditional, and professional students.

Responsibilities:

The Assistant Director of Systems and Data Reporting analyzes and reports on data for 35+ master’s degree programs, as well as for a portfolio of non-degree courses and certificates managed by the School of Professional Studies (SPS). This individual designs, produces, validates, distributes, and updates both quantitative and qualitative reports, queries, and data visualizations to support data-informed decision making in all facets of SPS’s processes, including the recruitment funnel (program prospects, inquiries, applicants, admission decisions, matriculants, and defers). The Assistant Director provides timely and interpretive reports for the Director of Admissions and Data Analytics, Director of Executive Education, SPS’s Senior Leadership Team, and others to inform recruitment, communication, selection, and enrollment strategies and policies. The incumbent will be expected to make recommendations on how to improve SPS enrollments based on data analysis from multiple sources.

The Assistant Director will work with the Associate Director of Master's Admissions Systems and others to identify data needs and develop tools in relevant systems (Technolutions Slate, Tableau, IBM Cognos Analytics) to address those needs.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree Or Equivalent Education And Experience


Four or more years of experience administering daily systems operations, preferably in a college admissions environment
Experience building CJ-based queries and validating data in Technolutions Slate
Experience building workspaces and workflows in a CRM or relational database
Experience working with integrated student database systems
Demonstrated understanding of complex table joins and database query language
Experience creating data connections between Tableau Server and various data sources
Demonstrated proficiency developing dashboards that are intuitive, impactful, user friendly, multi-faceted, and visually appealing
Experience with manipulating data from a relational database
Ability to craft logic formulas and calculations to display data in a clear way



Preferred


Previous experience in higher education
Degree in business/data analytics, computer science, management information systems or technically related field
Experience with Ellucian Banner or other student information and customer relationship management systems
Experience developing and providing training to a professional and potentially non-technical audience



Salary Grade:

10

Additional Information:

Applicants are asked to include a resume. In a separate document, please also respond to the following questions in lieu of a cover letter (no more than 1-2 pages, please):


Data Integrity & Validation



Please describe your personal process for validating a new query or report before it reaches leadership. What specific "checks" or habits do you use to ensure data remains consistent when moving between systems like Slate, Tableau, and Banner?


Analytical Framework & Decision Support



How do you translate complex metrics into clear recommendations for senior leadership? Additionally, how do you approach designing visualizations so that non-technical stakeholders can make quick, informed decisions?


Data Analysis



Tell us about a time an analysis you completed revealed an unexpected pattern or outcome. What was the situation, how did your analysis highlight this discrepancy, and how did you communicate the findings to your audience? What were the resulting recommendations or actions taken?

Job Title: Senior Digital Analyst

Work Model: Hybrid, Framingham MA

This Senior Digital Analyst will be responsible for driving insights and recommendations related to the end-to-end purchasing customer journey for Staples B2C and B2B digital strategy across both Web and App platforms. This role requires an excellent collaborator, communicator, and analyst with extensive hands-on data experience. The successful candidate is a problem solver in a fast-moving and highly diverse environment and will be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring accuracy and timeliness are not compromised. In addition to strong analytical skills, the Analyst must be adept at communicating findings to senior leadership and business stakeholders across the organization in both verbal and presentation formats.

What you will be doing:


Work closely with Product Management and Digital Experience partners to provide insights and recommendations to improve the end-to-end purchase customer journey, inclusive of the Web and App experiences.
Be the subject matter expert on A/B testing and other experiment methods, providing consultative support and ensuring campaigns are set up to deliver accurate data collection and robust impact measurement.
Build self-service reporting so Analytics and stakeholders have full visibility into how customers are engaging with the site experiences teams own, and are able to identify opportunities for improving the customer experience.
Use your keen analytical skills and business acumen to help solve complex problems, communicate insights, and advance our reporting capabilities.


What You Bring to the Table:


We are looking for a collaborative, intellectually curious problem-solver who thrives in a customer-centric, agile environment.
Strong interpersonal skills, excellent communication and presentation abilities, and critical thinking are essential.
You should be able to break down complex problems, present data in clear, compelling ways, and work effectively with diverse teams.


What’s needed: Basic Qualifications:


Bachelor’s Degree (BA/BS) in Data Analysis, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field or equivalent work experience
2+ years of demonstrated experience as a Data Analyst or related role
2+ years of experience with A/B testing and other experimentation methods (such as pre/post, synthetic control, multi-armed bandits, etc.)
2+ years of experience with data querying / processing languages such as SQL, and Python / R
2+ years of experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, etc.), experience with Adobe Analytics is a plus.


Preferred Qualifications:


Master’s degree in related field
Experience in predictive modeling and machine learning

Inclusive culture with associate-led Business Resource Groups  
Flexible PTO (22 days) and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays)  
Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more! https://careers.staples.com/Staples-Life/Benefits

Title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon Robotics
Description:
Description

We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Business Intelligence Engineer to join the BI Engineering, Analytics, & Data Science (BAND) team supporting Robotic Storage Tech (RST) programs within Amazon Robotics. In this role, you will bring a strong foundation in statistics to support the introduction of new containerized and workcell robotic products — from early concept through deployment. You will partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous questions about new product performance into structured analyses, and author recommendation-focused deliverables that inform program decisions and shape how new robotic systems progress through RST's development lifecycle. You will design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and other analytics artifacts purpose-built for new product introduction — tracking system maturity, surfacing readiness gaps, and enabling data-driven milestone decisions. You are a collaborative problem-solver who thinks holistically about how new systems evolve from prototype to production and uses data to accelerate that journey.

Key job responsibilities


Statistical Analysis for New Products: Execute foundational statistical methods including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, design of experiments, and regression analysis to evaluate new containerized and workcell system performance against readiness criteria at each development phase.
Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Program Managers, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous new product questions into structured analyses that support milestone decisions.
Data Source Development: Identify and onboard data sources from new containerized and workcell systems as they come online, define NPI-relevant metrics, and build data pipelines that enable performance tracking.
Whitepaper & Insights Delivery: Author recommendation-focused whitepapers and deep-dive analyses that inform new product development decisions — including system configuration trade-offs, readiness assessments, and deployment strategy recommendations.
BI Ownership: Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that track new containerized and workcell products through their Alpha, Beta, and General Availability phases, providing visibility into system maturation and operational readiness.


A day in the life

On any given day, you might be helping run a designed experiment to evaluate a configuration change on a new workcell system, building a readiness dashboard for a containerized product approaching its Beta milestone, or authoring a whitepaper that supports a recommendation whether a new system is ready to advance to the next development phase. You will own major components of the BAND team's NPI analytics infrastructure for RST, including contributing to data architecture decisions and delivering reports that track new products from through General Availability.

You will maintain a deep understanding of data lineage across your BI solutions — from the telemetry and event streams generated by new containerized and workcell systems, through metric aggregation processes, to how insights are consumed at milestone reviews and program readiness gates. You will create and optimize scripts (SQL, Python, R, Shell) to streamline BI processes and select appropriate analytics and visualization tools to meet diverse new product evaluation needs.

Your work will directly influence how new containerized and workcell products move through RST's development pipeline and shape the future of Amazon's robotic storage technology landscape.

About The Team

Robotic Storage Tech (RST) invents, designs, and develops transformational storage solutions used in the Amazon Logistic Network. We will realize the next generation of automated containerized systems, and optimize our existing install base. We are a team of talented engineers, product evangelists, and creators focused on technologies that make inventory pick, stow, and count safer and more efficient for Amazon. We deliver value with our elite robotic technologies because we listen and respond to our many customers, develop robust and reliable solutions, and invest in both our people and our products.

Basic Qualifications


3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
Experience writing complex SQL queries
Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

Title: Labor Relations Data and Reporting Analyst
Description:
Company Description

By working at Harvard University, you join a vibrant community that advances Harvard's world-changing mission in meaningful ways, inspires innovation and collaboration, and builds skills and expertise. We are dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming environment where everyone can thrive.

Why join Harvard University Central Administration?

Harvard University's Central Administration (CADM) is a 5,000+ employee organization that supports the university's overall excellence by understanding and serving the needs of its schools, students, faculty, staff, alumni, and surrounding communities. Through dynamic and collaborative partnerships, CADM provides high-quality and efficient services to the schools to help them achieve their goals.

Job Description

Job Summary:

Labor Relations Data and Reporting Analyst at Harvard leveraging strong analytical, communication, and people skills. This role plays a key role in delivering analytics to leaders responsible for strategy and decision-making. A critical aspect of this role is the focus on union data, where you will analyze union membership trends, contract metrics, and other union-related information to inform strategic decisions.

Job Specific Duties:

Collect, analyze, and disseminate union data across various business subject areas within Harvard. Provide support on diverse analyses and reporting services, including conducting complex statistical and quantitative analyses and presenting data through written reports, oral presentations, and graphical displays. Conducts specialized analysis of union staff data to identify trends and insights, providing actionable recommendations to HR leadership and union representatives.

This position will support a variety of operations including, but not limited to, gathering business requirements, serving as the primary contact for the community on using data to answer labor and union contract questions, troubleshooting problems, performing quality assurance of data and applications, providing project support, managing data access, maintaining data dictionaries, and other duties as required within Labor Relations (e.g., QlikView HR Analytics, Operational applications, and SQL).

Typical Core Duties:



Analyze data in a complex union environment, project management and consultative services during union negotiations.
Design and evaluate data sets; generate reports and tables of statistical results using a variety of tools (query and database).
Research, develop, and analyze metrics, particularly focusing on union data, to assist with union metrics and contract negotiations.
Conduct analyses of salary data, including collective bargaining impacts
Ensure compliance with University Human Resources policies, procedures, and applicable legal regulations, including ownership of and a specific focus on union agreements and labor laws.
Using formats that are meaningful to clients, develops dashboards, reports, written management summaries elucidating conclusions, and makes oral presentations when appropriate.
Participate in Union/Management joint committees
Manage policies owned by Labor and Employee Relations.


Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:



Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience required
Minimum of 5 years’ relevant work experience


Additional Qualifications and Skills:



Advanced knowledge of human resources and union specific data.
Experience working in a union environment.
Proficient in MS Office products, advanced Excel skills, experience with Power BI preferred.
Experience with creating and using financial models.
Experience working in higher education administration, business analytics, business intelligence, business administration, and/or information technology.
Strong oral and written communication skills.


Additional Information



Standard Hours/Schedule: 35 hours per week
Visa Sponsorship Information: Harvard University is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position
Pre-Employment Screening: Identity, Education
Other Information:

This position has a 90-day orientation and review period.

Work Format Details

This position has been determined by school or unit leaders that some of the duties and responsibilities can be effectively performed at a non-Harvard location. The work schedule and location will be set by the department at its discretion and based upon operational needs. When not working at a Harvard or Harvard-designated location, employees in hybrid positions must work in a Harvard registered state in compliance with the University’s Policy on Employment Outside of Massachusetts. Additional details will be discussed during the interview process. Certain visa types and funding sources may limit work location. Individuals must meet work location sponsorship requirements prior to employment.

Salary Grade and Ranges

This position is salary grade level 057. Please visit  Harvard's Salary Ranges  to view the corresponding salary range and related information.

Benefits

Harvard offers a comprehensive benefits package that is designed to support a healthy work-life balance and your physical, mental and financial wellbeing. Because here, you are what matters. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:



Generous paid time off including parental leave
Medical, dental, and vision health insurance coverage starting on day one
Retirement plans with university contributions
Wellbeing and mental health resources
Support for families and caregivers
Professional development opportunities including tuition assistance and reimbursement
Commuter benefits, discounts and campus perks


Learn more about these and additional benefits on our Benefits & Wellbeing Page.
