Harvard University is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination. We seek talent from all parts of society and the world, and we strive to ensure everyone at Harvard thrives. Our differences help our community advance Harvard's academic purposes.

Harvard has an equal employment opportunity policy that outlines our commitment to prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified in the university's non-discrimination policy. Harvard's equal employment opportunity policy and non-discrimination policy help all community members participate fully in work and campus life free from harassment and discrimination.

Title: Sales Ops / AI Analyst
Description:
Description

Position Overview

This role sits at the intersection of sales operations and AI-driven process design. You will own sales analytics and reporting, and you will build AI agent workflows that automate manual work and improve rep and team performance. You need to be sharp with data and comfortable building tools, not just requesting them

Requirements

Responsibilities

What You Will Do

Sales Operations


Own sales operations, reporting pipeline, forecast, conversion rates, win rates, quota attainment, and rep productivity metrics.
Build dashboards and reports that leaders use to make decisions
Analyze territory capacity and coverage to identify white space, overloaded reps, and underutilized segments.
Support account segmentation and territory design using data (firmographics, account potential, historical performance).
Identify process breakdowns and inefficiencies across the sales cycle using data, not guesswork.
Partner with sales leadership to translate business problems into automated solutions.
Maintain and improve CRM data quality and workflow logic.
Document workflows and processes so they are repeatable and maintainable.


AI Automation and Agent Workflows


Build AI agents and automations that improve Sales Ops execution: data capture, call and meeting summaries, follow-up drafting, account research, deal risk flags, and forecast narrative support
Create multi-step agent workflows that connect CRM, email, calling tools, and data sources
Own an AI automation backlog and ship improvements weekly based on measurable impact
Define guardrails: where humans must approve, what gets logged to CRM, and how we prevent bad data from spreading
Monitor performance (accuracy, adoption, time saved, pipeline impact) and continuously iterate


Analytics and Insights


Automate dashboards and reporting for pipeline health, funnel conversion and rep activity, attainment
Diagnose bottlenecks and quantify impact, then deploy AI or process changes to fix them
Track ROI of automations: hours saved, speed-to-lead, conversion lift, data completeness, forecast variance
Deliver clear insights to CRO and sales leaders with recommended actions


Qualifications

What You Need:


3+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, or business analytics.
Strong SQL and Excel/spreadsheet skills. Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) required.
Hands-on experience building AI agent workflows or automations (tools like n8n, Zapier, Make, Hatz, or similar; prompt engineering experience a plus).
Salesforce experience including reporting and workflow/automation setup.
Experience with territory planning, account segmentation, or capacity modeling.
Proven ability to turn messy data into clear, actionable insight.
Strong project management skills. You can scope a problem, build a solution, and ship it without heavy oversight.
Comfortable driving change with sales leadership and reps.


Preferred Qualifications


Python and API integration experience
Experience designing human-in-the-loop workflows and evaluation methods for LLM outputs


What Sets a Great Candidate Apart


You have built something before, a dashboard, a bot, an automated workflow, that measurably saved time or improved a number leadership cared about.
You are naturally curious about data and naturally impatient with manual work.
You can explain a complex analysis in one sentence to a VP.


Why This Role Matters

Sales operations only create value when insight turns into action. This role closes that gap by pairing sharp analytics with the automation to act on it fast.

Title: Interoperability Operations Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

Zus is a shared health data platform designed to accelerate healthcare data interoperability by providing easy-to-use patient data via API, embedded components, and direct EHR integrations. Founded in 2021 by Jonathan Bush, co-founder and former CEO of athenahealth, Zus partners with HIEs and other data networks to aggregate patient clinical history and then translates that history into user-friendly information at the point of care. Zus's mission is to catalyze healthcare's greatest inventors by maximizing the value of patient insights - so that they can build up, not around.

What we're looking for:

Every customer on the Zus network should have access to the most comprehensive clinical data possible and should understand exactly what they have. As Interoperability Operations Analyst, you'll build the metrics, intelligence, and tooling that make that possible. You'll dig into where coverage is strong and where it's thin, surface the reasons why, and partner with support and solutions teams to close the gaps. When the right fix is a query, you'll write it. When it's an automated workflow, you'll build it.

This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable in a SQL editor and a Python script, gets genuinely curious about unexplained patterns in data, and is excited about using AI tools to work faster and smarter. You'll sit at the intersection of data, operations, and product. Your insights will shape how the network grows and how we serve our customers.

As part of our team, you will be focused on...

Coverage Intelligence


Build and maintain the metrics and dashboards that track clinical data coverage across the Zus network — by geography, network, data type, and customer
Identify coverage gaps and anomalies, investigate root causes, and communicate findings clearly to customers and internal stakeholders
Deliver the regular coverage intelligence that helps every customer understand the depth and breadth of their data — and what's driving any gaps



Operations Partnership


Work closely with support and solutions teams to translate coverage findings into operational actions — escalations, network outreach, configuration changes
Develop and maintain playbooks for recurring coverage issues, turning one-off investigations into repeatable processes
Contribute to onboarding quality by flagging patterns in new participant data that suggest connectivity or configuration problems



Tooling & Automation


Build internal tools, scripts, and automated workflows that reduce manual analysis and surface insights faster
Experiment with AI tools (including Claude) and BI platforms to accelerate how the team operates
Partner with engineering and product to ensure the systems we rely on generate the signals we need



Product Feedback Loop


Translate operational data into product requirements — if a coverage gap is systematic, you'll articulate why it's a product problem and what solving it would require
Partner with UX and engineering to shape internal and customer-facing experiences that make coverage intelligence intuitive and actionable



You're a good fit because you have...


SQL fluency: You write queries naturally and reach for them first when you have a question about data. Experience with BI tools (Looker, Metabase, Tableau, etc.) is a plus
Automation instinct: You don't accept manual work as permanent. You're comfortable in Python and curious about AI-assisted workflows — you'd rather build a system than repeat a task
Analytical curiosity: You notice when numbers don't add up and you follow the thread. You're comfortable sitting with ambiguous data and forming hypotheses
Clear communicator: You can translate a coverage analysis into a crisp, jargon-free narrative for a customer or an executive
Healthcare interest: Prior exposure to clinical data formats ( FHIR , HL7 , C-CDA ) or the provider/ EMR ecosystem is a plus, but a genuine interest in how healthcare data flows is what matters most



Why this role matters...

Data coverage is one of the most tangible levers for customer value at Zus and right now, the infrastructure for understanding and improving it is still being built. You'll have real ownership over that build: the metrics, the tooling, and the feedback loops that help the network get better over time. The work compounds.

$80,000 - $130,000 a year

We will offer you…


Competitive compensation that reflects the value you bring to the team a combination of cash and equity
Robust benefits that include health insurance, wellness benefits, 401k with a match, unlimited PTO
Opportunity to work alongside a passionate team that is determined to help change the world (and have fun doing it)



Please Note: Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don’t apply unless they meet 100% of the job criteria. While we have worked to consolidate the minimum qualifications for each role, we aren’t looking for someone who checks each box on a page; we’re looking for active learners and people who care about disrupting the current healthcare system with their unique experiences.

We do not conduct interviews by text nor will we send you a job offer unless you've interviewed with multiple people, including the Director of People & Talent, over video interviews. Job scams do exist so please be careful with your personal information.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Technical Programs Analyst
Description:
The Technical Programs Analyst combines hands-on technical and analytical work with program ownership to support the Engineering Technical Programs function. You'll work with data across systems, build the reporting that gives leadership visibility, and take ownership of initiatives as they arise. This role is for a technically savvy, resourceful problem-solver who can navigate ambiguity and find a path forward independently. It's a high-visibility role with room to grow into broader program ownership and will be hybrid out of our Wakefield or Boston office.

Responsibilities

Analysis & Tooling

Pull, connect, and analyze data across multiple systems (e.g., via APIs and queries) to answer questions and surface insights.
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that give visibility into engineering delivery, spend, and tooling.
Identify opportunities to automate manual work and improve how the team gets and uses information.

Program Delivery

Take ownership of programs and initiatives as they arise, driving them from request through delivery.
Coordinate the people, tasks, and timelines needed to deliver outcomes effectively.
Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and action items, and follow up on open items to closure.

Vendor & Spend Tracking

Maintain a clear view of technology vendors and spend — cost, renewals, and usage.
Surface optimization opportunities such as underused licenses or duplicate tools for leadership decisions.

Reporting & Operating Rhythm

Produce clear status updates and recurring reports for engineering leadership.
Keep systems of record accurate and support the team's regular cadence of reviews and planning.

Requirements:

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
Experience: Minimum 3 years in an analyst, program, or related role in a technology or engineering environment.
Technical Skills: Comfort working with data and APIs; ability to pull, join, and analyze data from multiple sources; familiarity with reporting/dashboarding tools and tools like Jira, Confluence, or Smartsheet. Some scripting or query experience (SQL, Python, or similar) is a strong plus.
Core Skills: Resourceful problem-solver who can navigate ambiguity, strong analytical thinking, clear communication, and the drive to figure things out independently and follow through.

As a Manager, Advanced Data Analytics in the Advanced Analytics and Customer Insights organization you would have the opportunity to directly contribute towards this future. You'll be embedded in our Digital Assets business and will partner together to help support and evolve Fidelity Digital Assets® offerings that demonstrate Fidelity’s commitment to customer value and high customer experience standards.

Create and summarizes large datasets in structured and unstructured data.

Work across diverse skilled teams to find success for Fidelity and our customers.

Title: Customer Insights Analyst
Description:
Reporting to: SVP, Strategic Analytics

Department: Strategic Analytics

Location: Boston, MA (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Grand Circle Corporation is the leader in international travel, adventure and discovery for Americans aged 50+. Headquartered in Boston MA, and with more than 35 offices globally, more than two million Americans have traveled with our award-winning travel brands: Grand Circle Cruise Line, Overseas Adventure Travel and Grand Circle Travel.

We’re looking for a Customer Insights Analyst to transform how we understand and predict customer behavior. Embedded within the Strategic Analytics department, you will use data to shape brand development and bring value to customers and business teams. This role sits at the intersection of advanced analytics, customer intelligence, and business strategy.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze customer behavior patterns to identify actionable insights and opportunities for targeted marketing interventions
Collaborate with data engineering and BI to ensure data quality and reporting accessibility
Define and monitor KPIs that align with business objectives
Build conceptual dashboards that track customer journeys and identify optimization opportunities
Partner with brand, marketing, and other business teams to translate analytical findings into measurable business impact
Tell data-driven stories that convince and influence leaders using clear insights and recommendations
Develop predictive models for key business metrics including churn, lifetime value, and propensity scoring
Design and run experiments to test hypotheses about customer engagement and measure impact of strategic initiatives


Qualifications


2+ years in data analysis, preferably in a subscription or loyalty focused B2C environment
Advanced SQL proficiency (complex queries, window functions, and optimization)
Strong statistical foundation with hands-on experience in regression, classification, clustering, and time series analysis
Proficiency in Python or R for analysis and modeling
Experience with BI tools (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker, or similar)
Proven ability to communicate the results and recommendations of your analysis to senior leadership
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or quantitative field


Technical Skills


Experience working with cloud data warehouses and large-scale datasets
Proficiency with version control and collaborative development practices
Understanding of data pipeline concepts and ETL processes
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms and services
Knowledge of data governance and security best practices


Nice to Have


Experience with customer data platforms or marketing automation
Knowledge of machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow)
A/B testing and experimental design expertise
Familiarity with causal inference methodologies and experimentation techniques
Prior experience in travel or hospitality industry


Total Rewards

The base salary range for this role is $110,000 – $130,000 annually for employees based in Boston, MA. Final compensation may vary and will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for an annual incentive bonus and first-class benefits, which include:


Health & wellness: Comprehensive and heavily subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans, plus on-site gym access, holistic wellness sessions, and group fitness classes
Time for you: Substantial Paid Time Off (PTO), and 11 paid holidays- including Juneteenth, Memorial Day, and Labor Day – and Summer Fridays. Plus- extensive parental leave, with up to 12-16 weeks paid leave at 100% base salary.
Travel more, spend less: 50% off our trips for you and a companion, 25% for additional immediate family members, and exclusive quarterly associate travel deals
Your future, secured: 401(k) with company match, life insurance, and disability coverage
Continuous growth: Tuition assistance for both professional and personal development, opportunities for professional development through oversees travel, and direct access to Pinnacle Leadership & Team Development.
Extra perks: Commuter benefits, FSA options, pet insurance, home & auto discounts, and paid volunteer time off to give back to the community


To learn more, please visit our websites at www.gct.com, www.oattravel.com and www.grandcirclefoundation.org.

We are the global test and automation specialists, powering next-generation technologies through sophisticated solutions. Behind every electronic device you use, Teradyne's test technology ensures your device works right the first time, every time! Our portfolio of automation solutions help manufacturers to develop and deliver products quickly, efficiently and cost-effectively. Together, Teradyne companies deliver manufacturing automation across industries and applications around the world!

We attract, develop, and retain a high-performance workforce, comprised of people with diverse backgrounds and a shared drive for excellence. We strive to foster a positive and inclusive work environment that helps employees, and communities, thrive.

Our Purpose

TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day.

We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.

Opportunity Overview

Teradyne is seeking a Data Governance Analyst to design, implement, and scale data governance capabilities across enterprise data domains including Customer, Supplier, and Product data. This role bridges data governance policy and technical execution, ensuring data is trusted, discoverable, compliant, and ready to support analytics, AI, and operational systems such as ERP. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with data platforms and tooling and enjoys partnering with data owners, stewards, architects, and engineers.


Lead the implementation and operationalization of enterprise data governance standards, policies, and controls across core data domains.
Develop data quality checks, validation rules, monitoring frameworks, technical metadata, business glossaries, and lineage documentation.
Collaborate with Data Owners, Stewards, architects, engineers, and application teams to define business rules, critical data elements, and ownership models.
Build and configure data governance, data quality, and catalog tools while integrating governance capabilities into data pipelines, ERP systems, and analytics platforms.
Support root cause analysis, remediation of data quality issues, governance onboarding, training, and adoption for stewards and technical teams.
Partner with cross-functional teams to continuously improve Teradyne’s data governance operating model and proactively identify governance and data quality risks.


All About You

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you’re ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.


5+ years of professional experience in data governance, data quality, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related data role.
Working knowledge of data governance concepts such as data ownership and stewardship, business glossaries and metadata management, and data quality dimensions and controls.
Hands-on experience with SQL, relational databases, data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical governance solutions.
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to identify and resolve data quality issues across source systems and downstream platforms.
Experience with data governance, data quality, or catalog tools such as Informatica, Collibra, Alation, Atlan, or similar platforms.
Exposure to ERP systems such as Oracle and master data domains.
Experience supporting analytics, reporting, or AI/ML use cases.
Familiarity with data privacy and compliance concepts such as GDPR and SOX.
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work closely with data owners, stewards, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders.
Ability to support training, onboarding, mentorship, and adoption for stewards and technical teams.

Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG) is one of the world’s largest travel retailers and corporate travel managers. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of business intelligence, data analytics, and AI-driven productivity.

Design, develop, maintain, and optimize advanced dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric.
Build intuitive, scalable, and user-focused business intelligence solutions tailored to client requirements.
Leverage Microsoft Copilot, Claude, and Claude Code to accelerate development workflows and improve productivity.
Create and refine prompts for AI tools to support analytics, reporting, data interpretation, and business insight generation.
Analyze large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable business opportunities.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations and business-focused insights.
Develop, optimize, and maintain SQL queries to support reporting and analytics requirements.
Work with relational databases to query, manipulate, and manage data efficiently.
Utilize AI-assisted coding tools to improve query performance and accelerate development cycles.
Partner directly with clients to understand business needs and deliver reporting solutions that add value.
Present insights, dashboards, and findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Create AI-assisted data narratives, summaries, and reporting content where appropriate.
Continuously evaluate opportunities to improve reporting processes, workflows, and analytics capabilities.
Other duties and tasks as assigned
Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Proven experience as a Business Intelligence Developer, BI Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar role.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.
Experience designing and developing business intelligence dashboards and reports.
Solid SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.

Title: Business Systems Developer
Description:
BUSINESS SYSTEMS DEVELOPER

About JOH:

JOH is one of the strongest independent brokers in the country, with offices and strategic partnerships across the United States. We are focused on delivering profitable solutions for both our clients and customers while maintaining our commitment to integrity, passion, and results.

Our teams represent each client with tenacity and respect, delivering results through strong headquarters sales, retail merchandising, and exceptional access to key decision makers. JOH is proud to be a company that is Driven to Sell Right.




SUMMARY

This position is responsible for supporting the data infrastructure and reporting solutions that drive business decisions for both internal stakeholders and clients. Working within a modern technology environment built on Python, Google Cloud, and code-based business intelligence tools, this role contributes across the full data lifecycle - from acquiring and transforming third-party data sources to delivering reliable reporting and analytics solutions.




The ideal candidate possesses strong SQL and analytical skills, enjoys solving complex business problems, and is motivated by building scalable solutions that deliver meaningful business value.




JOB DESCRIPTION

Support JOH’s broader data and technology strategy by developing and delivering reliable, scalable solutions while partnering with departments and divisions to solve business challenges through data, reporting, automation and technology. The position requires strong technical skills, analytical thinking, collaboration, and the ability to take ownership of assigned work from development through successful delivery.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Partner across JOH departments and divisions to identify, prioritize, and develop scalable reporting, data, and technology solutions that improve business processes, increase access to information, and support better decision-making across the organization.
Build and maintain reports and dashboards in our code-based BI layer (Evidence - SQL + Markdown)
Develop and extend our ETL pipelines in Python, processing syndicated point-of-sale, shipment and inventory, retailer direct, and panel/loyalty data into clean, query-ready datasets.
Partner with category management and business stakeholders to translate business needs into clearly defined data solutions, helping refine requirements and ensure successful delivery.
Support and maintain data quality through validation, reconciliation and proactive identification of issues
Contribute to pipeline orchestration, our cloud workflow, and engineering best practices (Git, code review, CI/CD) as you ramp up.
Develop and maintain technical documentation to support knowledge sharing, operational continuity, and long-term maintainability of data assets and processes.




SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS (REQUIRED)

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience
Minimum of 1 year of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, analytics development, or a similar technical role; 3+ years of relevant experience preferred
Strong SQL - you can write, debug, and optimize non-trivial queries comfortably
Working proficiency in Python or demonstrated strong programming aptitude with some scripting experience and the drive to get fluent fast.
A real knack for wrangling messy, inconsistent real-world data and making it trustworthy.
Clear communication with non-technical stakeholders - you can ask the right questions and explain data plainly.
Analytical rigor and attention to detail
Comfort with version control (Git) or a clear willingness to learn it as a daily habit.




SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS (PREFERRED) Experience in any of the following areas is beneficial but not required:

Experience working with CPG data, including syndicated, retailer-direct, inventory data, or panel & loyalty data
Code-based / “BI-as-code” tools: Evidence, dbt, Lightdash, Looker, or similar.
Python data tooling, especially Polars (or pandas) and columnar/Parquet workflows.
Cloud platforms, especially Google Cloud (Cloud Run, GCS, BigQuery).
Pipeline orchestration (Dagster, Airflow, or similar).
CI/CD and general software engineering practices.
Light web-app development (Django, HTMX, or similar) for internal tools.
Familiarity with electronic data interchange (EDI) within a CPG context




COMPETENCIES

Partners Across Departments: Works collaboratively and effectively with colleagues throughout the company toward the common goals of JOH
Delivers Results: Rigorously drives self and others to achieve high levels of individual and organizational performance . . . clearly wants to win
Impacts and Influences Others: Skillfully persuades others to support initiatives, gain alignment with our goals, and act in the best interests of the company
Demonstrates a Deep Understanding of Our Business: Develops and applies a deep personal knowledge of our businesses, customers and clients
Focuses on the Customer and Market: Continuously evaluates what’s important to the customer/client and develops solutions that exceed expectations
Thinks and Acts Strategically: Anticipates business opportunities and challenges and drives long-term strategies while maintaining focus on short-term objectives
Makes Sound Business Decisions: Makes timely, well-informed decisions that advance critical priorities, capitalize on new opportunities, and resolve problems
Partners Across Departments: Works collaboratively and effectively with colleagues throughout the company toward the common goals of JOH

Title: Business Intelligence Specialist
Description:
About The Role

Arcadia Financial Group is a growing independent RIA built around a family office model that integrates financial planning, tax strategy, estate planning, and client service. We believe our clients deserve more than good returns — they deserve clarity, discipline, and a firm that understands their full picture.

To deliver that, we need great information. Business intelligence isn't about producing reports.

It's about helping the firm ask better questions, make better decisions, better serve our clients, and help them fearlessly live every day like it's Saturday.

We're looking for someone to help build that capability. Today, information lives across multiple systems. Some reporting is automated. Some still relies on spreadsheets. Some dashboards exist. Others haven't been built yet. We have ambitious ideas around executive dashboards, marketing analytics, operational scorecards, client segmentation, capacity planning, and business intelligence — but we're looking for someone who can help turn those ideas into reality.

Very few firms our size have made business intelligence a strategic priority. We're intentionally investing in this capability because we believe the firms that make the best decisions over the next decade will be the ones that know their business best. You'll have the opportunity to help build that capability from the ground up — not simply inherit someone else's reporting environment. ou'll work directly with our Director of Operations and COO to create the reporting environment that helps leadership understand what's happening across the firm, identify opportunities before they become problems, and make better decisions.

This role has visibility across every department in the firm. You'll partner with Marketing, Financial Planning, Tax, Client Service, Concierge, and Operations to help leadership understand not just how each department is performing — but how they work together. Because this role supports every department in the firm, you'll work in a highly collaborative environment. Priorities are established by the Director of Operations in partnership with the COO, ensuring your time is focused on the initiatives that will have the greatest impact on the business. This allows you to spend less time reacting to the loudest request and more time delivering meaningful improvements across the firm.

This is not an IT role.

It is not a systems administration role.

It is not a report-running position.

It's a role for someone who enjoys helping organizations think more clearly through better information.

This role does not define organizational strategy or determine the firm's key performance indicators — leadership establishes the metrics that define success. This role builds the reporting environment that delivers those insights accurately, consistently, and efficiently. As Arcadia's Business Intelligence capabilities mature, this position has the opportunity to evolve into a more analytical role focused on business insights, trend analysis, forecasting, and strategic decision support.

Who You Are

You enjoy solving business problems with data.

When someone asks you for a report, your first instinct isn't to ask what columns they want — it's to ask what decision they're trying to make. You know that dashboards aren't valuable because they're beautiful. They're valuable because they improve judgment. You're equally comfortable sitting with a department director to understand a business challenge as you are working with an outside consultant on Power BI, SQL, or data architecture. You're naturally curious, but you're also practical. You understand that the best reporting often removes work rather than creates it.

Most importantly, you take ownership. Not ownership of every project or every request — but ownership of helping the firm make better decisions. You know when to educate someone toward self-service, when to build a new analytical solution, and when to challenge whether a report should exist at all.

You think like an operator, not just an analyst. You understand that behind every metric is a business decision, and behind every business decision are real clients, real families, and real outcomes.

Specifically, You


Think analytically but communicate simply
Translate messy business questions into meaningful reporting
Care deeply about data quality because you know bad data leads to bad decisions
Look for opportunities to automate repetitive work
Build systems that reduce dependency instead of creating it
Enjoy continuous improvement rather than maintaining the status quo
Are energized by helping an organization become smarter over time


If you've ever looked at a dashboard and thought, "this answers the wrong question," you'll probably enjoy working here.

What You'll Own

Business Intelligence Solutions & Reporting


Design, develop, maintain, and continuously improve Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions that support operational and executive decision-making
Translate business requirements into meaningful dashboards, ensuring solutions align with leadership's defined objectives and success metrics
Monitor data quality across our systems, identify inconsistencies, and work with departments to improve accuracy and completeness
Maintain reporting documentation, dashboard standards, and report logic to promote consistency and long-term usability
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and eliminate manual processes
Continuously evaluate reporting effectiveness and recommend enhancements


Guiding Principle: When someone asks you for a report, your first instinct isn't to ask what columns they want — it's to ask what decision they're trying to make.

Collaboration & Adoption


Partner with department leaders to understand operational reporting needs and translate those needs into practical solutions
Train and educate leaders to confidently access, navigate, interpret, and use dashboards within their areas of responsibility
Develop user guides, documentation, and training resources that support long-term adoption
Promote consistent use of dashboards in department meetings and leadership discussions
Serve as the primary internal resource for reporting best practices and business intelligence education
Foster a culture where leaders increasingly use self-service reporting rather than relying on others for routine information


Guiding Principle: Department leaders remain accountable for their departmental metrics and performance. The Business Intelligence Specialist provides the reporting environment, education, and tools that enable leaders to confidently monitor, understand, and act upon those metrics.

Business Intelligence Operations & Continuous Improvement


Partner with Arcadia's external Business Intelligence consulting partner — translating requirements, coordinating enhancements, testing solutions, and supporting implementation
Support data quality initiatives by identifying inconsistencies and partnering with departments to improve reporting integrity
Collaborate with the Director of Operations to prioritize Business Intelligence initiatives aligned with organizational priorities
Continuously identify opportunities to improve reporting capabilities, streamline processes, and expand data-driven decision-making


Guiding Principle: Executive Leadership defines the organization's strategy, business objectives, and key performance indicators. The Director of Operations owns the Business Intelligence roadmap and priorities. The external Business Intelligence consulting partner owns technical architecture, integrations, data warehouse, and platform continuity. Department Leaders own the quality of their department's data and validate their own reporting needs. The Business Intelligence Specialist owns execution, the reporting experience, dashboard development, user adoption, and day-to-day enablement of the Business Intelligence function.

What Success Looks Like — First Year


Leadership relies on live dashboards rather than manually assembled reports
Department leaders confidently run routine reporting themselves while turning to you for meaningful analysis — not basic exports
Manual reporting has been significantly reduced through automation
Data quality has improved because departments understand what matters and why
Leadership has greater confidence in the firm's metrics because they're consistent, transparent, and trusted
Most importantly, the leadership team spends less time gathering information and more time making decisions
Documentation, training, and knowledge transfer ensure continuity of the Business Intelligence function regardless of future staffing changes
The Business Intelligence platform continues to evolve through collaboration between leadership, the Business Intelligence Specialist, and Arcadia's external consulting partner


What This Role Is Not


This is not an IT support position
This is not a systems administrator role
This is not someone who exports reports on demand and waits for the next ticket
This is not a passive analyst


At Arcadia, we don't believe dashboards exist to satisfy curiosity or produce prettier reports. We believe they exist to improve judgment. The work you do should help leadership ask better questions, identify opportunities sooner, eliminate unnecessary work, and ultimately create a better experience for the families we serve.

If you're energized by helping an organization think more clearly — not just report more efficiently — you'll thrive here.

Experience & Background

We care more about how you think than where you've worked. The ideal candidate brings:


3–5 years of experience in Business Intelligence, reporting, dashboard development, business systems, or data visualization
Strong Power BI experience with the ability to develop and maintain interactive dashboards
Working knowledge of SQL and advanced Excel
Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into reporting solutions
Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences
Experience with CRM platforms preferred (Redtail, Salesforce, Wealthbox, or similar)
Experience partnering with software vendors or external consulting firms preferred
Experience training users, developing documentation, and supporting organizational technology adoption
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across departments


Benefits

We believe in taking care of the people who take care of our clients.


80-100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision insurance depending on your plan selection
Unlimited paid time off (PTO) and flexible scheduling
Short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance — fully covered
401(k) retirement plan with 4% company match
Quarterly clothing allowance
Professional development and continuing education opportunities
Collaborative, people-first culture that values innovation and accountability


Arcadia challenges you to fearlessly live every day like it's Saturday.

Title: Product Data Scientist
Description:
Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.

Ever wonder how much of a lift a new flavor gives us, or which flavor a specific machine should be pouring in a specific office at a specific moment? That's this role. We're looking for a Product Data Scientist to support both our Beverage and Software product teams — measuring the incremental impact of every new flavor we launch, and building the recommendation engine that decides what each machine should offer next. You'll also own analytics across our Bevi-proprietary digital experiences, including the UI and the Well, plus our other websites (get a quote, order more, technical support). You'll partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering on both teams, turning data into a clear point of view on what we build next. We're looking for someone who spots what needs to get built before being asked, and drives it to done rather than waiting for direction.

Your Day To Day


Own analytics for our Bevi-proprietary digital experiences, including the UI and the Well — consult with Software on tracking structure, and own the analysis that shows what's working and what's not to inform the product roadmap.
Own tracking and analytics for Bevi.co and Partner.co, including GA4 and tag management, to inform the product roadmap.
Recommend the right analytics tools for our web properties alongside GA4/GTM — session replay, self-serve data, testing, heatmaps — in partnership with Product.
Measure the incremental impact of new flavors, blending A/B testing with non-traditional methods where clean experiments aren't possible.
Build the flavor recommendation engine — models that identify the optimal flavor profile per machine (or cluster), within real constraints like weekly-max updates and required static options.
Translate data and analytics into clear insights and recommendations.
Build clear, informative dashboards and drive adoption to democratize product data.
Partner with data engineering and software teams on data quality, tagging, and instrumentation.


Who You Are


2-4 years of professional experience in product analytics, digital analytics, or data science.
Strong hands-on experience with GA4 and tag management (e.g., GTM) — comfortable owning both the tracking implementation and the analysis built on top of it.
Hands-on experience designing and analyzing experiments — A/B testing and non-traditional/quasi-experimental methods (e.g., pre/post, difference-in-differences, propensity score matching) for situations where clean randomization isn't possible.
Strong SQL and Python/R for querying, modeling, and analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, PowerBI, Hex).
You use AI tools in your own workflow to move faster (eg exploratory analysis, code, documentation), and think about how to make product data accessible to AI tools as well as people.
A proactive, go-getter mindset — you notice what needs to get built before you're asked, and drive your own work to completion without needing to be chased.
Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.


At Bevi, We Believe Compensation Is a Powerful Tool To Attract, Retain, And Grow Talent. Our Compensation Philosophy Centers On 5 Principles


Market-driven - We anchor pay decisions in real-time market data
Performance-based - We reward individual impact, not just tenure
Equitable - We ensure fairness across teams, roles, and demographics
Growth-focused - We invest in talent that scales with Bevi
Total Rewards approach - We strategically balance base pay, bonuses, benefits, and equity


The posted compensation range reflects the salary* for this position. Some roles may be eligible for a commission plan or a bonus incentive. All Bevi employees receive equity in the form of stock options. All full-time employees are invited to participate in our Total Rewards plan, which includes health & medical benefits, flexible spending accounts, flexible PTO, and more. Offers to join Bevi are based on a few criteria, including the scope of the role, the candidate's work experience, targeted skills, internal equity of the team, and external market data.


For Sales roles: The posted range reflects base salary plus commission which is the total potential on target earnings (OTE) for the position.


Pay Range

$120,700—$149,100 USD

Benefits


Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance plans with BlueCross BlueShield, 95% paid by employer
401(k) with company match
Flexible PTO plus 12 company holidays, and additional paid days for sick leave, etc
Generous fully paid parental leave for both birth parents and non-birth parents
Fully employer paid disability and life insurances
Wellness and fitness reimbursements
Monthly stipends for cell phone use and commuting costs
Onsite snacks, weekly catered lunch, and (of course) unlimited Bevi ... plus composting and terra-cycling, too
Happy hours, team-building events, bagel breakfasts, Values awards - and more.


A note on AI in our hiring process: We use AI to help synthesize interview notes and surface themes from feedback, keeping our process consistent as we grow. Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and interviews may be recorded to support note-taking, just let us know if you'd prefer we don't. We'll also ask how you're learning and experimenting with AI in your work. Growing our AI fluency is something every Bevi team member is committed to and invested in.

Our commitment to responsible innovation is reflected in our partnership with the Mass AI Coalition, a collaboration that aligns with our dedication to community-driven progress and the future of technology.

We're passionate about supporting career growth and would love to be part of your professional journey. We also know that talent comes in many forms. We value individual accomplishments, specialized knowledge, and genuine passion over simply checking boxes on a requirements list. Whether you're a seasoned expert or an emerging talent, we're looking for people who are ready to build what's next. If any of our open positions interest you, we'd encourage you to apply! A member of the Bevi Talent team 'recruiting@bevi.co' will be reaching out about next steps if we would like to move forward.

Accommodations

Bevi is committed to an inclusive hiring process and we aim to provide accommodations for persons with disabilities. If you need any accommodations for the application or throughout the interview process please contact recruiting@bevi.co.

Title: Data Analyst, Corporate Human Resources
Description:
Job Description

We are seeking a customer‑focused Data Analyst to join our Corporate Human Resources team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on turning data into actionable insights, enjoys engaging with stakeholders, and is passionate about empowering others to advance their analytics capabilities. You will contribute to building our enterprise data foundation—including the development of our data lake, secure data access, and advanced reporting—and support analytics across the HR function. The role also involves applying AI technologies and building analytical agents to automate insights and enhance decision‑making. The salary range for this position is between $60,000 - $85,500 annually.

Responsibilities


Partner with business and leaders to understand operational challenges and develop data‑driven solutions that support strategic decision‑making.
Act as a trusted advisor, educating internal customers on analytics tools, data literacy, and best practices for self‑service and data‑informed thinking.
Support the development and evolution of the enterprise data lake, including defining requirements, validating datasets, and enabling downstream analytics.
Manage user security and access controls to maintain governed, appropriate data access.
Deliver analytics and reporting across Human Resources, providing visibility into performance, risks, and trends.
Build and deploy AI‑powered analytics capabilities, including agents that automate data processing, summarize insights, and augment reporting workflows.
Lead requirements‑gathering sessions and translate business needs into effective reporting and visualization solutions.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI and Alteryx.
Analyze complex datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that influence business decisions and initiative selection.
Identify opportunities to automate, optimize, and standardize data and analytics processes.
Support data governance practices including data quality, integrity, metadata standards, and stewardship.
Mentor colleagues on interpreting data, leveraging analytics, and applying emerging AI tools effectively.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
2–5 years of experience in analytics, data management, or business analysis.
Experience applying AI in a business context, including building or deploying AI agents.
Experience working with data lakes, data pipelines, or enterprise data platforms is an asset.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer‑centric mindset.
Proficiency in Power BI, Alteryx, SQL, and Excel.
Ability to explain complex analytical and AI concepts in clear, engaging ways for non‑technical audiences.
Strong problem‑solving abilities and a creative, innovative approach to analytics.
Background in statistics, Lean, or Six Sigma is an asset.


About Us

Founded in 1882, J.D. Irving, Limited (JDI) operates in Eastern Canada (New-Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Québec, Ontario, Newfoundland and Labrador), as well as in USA. We are a team of 20,000 dedicated employees. At J.D. Irving, Limited, you are part of a dynamic team of professionals who lead with integrity and are passionate about delivering results. With a culture that nurtures talent and creates an inclusive workplace, you can grow your career across our various operating divisions.

We are committed to creating accessible environments for our colleagues, candidates, and customers. Requests for accommodation due to a disability (which may be visible or invisible, temporary, or permanent) can be made at any stage of application and employment. We encourage candidates to make their accommodation needs known so that we can provide equitable opportunities.

Worried you do not meet all the requirements? Studies have shown that many applicants apply only to job opportunities when they feel they meet 100% of the criteria. We promote an inclusive environment where everyone is appreciated, recognized, and empowered to contribute fully. If you are interested in this position but are worried you did not meet all the requirements, we would encourage you to still apply.

Our recruitment advisors and hiring teams will utilize human screening combined with AI technology to help identify the skills and qualities that matter most to our business, while safeguarding your privacy and using AI responsibly.

We appreciate your interest in our company however only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

About The Team

Irving Business Services is a vital support function within J.D. Irving, Limited, delivering expertise in essential areas such as Finance, Human Resources, Supply Chain, Health and Safety, Communications, and Legal.

By managing resources, delivering fast and flexible outcomes, and fostering innovation, Irving Business Services plays a critical role in driving operational success and supporting the company’s long-term strategic goals. With a focus on collaboration and continuous improvement, Irving Business Services offers exciting opportunities for growth and development within a leading organization.

Your Opportunity at ARC’TERYX:
As the Data Analyst, ReBIRD, your expertise in analysis and data-driven insights supports key decisions on product service, repair, and long-term strategy. Reporting to the Senior Data Analyst, ReBIRD you will work closely with cross-functional partners of the ReBIRD program to deliver a best-in-class guest experience that extends the lifecycle of Arc’teryx products. You are a driven professional focused on creating a data-driven culture and enabling decision makers in the short- and long-term strategy to deliver on a best-in-class guest experience.




This role is based out of our North Vancouver office and is open to hybrid remote work. Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada.






Meet Your Future Team:




Under the Circularity umbrella, the ReBIRD team supports the operations of our warranty and repairs program, our service centers within retail, and resale.  The global ReBIRD program focuses on an exceptional Guest experience at all Commercial touchpoints, inclusive of Guest Services, After Sales, Branded activations, and especially within our owned Vertical channels, Retail and eCommerce. 







If you were in the Data Analyst, ReBIRD role now, here are some of the core activities you would be doing:


Performing data manipulation and analysis to support key performance metrics across the service and repair network


Maintaining recurring forecasts and supporting the development of new forecasting techniques


Building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI including troubleshooting and debugging errors, refreshing, and publishing data


Gathering business requirements and translating them into data requirements and specifications


Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Business Intelligence, Technology, Design, Quality Control, and Supply Chain; representing company needs in after-sales returns and service and working on projects to enable informed decision making


Improving data through research and analysis of product returns and trends in support of product insights and design teams


Understanding and teaching others about global service delivery systems and processes in relation to regional differences and constraints for reporting visibility





Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:





Supporting the creation and reporting of sustainability metrics and measuring the impact of the service and repair program, in partnership with our Sustainability team


Contributing to the evolution of data tools across the business, providing subject matter expertise in future development of data platforms


Integrating APAC regions into greater data analytics work to better inform global ReBIRD analytics


Incorporating raw material data to support forecasting, ordering, managing, and fulfillment






Are you our next Data Analyst, ReBIRD?



You have a Bachelor’s Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Finance, Business or a related field


You have 3+ years' experience synthesizing complex analysis into actionable insights and presenting insights to senior leaders


You have excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to summarize and express ideas clearly through visualizations, written documents and presentations


You have extensive experience in data visualization and analysis software (e.g. Power BI, Excel, Tableau, SQL, etc.)


You have experience with data manipulation and management including ETL, user provisioning, and Power BI service management


You have experience balancing customer focus with long-term strategic goals and operational constraints, and you take initiative in documenting and presenting opportunities for improvement


You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions.


You remain highly flexible and adaptable when faced with ambiguity.


Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it.


You are able and willing to travel as required

Title: Analytics Data Specialist
Description:
Welcome Home!

We’re more than Canada’s largest independent hardware and building supplies retailer—we’re part of communities across the nation.




Build Trusted Data. Empower Every Decision.

As the Analytics Data Specialist, you will champion and deliver enterprise data products that turn raw data into trusted insights, enabling scalable analytics through an Analytics Centre of Excellence. As part of the team that powers enterprise reporting and decision-making, you'll empower every area of the business with trusted data and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. Led by the Manager, Data and Analytics, this opportunity suits a collaborative and detail-oriented professional who enjoys building scalable data solutions, enabling enterprise analytics, and solving complex data challenges.




Ready to make an impact in a new role? Here’s how:

Design, build, and maintain scalable data products within Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystems that deliver trusted, business-ready data for reporting, analytics and decision making.
Develop and maintain Lakehouse and Warehouse data architectures, ensuring structured high performing data layers that support enterprise analytics.
Design and optimize business aligned semantic models that enable consistent reporting and analytics.
Develop automated data pipelines and integrated workflows using Fabric Data Factory, notebooks and Azure services to transform and deliver data.
Implement scalable data transformations that standardize how data is curated and modeled for analytics consumption.
Ensure data quality, integrity and reliability through validation, monitoring and cleansing processes across all datasets.
Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver high quality data solutions and enable adoption of enterprise data products.
Support enterprise data governance and master data management practices by applying data standards and lineage tracking.




We’re looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field; additional analytics certifications are an asset.
A minimum of five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or a related analytics role.
Strong experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Strong experience with data engineering and analytics languages (PySpark, SQL, Python, R).
Experience with database technologies (SQL Server, Azure SQL), PowerShell scripting, and ETL/ELT processes (SSIS).
Experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Experience with automation and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub) to support repeatable deployments.
Strong understanding of modern data architecture, including medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), dimensional and semantic data models, and data governance practices.
Experience delivering end-to-end analytics solutions, including data ingestion, transformation, semantic modeling, and reporting (Power BI).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across distributed data platforms.
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and confidently interact with senior leaders.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Highly adaptable, with a passion for learning and evolving alongside emerging technologies such as Microsoft Fabric and AI.
Experience with data mining, predictive analytics, machine learning, and Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) is an asset.
The ability to be onsite three days a week at our corporate office in St. Jacobs, to accommodate our hybrid working model.




How we’ll make you feel at Home

Our Team Members enjoy life at Home with our strong culture of support and inclusion, excellent benefits, and a team that always has your back. You will receive:

The expected starting salary range for this role is $85,800 - $128,600; the final offer will reflect relevant skills and experience.
Eligible for the annual bonus program.
Comprehensive Benefits Program including:
Health, Dental, Vision, Paramedical, Disability coverage, Out of Country Travel Insurance, Life Insurance, Employee Family Assistance Program.
Defined Contribution Pension Plan with Company Match, and choice of contribution level.
Group RRSP.
Discount from our Corporate Retail Store in St. Jacobs.
Home & Auto Insurance discounts.
Competitive vacation time.
Personal and sick time.
Employee Discount Program through Venngo WorkPerks.

Title: Intermediate Analyst Data Analytics, Revenue Management
Description:
This position requires in-person collaboration up to five days a week. This arrangement is subject to change based on business requirements.

Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. We’re proud to be one of Canada’s most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

Overview Of Role

The Revenue Analytics team provides business intelligence analytics and reporting solutions for the Revenue Management & Pricing department within WestJet. Transforming data into meaningful information is an art form that requires the combination of technical skills and business acumen. In Revenue Analytics, we approach information from the perspective of the business user, creating and developing accurate and reliable solutions that speak to both Executive and front-line audiences. The Revenue Analytics team is rapidly evolving the intelligent landscape of WestJet – implementing creative ideas to capture efficiencies and promote cutting edge analytics.

Reporting to the Manager of Revenue Analytics, you will help build a grassroots analytics function to propel WestJet to a new level of competitiveness. You will actively participate in the conceptualization, development, integration, and troubleshooting of new and existing analyses, tools, and reports - ensuring these solutions land with both Executive audiences and front-line analysts. You are an integral part of the growth of our airline as you ensure a consistent understanding, communication of, and approach to meeting strategic goals.

Key Deliverables Include


Translate Revenue Management, Pricing, and Ancillary business problems into advanced solutions by developing data models and assets, experimenting with innovative ideas, creating insight to support the strategic direction of the company
Develop and implement systems and technology to produce decision support data and tools that enable WestJetters to take strategic action in a dynamic competitive environment
Develop and maintain automated systems to perform a strategic pricing and inventory activities. Select the best methodologies to approach business problems
Improves productivity and quality by automating routine tasks. Seeks to eliminate the need for human intervention and proactively identifies opportunities for quality improvement
Contribute to system adaptation and migration strategy and perform system administration tasks (user setup, system configuration) for all business unit applications
Identifies and conducts required testing efforts for business initiatives and assists, conducts, and supports testing efforts for various stakeholder groups as appropriate
Represent the business unit on large cross-business unit projects, proactively identify potential areas of improvement, and lead plausible solutions from ideation to delivery


Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor’s Degree (Computer Science, Quantitative Economics/ Math/ Stats/ Business/ Engineering or similar)
5+ years with a minimum of 3 years in an analytical role incorporating decision making and project coordination in a fast-paced environment
In-depth understanding of database management systems, online analytical processing (OLAP) and ETL framework and strong proficiency in SQL is mandatory
Proficiency in one or more of the following is a bonus –Alteryx, Tableau, Oracle, Sabre, VBA, Python, R, SAS, ATPCO, Snowflake
Excellent communication and presentation skills and a unique ability to bridge the communication gap between executive and front-end users
Highly motivated, organized, and autonomous individual who can collaborate cross-functionally and lead deliverables and/or projects
At WestJet we pride ourselves on our fun and friendly customer focus
Please note: Analyst level and title will be determined by the selection team based on the evaluation process and the candidates requisite experience.


The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:


A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs


Think we’re a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. We’re Canada’s leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet's Alcohol and Drug Policy. 

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. We welcome diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds so if you're passionate about this role, we encourage you to apply – even if you don't meet every qualification listed. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. If you require accommodation at any stage, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at talent@westjet.com.

We value the time and effort you put into your application. Our recruitment process is highly competitive and while every applicant will receive communication regarding their application status, only those selected to move forward will be contacted with next steps. If this role isn’t the right fit, we encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.

Title: Data Analyst II, Fraud
Description:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind.

Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders

About the Role:

As a Data Analyst, Fraud, you will be part of Remitly's Identity & Trust Analytics Team. Your mission is to leverage analytical methods to identify, prevent, and mitigate fraud impacting our customers globally. You will develop a deep understanding of Remitly's fraud detection systems, regional risk profiles, and operational processes to improve fraud defenses while maintaining a seamless experience for legitimate customers. You'll partner with Product, Engineering, Business Management, and Compliance to customize and optimize fraud models and workflows, integrating data from legacy and new platforms. This hybrid role requires 2–3 days per week in the Vancouver office.

You Will:


Become an expert on Remitly's fraud data (e.g. chargebacks, promo abuse, scams, onboarding risk).
Build data-driven models and dashboards to analyze and monitor fraud exposure, balancing customer experience with operational efficiency.
Collect, normalize, and analyze data from legacy prebriefs, transaction logs, and onboarding systems to identify fraud trends and behavior anomalies.
Partner with Business Management and Product to continuously improve customer verification, KYC, KYB and compliance workflows.
Design and evaluate experiments and A/B tests to measure fraud control effectiveness and minimize false positives.
Develop and track risk metrics that quantify fraud exposure, policy compliance, and system performance.
Provide actionable insights and influence the development of fraud detection strategies, tools, and automation.


You Have:


3+ years in an analytics or fraud/risk analysis role within fintech, e-commerce, or digital payments.
Experience with fraud or trust analytics.
Bachelor's degree in mathematics, engineering, economics, or another quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience).
Proficiency with SQL and hands-on experience analyzing large datasets (Python, R, or statistical modeling experience preferred).
Strong understanding of fraud taxonomies (chargebacks, identity theft, scams, onboarding risk, and promo abuse).
Demonstrated ability to distill business problems, develop hypotheses, perform analysis, and communicate clear recommendations.
Excellent data storytelling and communication skills; ability to translate complex findings into business decisions.


Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $125000. In Canada, Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Our Benefits


Four weeks vacation
Health Benefits
Mental Health & Family Forming Benefits
RRSP plan with company match
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
Life Insurance & Disability
Continuing education and travel benefits


Our Connected Work Culture: Driving Innovation, Together

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster. For corporate team members, we have an in-office expectation of at least 50% of the time monthly, typically achieved by coming in three days a week. This creates a consistent, meaningful overlap that supports team norms and business needs. Managers also have the flexibility to set higher expectations based on their team's specific needs. These intentional in-office moments are vital for deepening relationships, fueling creativity, and ensuring your impact is felt where it matters most.

Remitly is an E-Verify Employer

At Remitly, we are dedicated to ensuring that our workplace offers equal employment opportunities to all employees and candidates, in full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Remitly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Title: Finance Data Analyst – Financial Planning & Analysis
Description:
Alberta Blue Cross® is an Alberta based organization dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experience and community leadership. We’re committed to providing the best health coverage to over 1.8 million members and take an active role in promoting wellness. We believe in what we do—and place trust in our employees to deliver our vision.

Working at Alberta Blue Cross® means having a career where you’ll be recognized for your contributions. We value diversity, encourage our team members to maintain a healthy work-life balance and provide opportunities for career growth.

OVERVIEW:

Alberta Blue Cross is looking for a Finance Data Analyst to join our Financial Planning & Analysis team. Reporting to the Manager, Finance Intelligence and Analytics, the Data Analyst will be quality focused, passionate, a quick learner, self-motivated, analytical and detail oriented. They will ensure a high caliber of data quality and will support and collaborate with the other data teams in the organization. In this flexible work style arrangement, you will be able to work from home and go into office when required.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:


Collect and extract financial and operational data from internal systems and external sources.
Clean, validate, and prepare datasets to ensure accuracy and reliability for analysis.
Develop financial reports and analytics to support business and finance decision-making.
Interpret data trends and explain insights, variances, and findings to the finance team.
Participate in finance data projects, automation, and system enhancements.
Collaborate with Enterprise IT and analytics teams to create and maintain data pipelines and data governance for finance.
Support the maintenance of financial data models, metrics, and reporting tools.
Ensure adherence to data quality standards and contribute to continuous improvement.



WHAT YOU WILL HAVE:


Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Data Analytics, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
3 years’ experience in a similar role in a finance department.
Strong foundation in quantitative analysis, data management, and financial concepts.
Analytically minded with hands on skills in Advanced Excel, VBA, SQL, Python, Power BI and the ability to work with large and diverse sets of data. Experience with other power platform tools is an asset.
Experience in data extraction.
Demonstrated ability to deal with change and excel in high-stress situations.
Ability to manage multiple responsibilities with varying priority to deliver timely results.
Commitment to a highly collaborative team environment including cross-training.
Knowledge of Workday Adaptive planning is an asset.



This position will remain open until a suitable candidate is selected.

Alberta Blue Cross® is an inclusive employer committed to a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We empower and are advocates for our team members by welcoming, respecting and valuing their unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.
