Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Permanent Full Time

We are looking for Senior Analysts to join Canada Life’s Business Enablement, Data Analytics & Reporting team. We are currently hiring for multiple Senior Data Analyst roles and are seeking candidates with experience across one or more of the following skill sets:

We’re hiring for experience in the following areas:


Senior BI Analyst – Core BI delivery focused on requirements, KPI definition, analysis, and Power BI reporting using curated datasets
Senior BI Specialist – End‑to‑end delivery specialists combining advanced Power BI development with strong data‑engineering capability, owning solutions from discovery through build, validation, and rollout
Senior Data Foundation Analyst – Data‑engineering–focused role responsible for building, enriching, and governing data pipelines and datasets that enable downstream BI and analytics


As a Senior Analyst you will join Canada Life’s Business Enablement, Data Analytics and Reporting team. In this role you will support all Canada Operations and Business Enablement teams with the ideation, development, implementation, and maintenance of analytics solutions ranging from descriptive and diagnostic to predictive.

The Senior Analyst, Data & Analytics is a data subject matter expert enhancing decision making, monitoring business performance, providing actionable insight, and driving operational efficiencies using advanced analytics and statistical techniques.

In this role, you will model, analyze, and predict complex business processes. You will translate business requirements into data, reporting, and analytics projects, which you will oversee and support throughout their entire lifecycle.

What You Will Do


Translate business needs into data requirements; collect, integrate, clean, model, and analyze large datasets; and visualize and present insights to business leaders
Build, implement and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards
Use Azure Databricks and advanced SQL to transform and model data, and Power BI to deliver governed, insight‑driven reporting and analytics solutions
Work with large datasets that are not consistent, clean, or fully modelled
Apply strong communication, influence, and strategic thinking to shape analytics solutions and drive business decisions
Define, implement, and monitor metrics and KPIs and ensure ongoing strategic alignment with short and long-term business objectives
Enable effective, efficient working relationships with business partners
Work closely with senior leaders to understand business drivers and enable them to make decisions based on data
Oversee and support projects throughout the entire analytics lifecycle
Assist the business in the ideation of new analytics initiatives ranging from descriptive, diagnostic, predictive to prescriptive
Present and communicate insights and recommendations in a visual and simplified manner
Retrieve, integrate, and transform data from multiple systems using SQL, Python, and other scripting languages


What You Will Bring


3-5 years of relevant experience and a master’s degree in related field of study, or an equivalent combination of bachelor’s degree and extensive related experience
Strong experience in working with data analytics tools (SQL, Python), Databases (SQL Server), Cloud (Azure, Databricks), data visualization tools (Power BI) with demonstrated experience at creating interactive dashboards
Ability to write complex and efficient SQL and Python queries to extract, integrate and transform data from multiple sources and automate data pipelines
Advanced skills in Power BI, Data Modeling, Power Query, and DAX
Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL‑300) certification preferred
Strong experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Subject matter expertise in data analytics and statistical modelling
Polished communication and presentation skills to audiences including senior leadership
Strong analytical skills for problem solving and to monetize value for the organization
Ability to work with little to no documentation or instruction
Think outside the box and identify solutions to overcome obstacles
Proven ability to learn and handle multiple priorities in a challenging work environment
Experience within the Financial Services sector would be an asset
Reliability Status Security Clearance – this can only be completed with candidates who receive an offer of employment. This is a personal security status that is required as a condition of employment before an employee can gain access to Protected B information, assets or work sites as outlined by the Government of Canada website. The cost of submitting these checks will be covered by Canada Life.


The base salary for this position is between $80,400 - $130,400 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc). If you are selected to move forward in our recruitment process, your recruiter will be able to discuss additional details of our total rewards program with you.

Career opportunities will be open a minimum of 5 business days from the date of posting, closing dates will vary depending on the search activity. All applications received will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Title: Analytics Developer
Description:
A Little Bit About Us

Founded in Vancouver in 2016, FORM is the sports technology company behind the award-winning FORM Smart Swim Goggles. Since launching in 2019, our goggles have earned global recognition, including Red Dot, iF Design, and Global Triathlon awards, and are trusted by professional athletes, age-group triathletes, and swimmers looking to get better.

We're a talented, tight-knit team that's fun to work with and serious about building great products. Together, we bring decades of consumer product experience spanning sports eyewear, interface design, and activity-tracking algorithms.

To learn more, visit formswim.com

Position Overview

We're seeking an experienced Analytics Developer to strengthen FORM's analytics data foundation and business intelligence capabilities. Working primarily in SQL, dbt, Amazon Redshift and Tableau, you will transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce and financial data into trusted, reusable models and translate those models into clear, decision-ready dashboards and visualizations. This is a hands-on role for someone who can contribute quickly, take ownership of production work and leave well-tested, documented systems and intuitive reporting behind.

Primary Responsibilities


Build and maintain scalable SQL and dbt models in Amazon Redshift
Transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce, marketing and financial data into clean, reusable analytics datasets
Define and maintain consistent business metrics, including revenue, MRR, churn, retention, trial conversion, customer lifetime value and sales performance
Implement automated data-quality tests, documentation and lineage so stakeholders can trust and understand the data
Monitor scheduled analytics workflows, investigate failures and improve pipeline reliability
Develop and maintain Tableau data sources and dashboards using curated warehouse models
Build Python-based data integrations and automation where SQL and dbt are not the right tools
Improve Git-based development, code review, deployment and CI/CD practices for analytics
Partner with Analytics, Data Engineering and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable data products


Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications


3 - 5 years of experience in analytics development, data engineering or a highly technical analytics role
Advanced SQL skills and strong knowledge of dimensional data modelling
Hands-on experience building, testing and documenting production data models with dbt
Experience working with a cloud data warehouse; Amazon Redshift and AWS experience are preferred
Experience using Git, code review and software development practices in an analytics environment
Working proficiency in Python for data pipelines, integrations or automation
Experience with Tableau or another modern business intelligence platform
Ability to troubleshoot data issues across source systems, transformation pipelines and downstream reporting
Strong communication skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into clear, maintainable data solutions


Nice to Haves


Experience with Dagster, Airflow or another workflow orchestration platform
Experience with Fivetran or other managed data ingestion tools
Experience with subscription, ecommerce, product telemetry or financial data
Experience working in a fast-paced startup or consumer technology environment


We thank you for your interest in FORM and to everyone who took the time to apply for this position, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted.

FORM is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of diversity and inclusion. We recognize that we are better able to achieve our goals and live our core values when we have a diverse team of employees. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment. We welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, race, colour, place of origin, religion, family status, marital status, physical or mental disability, sex, age, sexual orientation, or political beliefs.

Benefits


Extended Healthcare Plan (Medical, Disability, Dental & Vision)
Group Life - AD&D - Critical Illness Insurance
Paid Time Off Benefits
Employee Discounts
Employee Assistance Program - Counselling


This role has an annual salary range of $90,000 to $110,000. Most new hires do not start at the top of the range. Compensation is determined based on a candidate's experience, skills, qualifications, and overall alignment with the role.

Candidates who are newer to this level of responsibility but demonstrate strong potential may receive an offer toward the lower end of the range.   • Transform raw product, subscription, ecommerce, marketing and financial data into clean, reusable analytics datasets

  • Implement automated data-quality tests, documentation and lineage so stakeholders can trust and understand the data
  • Monitor scheduled analytics workflows, investigate failures and improve pipeline reliability
  • Develop and maintain Tableau data sources and dashboards using curated warehouse models
  • Build Python-based data integrations and automation where SQL and dbt are not the right tools
  • Improve Git-based development, code review, deployment and CI/CD practices for analytics
  • Partner with Analytics, Data Engineering and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable data products

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 3 - 5 years of experience in analytics development, data engineering or a highly technical analytics role
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong knowledge of dimensional data modelling
  • Hands-on experience building, testing and documenting production data models with dbt
  • Experience working with a cloud data warehouse; Amazon Redshift and AWS experience are preferred
  • Experience using Git, code review and software development practices in an analytics environment
  • Working proficiency in Python for data pipelines, integrations or automation
  • Experience with Tableau or another modern business intelligence platform
  • Ability to troubleshoot data issues across source systems, transformation pipelines and downstream reporting
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into clear, maintainable data solutions

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with Dagster, Airflow or another workflow orchestration platform
  • Experience with Fivetran or other managed data ingestion tools
  • Experience with subscription, ecommerce, product telemetry or financial data

Eastlink

Can identify trends, evaluate impacts, and make well-supported recommendations.

Build strong working relationships and collaborate effectively with different teams.

Three or more years of experience in an analytical, financial, operational, or business support role.

Title: Data Analyst, Investment Data Management
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.


The salary range for this position is $60,000-$90,000. The salary range provided reflects the base salary range for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation for this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

Title: Vineyard Business Analyst
Description:
Winemaking in some major regions of the world can be an ‘industrial’ undertaking, but for us here at Iconic Wineries of British Columbia, every decision in the vineyard has a direct impact on the quality of what ultimately ends up in the bottle.

Exceptional vineyards require more than great farming practices. They require clear insights, strong operational discipline, and the ability to understand the story behind the data.

Our vineyards generate vast amounts of information every season, from labour and productivity metrics to purchasing activity, operational costs, vineyard performance trends, and planning data. The opportunity is no longer collecting data. It is transforming that information into meaningful insights that help our teams make better decisions.

The Role

As our Vineyard Business Analyst, you will play a critical role in helping us better understand, measure, and optimize the performance of our vineyard operations. Sitting at the intersection of data, operations, finance, and viticulture, you will transform complex operational information into actionable insights that improve productivity, strengthen cost visibility, and support decision-making across our vineyards. This is a highly collaborative role that combines business analysis, operational reporting, procurement support, and data visualization. You will work closely with Vineyard Managers, operational leaders, and finance partners to uncover trends, identify opportunities, and build reporting tools that provide clarity across vineyard operations. More than a reporting role, this is an opportunity to bring a fresh perspective, challenge assumptions with data, and help shape how vineyard performance is measured and managed for years to come.

Productivity & Performance Analytics


Measure and monitor vineyard productivity, labour efficiency, and operational performance across activities, blocks, sites, and seasons.
Analyze key operational metrics including hours per acre, cost per activity, labour utilization, and year-over-year performance trends.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Translate complex operational data into practical recommendations that vineyard leadership can act on.
Support annual planning processes through productivity benchmarking, workforce analysis, and operational forecasting.
Develop meaningful performance indicators that help leaders understand operational effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.


Data Visualization & Reporting


Design and maintain dashboards and reporting tools that provide visibility into vineyard performance and operational health.
Transform data from multiple operational systems into meaningful business insights.
Develop reporting frameworks that allow teams to proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Present data in a clear and compelling way, helping stakeholders understand the story behind the numbers.
Ensure data integrity, consistency, and accessibility across vineyard reporting processes.
Create visualizations that simplify complex datasets and support informed decision-making at all levels of the organization.


Financial Analysis, Procurement & Cost Visibility


Support procurement and purchasing activities by validating invoices and ensuring alignment to approved budgets and plans.
Monitor vineyard operating costs and spending trends to improve financial visibility across the organization.
Partner with Finance and operational teams to improve cost reporting and forecasting accuracy.
Identify potential productivity or cost-related risks before they become larger operational challenges.
Maintain disciplined documentation and reporting standards that support planning, budgeting, and operational decision-making.
Help establish stronger cost controls and spending transparency across vineyard operations.


Collaboration & Continuous Improvement


Partner closely with Vineyard Managers, operational leaders, finance teams, vendors, and stakeholders across the business.
Build trusted relationships while introducing new ways of measuring and evaluating operational performance.
Support the development of data-driven processes that improve consistency and operational discipline across vineyard operations.
Bring curiosity, fresh thinking, and a continuous improvement mindset to help evolve how work gets done.
Contribute to a culture where decisions are informed by data, insight, and transparency.
Act as a bridge between operational teams and data, ensuring insights translate into meaningful action.


Who You Are


Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Supply Chain, Agriculture, or a related discipline.
2+ years of experience in business analysis, operational analytics, financial analysis, supply chain, procurement, or a similar analytical role.
Advanced Excel skills with strong capabilities in data manipulation, reporting, and analysis.
Experience with data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools.
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to transform data into actionable recommendations.
Comfortable working with both operational and financial datasets in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders through data and insights.
Experience in agriculture, wine, food manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, or operational environments is considered an asset, but not required.
Naturally curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by solving problems and improving processes.
Able to translate complex information into simple, practical business recommendations.


What's In It For You


A rare opportunity to help build and shape how vineyard performance is measured across one of Canada's most respected premium wine organizations.
Visible impact across vineyard operations, influencing planning, budgeting, productivity improvement, and operational decision-making.
Exposure to vineyard operations, finance, procurement, business analytics, and strategic planning in one highly collaborative role.
The opportunity to create reporting tools and processes that become foundational to how our teams operate.
A role where your insights directly influence business decisions rather than sit in a report.
Partnership with experienced vineyard, finance, and operational leaders who value curiosity, fresh thinking, and continuous improvement.
The ability to bring a fresh lens, challenge legacy processes, and make a measurable impact on how the business operates.

Title: Analyst, Rebates - Calgary or Saskatoon
Description:
Nutrien is a leading provider of crop inputs and services, and our business results make a positive impact on the world. Our purpose, Feeding the Future, is the reason we come to work each day. We’re guided by our culture of care and our core values: We put safety first. We act with integrity. We are stronger together. We deliver with excellence.

Through the collective expertise of our nearly 26,000 employees, we operate a world-class network of production, distribution, and ag retail facilities. We efficiently serve growers' needs and strive to provide a more profitable, sustainable, and secure future for all stakeholders.  Help us raise the expectation of what an agriculture company can be and grow your career with Nutrien. 

We are currently hiring for two openings within this position.

What You'll Do


Lead monthly reporting, quarterly forecasting, and strategic annual budgeting activities
Develop and maintain analytical models to deliver actionable insights on supplier profitability and rebate performance
Manage rebate programs in Segmentation/Vistex, including setup, maintenance, and product-level impact analysis
Ensure accurate data setup and integration across ERP, and rebate accrual systems
Support supplier contract lifecycle through financial analysis, negotiation input, implementation tracking, and redemption oversight
Serve as liaison between Vistex consultants and internal teams to ensure business requirements are clearly defined and delivered
Conduct financial modeling, sensitivity analysis, and business case evaluations to support strategic decisions and new business initiatives
Present financial analyses quantifying P&L impact and communicate key findings to stakeholders
Recommend and implement automated solutions to enhance regular business activities to ensure efficiency within tasks
Align with strategic supplier managers on new or changes in reporting requirements to deliver accurate analytical and performance rebate program metrics
Collaborate cross-functionally with Strategic Supplier Managers, FP&A, and other key stakeholders, working independently as needed


What You'll Bring


Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in data sciences, finance, or economics. MBA a plus. Experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
3+ years of related experience required, preferably in Finance or Business Analysis
Demonstrate a high level of attention to detail and accuracy in your work
Excellent organization and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities
Understanding of business forecasting and analytics is required, with prior experience in vendor rebate analytics as a strong differentiator
Ideal candidate would have experience with FP&A, SAP, Vistex, reporting, analytics, and Excel modeling; however, candidates who offer a combination of several of these qualifications will be considered
Curiosity to find ways to create efficiencies to improve processes over time
Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills preferred
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, demonstrating initiative & problem solving
Strong written, presentation, and verbal communication skills; ability to effectively communicate at all levels of the organization


What You'll Get


Purpose-Driven Work – Make an impact as part of a global team feeding the future and support farmers locally and around the world
Excellent Benefits – Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, plus a retirement program with generous employer matching for your future
Grow Your Career – Tuition assistance for future education and ongoing learning and training opportunities for career advancement pathways across the organization
Support When it Matters – Employee Assistance Programs, inclusive leaves, and paid time for holidays, volunteering, vacation, and wellness
Thrive in a Strong Culture – Guided by our core values we put safety first, act with integrity, are stronger together, and deliver with excellence in a collaborative, high-performing environment


Ready to make an impact with us? Apply today!  

The estimated salary that Indeed, Glassdoor and LinkedIn lists does not represent Nutrien's compensation structure. Nutrien is an equal opportunity employer.  We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.  

This job will remain posted until filled. In accordance with Nutrien policies, you will be required to undergo a background check, and may be required to undergo a substance test. While we appreciate all applications we receive, only candidates under consideration will be contacted. Applicants must meet minimum age requirements, as permitted by law.

Title: Business Intelligence & Data Systems Analyst
Description:
💼 Are you someone who enjoys transforming raw data into meaningful business insights while helping teams make smarter, data-driven decisions?




Our client is a Canadian-owned healthcare organization focused on developing, manufacturing, and marketing innovative products. They are a collaborative and entrepreneurial organization where employees have the opportunity to work closely with the business and make a meaningful impact.




💻 Who You Are




We are looking for a Business Intelligence & Data Systems Analyst to take ownership of the organization's data ecosystem and help transform data into meaningful business insights.




This is a highly hands-on and autonomous role. You will be the primary resource responsible for the company's BI and data environment, working across systems, data integrations, reporting, and analytics while partnering directly with stakeholders across the business.




The ideal candidate is someone who not only knows how to work with data, but thinks critically about how data should be organized, structured, documented, and used to support scalable business decisions.




📍 Work Type




Location: Oakville, ON (Hybrid - 2 days a week in office)
Vacancy Type: This role reflects an existing vacancy




🎯 What You'll Do:




Data & Systems Management




Take ownership of the organization's data and analytics environment, including Qlik Sense, Snowflake, Fivetran, Census, and Veeva CRM.
Monitor and troubleshoot data integrations and pipelines to ensure data is accurate, reliable, and accessible.
Identify inconsistencies, investigate data issues, and work with internal teams, consultants, and software vendors to resolve issues.
Establish scalable approaches to data organization, documentation, and governance.
Help reduce one-off data solutions by developing more standardized and sustainable processes.
Manage relationships with technology vendors and know when to leverage vendor and consultant expertise.
Identify opportunities to improve automation, data architecture, and the overall efficiency of the data environment.




Business Intelligence & Reporting




Own the development and ongoing administration of Qlik Sense, including dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and reporting.
Develop standardized reporting across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Leadership.
Pull data from multiple systems and turn it into meaningful insights and recommendations.
Analyze business performance and identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring further investigation.
Ensure the business is reporting on the right information and that KPIs accurately reflect business performance.
Present dashboards, reporting, and insights to stakeholders across the organization.
Support both recurring reporting requirements and ad hoc analytical requests.




Data Strategy & Business Partnership




Work directly with stakeholders across multiple business units to understand their reporting and analytics needs.
Help establish a more structured and scalable approach to how business data is organized and managed.
Act as a key resource in developing the organization's data and reporting strategy.
Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and emerging technologies to improve reporting and decision-making.
Support data initiatives involving additional sources and platforms, including potential integrations with Amazon and Shopify.
Balance ongoing reporting needs with longer-term data improvement and implementation projects.




⭐ What We're Looking For:




3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Data Management, or a similar role.
Strong hands-on experience with Qlik Sense is required.
Strong SQL and data analysis capabilities.
Experience working with data warehouses, integrations, and ETL/ELT processes.
Experience with Snowflake is strongly preferred.
Experience with Fivetran, Census, and/or Veeva CRM is an asset.
Power BI experience is an asset, particularly as the organization continues to evaluate its future BI strategy.
Strong understanding of data organization, data quality, governance, and scalable data practices.
Ability to investigate data discrepancies and troubleshoot issues across multiple systems.
Strong business acumen and the ability to identify the key insights and business drivers within data.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience working with external technology vendors and consultants is an asset.




Benefits




Base Salary: $70,000 - $85,000
Paid Time Off
Annual Performance-Based Bonus
Health & Dental Benefits: Comprehensive coverage to support your overall well-being

Title: Fleet & Equipment Data Analyst & Coordinator
Description:
Overview:

The Fleet & Equipment Data Analyst & Coordinator supports the effective financial capture and operational management of the company’s equipment and vehicle fleet. This position is responsible for collecting, validating, and analyzing fleet data to improve equipment costing, project allocation, utilization, maintenance planning, replacement forecasting, and full life-cycle management.

Working closely with Fleet, Operations, Finance, Maintenance, Procurement, and Project Management, the incumbent will maintain accurate cost profiles for each asset and provide validated information regarding equipment deployment, retention, replacement, rental, purchase, and disposal.




Duties and Responsibilities:




Fleet Costing and Data Analysis

Manage, maintain and monitor complete cost profiles for designated assets.
Manage ownership and operating costs, including including replacement cost, interest, lifecycle, fuel, labour, repairs, maintenance, licensing, insurance, telematics, transportation, and salvage.
Calculate hourly, daily, monthly, and per-kilometre equipment costs.
Update appropriate internal charge-out and project allocation rates.
Compare actual equipment costs against budgets, forecasts, and established benchmarks.
Investigate cost variances and identify opportunities to reduce total cost of ownership.
Support capital budgeting and business cases for equipment purchases and replacements.
Identify and analyze operator factors both positive and negative which affect life cycles and cost of operation







Equipment Allocation and Utilization

Coordinate and perform the allocation of asset costs to divisions, yards, and operating locations.
Ensure equipment usage is assigned to the correct cost code, department, or business unit.
Report on utilization, availability, downtime, idle time, and production hours.
Identify underutilized, overallocated, or inactive assets to the responsible parties.
Analyze company-owned equipment costs against rental, lease, subcontract, and purchase options.




Equipment Life-Cycle Management

Maintain life-cycle records for each asset from acquisition through disposal.
Track equipment age, hours, kilometers, condition, maintenance history, reliability, utilization, replacement value, and market value.
Assist in maintaining replacement criteria based on age, operating hours, repair trends, downtime, safety, productivity, and residual value.
Prepare repair-versus-replace and retain-versus-dispose analyses.
Support the development of annual and multi-year capital replacement plans.
Document asset specifications, participate in research of emerging technologies, fuel alternatives, and industry trends.
Assist with disposal planning, trade-in evaluations, auction reviews, and resale-value analysis.
Conduct post-purchase and post-disposal reviews to compare actual results with projections.




Data Management and Reporting

Maintain accurate fleet master data of assets across maintenance, accounting, telematics, fuel, procurement, and project-management systems.
Audit data for missing entries, duplication, incorrect allocations, and inconsistent asset information.
Monitor and provide info and recurring reports
Total cost of ownership
Providing data to Supervisors regarding operator performance
Convert operational data into clear findings for management.
Support the development of standardized fleet policies, processes, cost codes, and performance measures.




Coordination and Continuous Improvement

Coordinate information between Fleet, Maintenance, Finance, Operations, Procurement, Dispatch, and Project Management.
Follow up on missing meter readings, work orders, invoices, fuel transactions, equipment transfers, and allocation records.
Participate in fleet-planning, capital-budget, maintenance, and operational review meetings.
Document workflows and recommend improvements to data capture and reporting processes.
Support implementation and improvement of fleet-management, ERP, telematics, maintenance, and business-intelligence systems.
Assist with special studies related to fleet standardization, productivity, emissions, electrification, and operating efficiency.




Requirements:

Two to five years of experience in fleet analysis, equipment coordination, construction operations, maintenance administration, cost accounting, or asset management.
Experience with construction equipment, commercial vehicles, or industrial fleets is strongly preferred.
Understanding of equipment costing, depreciation, utilization, preventive maintenance, and capital replacement planning.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, data validation, and financial modelling.
Experience with fleet-management, ERP, telematics, maintenance, or business-intelligence systems is an asset.
A valid driver’s license may be required.




Knowledge and Skills

Strong analytical and research capabilities
High level of accuracy and attention to detail
Ability to connect financial data with field-operating conditions
Strong organizational and coordination skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow up on incomplete information
Clear written and verbal communication
Sound judgment and practical problem-solving
Ability to explain complex cost information to operational and non-financial stakeholders
Understanding of heavy equipment terminology and construction operations
Commitment to confidentiality, data integrity, safety, and continuous improvement




Cavanagh Employee Benefits:

Family oriented work environment
Attractive, competitive compensation for qualified candidates
Internal growth opportunities
Training and development opportunities
Benefit, Wellness and Pension Plans




Wage Range:

The salary range for this position in Ontario at the start of employment is expected to be between $70,000 per year and $80,000 per year. However, the range offered is based on local job market factors and may vary further depending on factors specific to the selected job candidate, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

Description:
Job Information

Job Title: Senior Data Analyst

Job Requisition ID: 85400

Ministry: Transportation and Economic Corridors

Location: Edmonton

Full or Part-Time: Full Time

Hours of Work: 36.25 hours per week

Permanent/Temporary/Wage: Temporary (2-year contract)

Scope: Open Competition

Closing Date: August 24, 2026

Classification: Program Services 4

Salary: $3,148.2 to $4,126.82 bi-weekly ($82,168 - $107,710/year)

Alberta Transportation and Economic Corridors (TEC) is a centre of excellence for transportation in North America. We contribute to Alberta's prosperity and quality of life by providing and supporting a safe, innovative and sustainable provincial transportation system and water management infrastructure. With Alberta Transportation and Economic Corridors, you can engage in a fulfilling career with diverse room to grow. We believe in building careers, providing opportunities for growth within the organization, and striving to provide our staff with a work-life balance including reasonable hours of work to ensure time with family and to accommodate outside interests.

The Ministry Promotes a Vital And Diverse Economy By


Managing transportation safety.
Supporting municipalities with public transportation and water/wastewater facilities.
Expanding and enhancing a well-integrated transportation system and enabling market access.
Preserving and developing the provincial highway network and water management infrastructure.


For more information, visit https://www.alberta.ca/transportation-and-economic-corridors .

Role Responsibilities

This position reports to the Manager, Data and Analytics within the Modernization and Business Intelligence unit of Motor Vehicle Modernization branch of Traffic Safety Services (TSS) division of TEC. The Senior Data Analyst leads the analysis of complex traffic safety datasets and extracts key insights and interpretations to drive evidence-based policy and business decision making.

The primary responsibilities for the Senior Data Analyst include, but are not limited to:


Advanced Data Analysis and Comprehension
Lead complex data analysis projects by applying advanced statistical methods and techniques to extract actionable insights.
Identify emerging trends or patterns in traffic safety data and investigate contributing factors to help inform policy decisions.
Strategic Data Reporting and Dashboards
Design, develop, and maintain advanced reporting systems and interactive dashboards that support performance measurement, program evaluation, and decision - making.
Ensure that reports and dashboards provide real-time, actionable insights, are user-friendly, and align with departmental goals and outcomes.
Predictive and Prescriptive Analytics
Utilize predictive modeling, machine learning, natural language processing techniques and other advanced analytical techniques to forecast future trends, assess risks, and develop prescriptive recommendations.
Lead initiatives that leverage data analytics to optimize program delivery and improve service outcomes within Traffic Safety Services operations.
Data Governance and Standards
Lead the implementation of data governance frameworks, ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and consistent across government systems.
Develop and enforce best practices for data quality assurance, ensuring data integrity, security, and privacy across all analytical initiatives.
Policy Development and Evaluation
Provide data-driven insights to inform the development of policies, regulations, and strategic initiatives.
Participate in government working groups and committees, providing expert level analytical support to evaluate the effectiveness and impact of traffic safety programs using rigorous data analysis methods, recommending improvements based on findings.


The Successful Candidate Will Have


Proven ability to manage complex data projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery, quality control, and alignment with business objectives.
Strong project management skills, including managing resources, timelines, and deliverables across multiple teams and departments.
In-depth understanding of public sector operations and government program structures, with the ability to tailor data analysis to inform program performance and policy development.
The ability to evaluate the effectiveness of government initiatives, identify gaps, and propose data-driven solutions for improvement.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present data findings to a wide range of audiences, from technical teams to senior executives and government officials.
Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate with various departments and stakeholders, influencing decision-making through data-driven insights.
Proven leadership ability to mentor and guide junior data analysts, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.


The Job Description is provided for Further details on this position.

APS Competencies

Competencies are behaviors that are essential to reach our goals in serving Albertans. We encourage you to have an in depth understanding of the competencies that are required for this opportunity and to be prepared to demonstrate them during the recruitment process.


Systems Thinking – Takes a long-term view towards organization’s objectives and how to achieve them: Senior Data Analyst has a well-rounded and deep understanding of TEC's 48 technology applications and the data sets within each and the interrelationships between the data sets.
Creative Problem Solving – Engages the community and resources at hand to address issues: Develops compelling insights and recommendations through creative storytelling and data visuals that meet the needs of non-technical senior leaders.
Develop Networks – Works on maintaining close relations with all stakeholders: Actively develops connections and influences others through the course of their duties.
Develop Self and Others – Plans according to career goals and regular development: The SDA takes a life long learning approach to data analysis and learns new techniques and data analysis software as it becomes available.


Qualifications

Required:


University graduation in Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Intelligence, Analytics or a related field PLUS Four (4) years’ progressively responsible related experience


Equivalency: Related experience or education (e.g. related diploma) may be considered as an equivalency on a one for one basis

Assets


Master’s degree preferred. Strong project management skills, including managing resources, timelines, and deliverables across multiple teams and departments.
Proficiency in advanced data visualization tools and reporting platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to create interactive dashboards and reports. The hiring team would prefer to see a copy of candidate’s portfolio of previous work/dashboards. (Not mandatory)
Expertise in statistical Modeling, regression analysis, time series forecasting, Clustering, and multivariate analysis. Proficiency in applying machine learning algorithms and advanced analytics techniques (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning) to solve complex problems.
Expertise in SQL for querying, analyzing, and manipulating large datasets from relational databases. Proficiency in using programming languages for data analysis (e.g., Python or R)
Strong ability to use visualization techniques to communicate insights clearly and effectively to senior leadership and external stakeholders.
Ability to interpret and present complex, actionable insights and analytical results (via visualizations, written reports and KPIs) to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong experience with data quality management, including data cleansing, validation, cataloging, and monitoring for data integrity.
Proven ability to manage complex data projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery, quality control, and alignment with business objectives.
Strong knowledge of data management principles, including data governance, metadata management, and data integration across diverse sources (e.g., databases, APIs).
Deep understanding of data governance frameworks and best practices, ensuring data privacy, security, and compliance with relevant legislation and regulation such as the
Access to Information Act (ATIA), the Protection of Privacy Act (POPA) and the Access to Motor Vehicle Information Regulation (AMVIR).

Additional Position Details


Term of Employment: Temporary, full-time role (2-year contract) with the standard weekly work hours of 36.25, Monday to Friday (8:15 am – 4:30 pm).
Location: Edmonton.

Candidates are required to apply for a job online. Please see Job Application Resources for information.

It is recommended applicants who have completed post-secondary studies from outside of Canada obtain an evaluation of their credentials from the International Qualifications Assessment Service (IQAS) or from a recognized Canadian Credential Evaluator; please visit the Alliance of Credential Evaluation Services of Canada for more information .

It is recommended that applicants include the assessment certificate from IQAS or any other educational assessment service as part of their application.

  • Proficiency in advanced data visualization tools and reporting platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to create interactive dashboards and reports. The hiring team would prefer to see a copy of candidate’s portfolio of previous work/dashboards. (Not mandatory)
  • Expertise in statistical Modeling, regression analysis, time series forecasting, Clustering, and multivariate analysis. Proficiency in applying machine learning algorithms and advanced analytics techniques (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning) to solve complex problems.
  • Expertise in SQL for querying, analyzing, and manipulating large datasets from relational databases. Proficiency in using programming languages for data analysis (e.g., Python or R)
  • Strong ability to use visualization techniques to communicate insights clearly and effectively to senior leadership and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to interpret and present complex, actionable insights and analytical results (via visualizations, written reports and KPIs) to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong experience with data quality management, including data cleansing, validation, cataloging, and monitoring for data integrity.
  • Proven ability to manage complex data projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery, quality control, and alignment with business objectives.
  • Strong knowledge of data management principles, including data governance, metadata management, and data integration across diverse sources (e.g., databases, APIs).
  • Deep understanding of data governance frameworks and best practices, ensuring data privacy, security, and compliance with relevant legislation and regulation such as the
  • Access to Information Act (ATIA), the Protection of Privacy Act (POPA) and the Access to Motor Vehicle Information Regulation (AMVIR).
